[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/62?t=1001&akid=7431%2E5257348%2EugPL-R ]Adam Schiff for Senate

Derek, Trump
went after me again yesterday in Wisconsin:

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=sept2024_abs_em.p0j6ot&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_RES_AC90_20240908_PM1_V1_S1&t=1004&akid=7431%2E5257348%2EugPL-R ]Trump holds a rally in Wisconsin

“Thomas Jefferson did the same kind of things. Alexander Hamilton. Lots of
people. All throughout the ages. Hillary Clinton wouldn’t acknowledge the
election. All of these senators like Shifty Schiff. Can you imagine?
Shifty Adam Schiff, all of them, they disputed the 2016 election. It’s
okay for them to do it. But if we do it it’s a serious, serious crime.
These people are sick. We’ve got to get them the hell out of there. We
have to win this election.”

I have three quick things to say about this, but if you’re ready to help
us win no matter what, [ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=sept2024_abs_em.p0j6ot&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_RES_AC90_20240908_PM1_V1_S1&email=&amount=10&t=1005&akid=7431%2E5257348%2EugPL-R ]rush a
$10
donation now.

$10

First, what a compliment to be mentioned among names like Hamilton and
Jefferson.

Second, Trump is crazy, but he’s not stupid. Of course, he lost the
popular vote to Secretary Clinton by 3 million in 2016, and of course the
Russians helped him win by hacking and dumping DNC emails and running a
social media campaign for him. But he thinks more lies will trick voters
into helping him win.

And third. You may be wondering why your contribution to my race is so
urgent — because after all, despite my opponent, Steve Garvey, outraising
us by $1.2 million in the most recent FEC quarter, Trump seems to think
I’ve already won.

But here’s the thing,
Derek — Axios just reported
this week that “Control of the U.S. House may come down to six races in
California.”

It’s why National Republicans have invested more than $6.4 million in
House races across the state.

And here is the truth: Even if we elect Vice President Harris (no sure
thing in a race this close), if we are going to have any hope of taking
back the House and ending the last two years of MAGA-controlled chaos,
then we simply cannot leave these California Democrats to fight back
entirely on their own.

I’m doing everything I can to help these House candidates even as I run
hard in my own campaign. That is why your donation to our race in
California matters. Let’s take back the House, defend the Senate, and
defeat Trump.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=sept2024_abs_em.p0j6ot&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_RES_AC90_20240908_PM1_V1_S1&email=&amount=10&t=1007&akid=7431%2E5257348%2EugPL-R ]Rush in

body:
| Can I tell you a story about my family farm, folks? [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/77752?t=6&akid=16707%2E878179%2EZtRQvh) In 1910, my grandfather came to Montana. He found a piece of grassy land, took a look at it, and said, “This is the place.” And that’s where the farm began.

He farmed the land until the early 1940s, and then passed it down to my folks. In 1978, my wife Sharla and I took over the farm and we’re still here today, three generations and more than 40 years later.

We’ve made a lot of progress here — Sharla and I built a new home, several steel buildings, and more storage.

The truth is, I love this work. Yes, it makes for early mornings and late nights during planting and harvest seasons — but it also keeps me grounded, and it gives me perspective on the issues we face every day.

When I think about climate change, I’m thinking of folks on farms like mine, struggling with catastrophic droughts or historic levels of flooding. When I think about reforming the USPS, I’m thinking of the people in rural communities across Montana who rely on timely mail delivery for their medication or Social Security checks. And when I think about infrastructure, I’m thinking of the rural towns near mine that need access to affordable, high-speed internet.

**These aren’t abstract issues or talking points. They’re very real challenges that deserve real solutions, and that’s what I’m fighting for in Washington. I spend every single day trying to do right by working families, farmers, students, and veterans here in Montana and across the country.

subject: War criminals and genociders will always stick together

body:
The ghastly reality of Harris accepting Cheney’s endorsement.

| | | [ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=cheney_endorsement&n=1)
---
Peter,

It’s the buddy comedy nobody asked for.
---
[ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=cheney_endorsement&n=2)
---
The neoliberal political chattering class is gushing over Kamala Harris’ latest endorsement – the notorious and unrepentant war criminal, Dick Cheney.

Let’s refresh everyone on who Dick Cheney really is.

**Dick Cheney was the architect of the WMD lie that launched the Iraq war** , leading to the deaths of millions of Iraqis, thousands of our own troops and civilian support staff, and handing a multibillion dollar no-bid contract to his former company, Halliburton-KBR.

**Dick Cheney spearheaded the use of torture as official US policy** , coordinating the infamous “torture memo” by leaning on the Office of Legal Counsel and squashing dissent within the administration. When evidence surfaced of US troops **torturing Iraqis at the Abu Ghraib prison camp** – reports that bear a startling resemblance to the conduct at Israel’s Sde Tieman prison today – Cheney went on a media blitz defending all of it as “enhanced interrogation techniques.”

**Dick Cheney drove the decision to convert the US Naval base in Guantanamo Bay into a prison** for nearly 800 men he labeled as “enemy combatants” – a legal term designed to dodge accountability for treatment of prisoners of war under the Geneva convention. Of the 780 men they detained, only 12 have ever led to formal charges and prosecution, and even fewer convicted. At least 9 have died in custody after enduring years of physical and psychological torture. **There are still 31 men incarcerated at GITMO today** – remaining in custody under both Republican and Democratic administrations.

Dick Cheney was also the principal actor behind the practice of **mass surveillance** of US citizens and the use of **drone strikes** – both of which vastly expanded under Barack Obama’s administration. He also tried to push us into **war with Iran** (and mercifully failed).

The full list of Dick Cheney’s crimes is too long for this email. Yet Kamala Harris is honored to have his endorsement as well as the endorsement of his daughter, Liz Cheney – calling them both “leaders who are well-respected.”
---
[ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=cheney_endorsement&n=3)
---
This “well-respected leader” dissolved the entire Middle East into chaos, politically destabilized multiple countries leading to mass deaths in Iraq, Syria, Yemen and beyond while turning millions more into refugees.

Naturally, Cheney feels right at home with the administration that is arming the genocide in Gaza, relentlessly stoking nuclear war with Russa, China and Iran, and changing their party’s platform to remove opposition to torture.

**This endorsement is not an honor – it’s a warning bell.

[ I’m proud to say that zero war criminals have endorsed our campaign and _none_ would be welcome in our coalition. Will you donate to our campaign to make certain that every American has the opportunity to vote for the only anti-war, anti-genocide, pro-worker, pro-planet candidate on the ballot?](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=cheney_endorsement&n=4)**
---
| [](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=cheney_endorsement&n=5 "DONATE NOW") [DONATE NOW](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=cheney_endorsement&n=5)
---
There is nothing more unifying to Democrats and Republicans than war. Conservatives like Cheney are dumping Trump and embracing Harris because they _can’t control_ a malignant self-serving narcissist like Donald Trump.

But they can count on Democrats to fund their favorite wars and cheer on a genocide committed with American bombs.

The two major parties have become fused into a single beast that serves Wall Street and warmongers.

It’s time the rest of us united behind the party that serves humanity. **[Please consider a donation today](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=cheney_endorsement&n=6)** , and then share this message with your friends and family to encourage everyone to VOTE GREEN this November.

In solidarity,

Jill

_*Sent in support of Ruben Gallego for Arizona and Lucas Kunce for U.S. Senate*_

## For Tuesday’s debate, keep in mind it’s now about Pennsylvania and soccer moms
---
|
---
#### [View original post](https://a1e0.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=66de4d91595c9d0568284b2a&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.mainstreamrevolution.com%2Fblog%2Fwtf-just-happened%3Fss_source%3Dsscampaigns%26ss_campaign_id%3D66de18c7fa72a662d501bd1e%26ss_email_id%3D66de4d91595c9d0568284b2a%26ss_campaign_name%3DDuring%2Bdebate%252C%2Bremember%2Bit%25E2%2580%2599s%2B%2Babout%2BPennsylvania%2Band%2Bsoccer%2Bmoms%26ss_campaign_sent_date%3D2024-09-09T01%253A21%253A48Z&w=6619ff0a31aa07375378c596&c=b_66de18c7fa72a662d501bd1e&l=en-US&s=6f7drA4Zc7MuGiMb0vxsN-ulEcI%3D)
---
I told my kids, in 40 years of being a political junkie, I’ve never seen the following recent events in any Presidential election over the last 60 days:
* July 21 – President Biden drops out, endorses Vice President Kamala Harris
* July 13 - Attempted assassination of former President Trump in Butler, PA

### **It’s now about Midwestern swing states**
Pennsylvania (19 electoral votes), Michigan (15) and Wisconsin (10) – called the “Blue Wall” in the 2020 election of 44 electoral votes. I’ve been in Michigan every July for almost 25 years as my wife, Julie, grew up in Western Michigan.
#### Midwesterners were ignored by both party establishments when manufacturing jobs were outsourced to China under global trade, followed by the opioid epidemic after the Great Recession
The VP picks were selected to help win the Midwestern swing states: Ohio Senator JD Vance and Minnesota Gov. Tim Walz
### **And key swing voters - college-educated suburban women**
VP Kamala Harris will make reproductive rights a key issue to convince college-educated suburban women, a huge swing voter group, known as “soccer moms” then “security moms” after 9/11. Trump will try to convince soccer moms over rising crime, border and national security.
#### So what’s next?
It’s so important to reach out across the aisle and forge consensus on the policies that will fix the problems facing our nation. But I’m afraid the election will only become a shouting match.
---

name: Heidi Ganahl
subject: Sunday News Digest: 9/8/2024
body:
Leadership failures to blame for Tren de Aragua flourishing in Aurora, Fabbricatore says
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**September 8, 2024** **SUNDAY NEWS DIGEST** **By Heidi Ganahl**
| | Dear Readers,
Before we dive into today's topic of discussion, I want to formally invite you to a super fun rally I'm speaking at alongside Lauren Boebert a week from today at Wide Open Saloon in Sedalia, CO! We’ll have great music, drinks, food, and FUN! **[Register for free here!](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
Now into the news. As I'm sure you've probably noticed, gang violence in Colorado's Aurora suburb has taken over national news this week with even [Trump commenting](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) on the matter.
A lack of leadership exists within City Hall administration and at the police department, and it can be credited for the growth in activity by Venezuelan prison gang Tren de Aragua in the City of Aurora, former regional ICE Director John Fabbricatore said Friday during a City Hall roundtable.
Fabbricatore, who holds the Republican nomination for the 6th District seat in the U.S. House, was joined at the roundtable by two members of the Aurora City Council, two members of U.S. Congress, former federal ICE Director Tom Homan, state representatives and senators, a county commissioner and four residents of Aurora. Missing were any member of management from City Hall or the police department.
“Aurora has been underserved by their leadership in the police department,” Fabbricatore said. “I’m hoping, with the hiring of the new police chief, that we’re going to have a police chief that comes in and lets the Aurora [Police Department] do their job, and stop the crime that’s being committed in our community.”
The roundtable, directed by U.S. Reps. Lauren Boebert and Chip Roy, was described as a fact-finding, listening session. Those in attendance heard from a former resident of an apartment complex where the gang took over. She claimed to have been on a first-name basis with 911 after calling daily to report illegal or threatening activity.
“The [interim] police chief [Heather Morris] is not going to show up here,” Fabbricatore said. “I’m not trying to tarnish her reputation; it is already tarnished. She dropped the ball on this. Art Acevedo, when he left in January, dropped the ball on this.”
Fabbricatore has often interrupted his campaign for a seat in Congress to use his Twitter/X account as a tip line, where often someone provides a tip and he does the verification. He is one who first identified the activity of Tren de Aragua in Aurora, later [verified by an Aurora police press release](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) on Aug. 29.
“We need the right kind of leaders and we don’t have that right now, including the city manager,” Fabbricatore said. “The city manager has been non-existent. No one is here [at the roundtable] from city management.”

# [The presidential race is about populism vs. the establishment, not D vs. R.](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=111730&post_id=148668062&utm_source=post-email-title&utm_campaign=email-post-title&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTQ4NjY4MDYyLCJpYXQiOjE3MjU4NjM4NzgsImV4cCI6MTcyODQ1NTg3OCwiaXNzIjoicHViLTExMTczMCIsInN1YiI6InBvc3QtcmVhY3Rpb24ifQ.Lpsahim5wnRmXY5_4-tNTYMP5I1H8xa-YcDmL5A4ZYE)
### Once you notice this, everything makes more sense. And it may even affect how you vote.
| | [Aditya Pai](https://substack.com/@adityapai)

Some friends recently have asked me, how could Dick and Liz Cheney [endorse Harris](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/aeac35a4-aa94-4414-9840-da04ba0e2a10?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), though they oppose virtually all of her policy positions? And how could Tulsi Gabbard, who used to be a Democrat, and RFK Jr., scion of the most famous Democratic family in American history, [align with Trump](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/dfe6c295-677b-4c93-bc83-17c911e61242?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)?
**The answer is simple: the Cheneys and Harris are pro-establishment; Trump, Gabbard, and Kennedy are anti-establishment populists.**
[](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/bfef67cf-aa81-4286-9ffd-0214c65b4355?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
National politics today is governed by two axes (see above):
1. The X-axis: left vs. right.
2. The Y-axis: populism vs. the establishment

The X-axis gets all the explicit, conscious attention. But it misses most of what is actually going on right now. And, I promise you, it will not determine who becomes the next president of the United States.
Far more important is the implicit, subconscious Y-axis of American politics: anti-establishment vs pro-establishment sentiment. It drives the MAGA movement and much of what we have since in U.S. politics since 2015.
**What is 'the establishment'?**
**The establishment** is a school of thought, not a group of people. It is the philosophy that America's institutions are fundamentally trustworthy -- and work. That the government has your best interests at heart, and spends money well, so paying taxes is inherently good and spending -- especially defense spending -- is noble. That journalists are honest, decent, public-spirited and trying to tell you the truth.
Establishment thinkers believe the economy is doing well and Americans have never had a higher standard of living than we do today. Sure, America has poverty and serious problems; but Trump would destroy whatever good things we have going, and make our problems even _worse_ -- not better. We must support Israel and Ukraine in their hour of need in battles that are both necessary and just.
That is why, even if you are a Republican, you must set aside your policy differences and vote for Harris. Trump is an 'existential threat to democracy' and 'the post-WWII global order.' He is 'weird.' You should vote for democracy and for 'joy' because 'we are not going back.'
**What is 'populism'?**
**Populism** rejects all of these claims. Elections don't matter as much as you think, the populists say, because the donor class selects the candidates anyway; we live in an oligarchy (rule by wealthy elites), not a democracy (rule by the demos, or masses). That is why Bernie lost twice and Trump barely won once. And it is why the rich get richer while everyday Americans struggle to pay for groceries or buy a home.
After Korea, Vietnam, Iraq, Afghanistan, and 'the forever wars' now brewing in the Middle East and Ukraine, the populists argue, we must reject the notion that government spending - especially defense spending - is inherently noble.
The media deliberately lied to you by, first, claiming for years that a dementia-addled president was perfectly healthy, until he _visibly_ wasn't; and second, by telling you that democracy means nominating a historically unpopular vice-president who lost the 2019 Democratic primary, badly; has not earned a single vote for her 2024 nomination; and now hopes to be elected after doing 1 interview, 0 press conferences, and 1 debate.
Most of all, populists have zero trust in the federal government as constituted - and believe that career politicians in both parties are bought and paid for by corporations, foreign agents, and a 'globalist elite' who will always put America last. You should vote for Trump because he will 'put America first.'
**The real realignment**
This is a realignment election, but not along the X-axis of left vs. right / Democrat vs. Republican. It is not about guns, abortion, immigration, foreign wars, crime, inflation or any one policy issue, though they will all factor into the outcome. It is about where you fall on the Y-axis of American politics:
* If you believe (1) politics as practiced today is the _solution_ to America's problems, (2) we live in a _democracy_ (3) and Trump is a dangerous threat to it, you will eventually vote for Harris, whatever her obvious flaws. _You are an Establishment Thinker._
* If you believe (1) politics is the _problem,_ (2) we live in an _oligarchy, and_(3) Harris is its appointed puppet, then you will end up voting for Trump, despite the obvious risks. _You are an Anti-Establishment Thinker._
* And if you're uncertain about this question, then you are undecided, a third-party voter, or simply will not vote.

_**In any case, the most significant issue in this election is not related to policy, personality, or even the #vibes.**_
_**The number one issue in this election is your underlying attitude toward politics itself.**_

body:
| | | | BIG ANNOUNCEMENT
---
---
| Friends, We've all asked the following questions:
Is Virginia really a blue or purple state like we've been led to believe?
Will my vote for Donald J. Trump really count this time?
What can I do? What can we do to make sure we don't have a repeat of 2020?
I've dedicated the past 4 years to getting the answers to these questions, and have spearheaded an incredible team of professionals who have volunteered countless hours to assist in this effort.
Today, I'm releasing The Virginia Report, which is a culmination of over 4 years worth of sheer determination, commitment and hundreds of hours in getting to the bottom of what happened in 2020, right here in Virginia.
We've been told Virginia is a purple or blue state. I don't believe that. Once you read this report, you will be enlightened and encouraged.
While we have much work to do to clean up our elections here in Virginia, it can be done if leadership is forced to take election integrity seriously. "We the People" need to demand more from our representatives and make sure true election integrity is a top issue. For instance, we need to push for full forensic audits, not fake risk limiting audits.
The 2020 Presidential election was a pivotal year in which we experienced odd unexplainable anomalies, things we had not seen in prior elections. We could see the smoke, but we couldn't clearly identify the fire. When we tried to investigate and find the source of the fire, we were shut down.
Curious and loyal patriots who sincerely sought the truth were shut down through censorship, cancellation, political, professional, personal attacks meant to discredit and demean dissenting opinions.
Despite the strong opposition to seeking the truth, for the past 4 years I've worked with many legislators and grassroots leaders across the country to make sure your vote will count this time. I was shut down at every turn.
Because of a Democrat controlled Virginia Senate, little has been done legislatively.
When all failed legislatively, Governor Youngkin recently issued an executive order to address illegals voting in our Virginia elections, paper ballots and voting machines. The executive order can be read below.
Unfortunately, the executive order expires at the end of Governor Youngkin's 4 year term. We must elect legislators willing to tackle election integrity in the years to come.
The purpose of the Virginia Report is to educate and inform Virginians as to where we have issues and to address the issues locally.
In this report, 11 Virginia counties were thoroughly analyzed using the government's own data and statistics that are widely published and available to the public.
---
|
---
I urge you to read the report below. It will be well worth your time as you view the heat maps highlighting 11 Virginia counties and precincts.
Did you know the U.S. Department of Homeland Security under the guise of CIS Center for Internet Securities has installed Albert Sensors to monitor and interfere with our state elections?
That's right. The Federal Government has the ability to monitor and interfere in our elections in real time. And they are. Whether it be access to poll pads, voter registration, election office networks, polling locations or voter tabulation systems, without detection.
Did you know that we had ballot trafficking rings right here in Virginia? Northern Virginia, the Richmond area and the Newport News areas were all primary targets.
Did you know that in Virginia, it is roughly estimated that there may have been 760,000 illegal votes?
Once again, please click on the link below to read the entire report.
We need to encourage our local board of supervisors to go to hand counts of our paper ballots. Several counties have already successfully done so.
Citizens are canvassing their neighborhoods and reporting voters who don't live at the said address.
Now that more and more Virginians are becoming aware of what happened in 2020, we have made great strides for a more secure 2024 election. But more still needs to be done.
Fair, transparent elections are the foundation of a Constitutional Republic.

clean_body: | | | | BIG ANNOUNCEMENT | Friends, We've all asked the following questions: Is Virginia really a blue or purple state like we've been led to believe? Will my vote for Donald J. Trump really count this time? What can I do? What can we do to make sure we don't have a repeat of 2020? I've dedicated the past 4 years to getting the answers to these questions, and have spearheaded an incredible team of professionals who have volunteered countless hours to assist in this effort. Today, I'm releasing The Virginia Report, which is a culmination of over 4 years worth of sheer determination, commitment and hundreds of hours in getting to the bottom of what happened in 2020, right here in Virginia. We've been told Virginia is a purple or blue state. I don't believe that. Once you read this report, you will be enlightened and encouraged. While we have much work to do to clean up our elections here in Virginia, it can be done if leadership is forced to take election integrity seriously. "We the People" need to demand more from our representatives and make sure true election integrity is a top issue. For instance, we need to push for full forensic audits, not fake risk limiting audits. The 2020 Presidential election was a pivotal year in which we experienced odd unexplainable anomalies, things we had not seen in prior elections. We could see the smoke, but we couldn't clearly identify the fire. When we tried to investigate and find the source of the fire, we were shut down. Curious and loyal patriots who sincerely sought the truth were shut down through censorship, cancellation, political, professional, personal attacks meant to discredit and demean dissenting opinions. Despite the strong opposition to seeking the truth, for the past 4 years I've worked with many legislators and grassroots leaders across the country to make sure your vote will count this time. I was shut down at every turn. Because of a Democrat controlled Virginia Senate, little has been done legislatively. When all failed legislatively, Governor Youngkin recently issued an executive order to address illegals voting in our Virginia elections, paper ballots and voting machines. The executive order can be read below. Unfortunately, the executive order expires at the end of Governor Youngkin's 4 year term. We must elect legislators willing to tackle election integrity in the years to come. The purpose of the Virginia Report is to educate and inform Virginians as to where we have issues and to address the issues locally. In this report, 11 Virginia counties were thoroughly analyzed using the government's own data and statistics that are widely published and available to the public. | I urge you to read the report below. It will be well worth your time as you view the heat maps highlighting 11 Virginia counties and precincts. Did you know the U.S. Department of Homeland Security under the guise of CIS Center for Internet Securities has installed Albert Sensors to monitor and interfere with our state elections? That's right. The Federal Government has the ability to monitor and interfere in our elections in real time. And they are. Whether it be access to poll pads, voter registration, election office networks, polling locations or voter tabulation systems, without detection. Did you know that we had ballot trafficking rings right here in Virginia? Northern Virginia, the Richmond area and the Newport News areas were all primary targets. Did you know that in Virginia, it is roughly estimated that there may have been 760,000 illegal votes? Once again, please click on the link below to read the entire report. We need to encourage our local board of supervisors to go to hand counts of our paper ballots. Several counties have already successfully done so. Citizens are canvassing their neighborhoods and reporting voters who don't live at the said address. Now that more and more Virginians are becoming aware of what happened in 2020, we have made great strides for a more secure 2024 election. But more still needs to be done. We’ll work with anyone to get the job done for our constituents.** And we’ll always stand up to the special interests in Washington to help folks back home. subject: Money in Politics
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Robertson for Congress ***Mark Robertson retired from the Army
body: This may make you mad. Money in Politics By Mark Robertson, Candidate for Nevada's First Congressional District Hello Peter, Money can buy power, and power can corrupt. Nearly everyone agrees that there is too much money in politics. Both parties have contributed to the problem. Can anything be done to fix it? In this edition of the Monday Memo, I explain some issues, the results, and the solutions surrounding money in politics. Issue #1: Outside money buys influence with elected officials. The Problem: During this election cycle, less than 15% of donations to Dina Titus came from Nevadans; the remaining 85+ % came from Lobbyists, PACs, and individuals and organizations outside of Nevada. In contrast, 89% of contributions to my campaign came from the people of Nevada. The Results: Dina Titus doesn’t represent the people of her district. She represents the big-money interest of her wealthy donors. Titus is not alone in this regard; most elected officials receive significant donations from outside their districts. The Solution: We need to pass a law requiring candidates for public office to accept donations only from people who can vote for them. This will ensure that elected officials truly represent the people of their district. Issue #2: Elected officials use government spending to buy votes. The Problem: Whether it is canceling student debt, exempting tips from taxes, pork projects, or government grants to special interest groups, politicians have learned they can buy votes by borrowing, printing, and spending money we don’t have. This is a bipartisan problem with big spenders on both sides of the aisle. The Results: Our nation is more than $35,000,000,000,000 in debt and growing every minute. Each day, the federal government prints, borrows, and spends $5.2 billion more than it takes in. The interest alone is $2.6 billion a day. Dina Titus is not solely responsible for the debt; however, since she entered Congress, the national debt has nearly tripled. The Solution: We need to pass a law that says incumbents cannot run for reelection in any election cycle in which the government spent more money than it brought in. Issue #3: Elected officials spend too much time raising money and not enough serving constituents. The Problem: Members of Congress from each party are expected to raise money for their party and their reelection. Republican and Democrat parties own buildings on Capitol Hill where members go to “dial for dollars.” Plum committee assignments are doled to the members who raise the most money. The Results: Our congressional committees may not comprise the most qualified members but rather the most prolific fundraisers. For example, with 30 years of experience in the military and 20 years in financial services, you might think I would be selected for the House Armed Services or Financial Services Committees. However, these are highly sought-after committees, and thus, party leaders reserve these assignments for members who raise the most money. Committee chairmanships are doled out the same way. The Solution: We need to select committee members according to merit and qualifications. Fundraising should not play a role in committee selection. I’m running for Congress to change the direction our country is headed. We cannot afford to continue to spend money we don’t have. I will join other fiscal conservatives to fight the big spenders in both parties. Dina Titus has been part of the problem for far too long. It doesn’t make sense to expect the people who created these problems to now fix them. It is time for a change! clean_body: This may make you mad. Money in Politics By Mark Robertson, Candidate for Nevada's First Congressional District Hello Peter, Money can buy power, and power can corrupt. Nearly everyone agrees that there is too much money in politics. Both parties have contributed to the problem. Can anything be done to fix it? In this edition of the Monday Memo, I explain some issues, the results, and the solutions surrounding money in politics. Issue #1: Outside money buys influence with elected officials. The Problem: During this election cycle, less than 15% of donations to Dina Titus came from Nevadans; the remaining 85+ % came from Lobbyists, PACs, and individuals and organizations outside of Nevada. In contrast, 89% of contributions to my campaign came from the people of Nevada. The Results: Dina Titus doesn’t represent the people of her district. She represents the big-money interest of her wealthy donors. Titus is not alone in this regard; most elected officials receive significant donations from outside their districts. The Solution: We need to pass a law requiring candidates for public office to accept donations only from people who can vote for them. This will ensure that elected officials truly represent the people of their district. Issue #2: Elected officials use government spending to buy votes. The Problem: Whether it is canceling student debt, exempting tips from taxes, pork projects, or government grants to special interest groups, politicians have learned they can buy votes by borrowing, printing, and spending money we don’t have. This is a bipartisan problem with big spenders on both sides of the aisle. The Results: Our nation is more than $35,000,000,000,000 in debt and growing every minute. Each day, the federal government prints, borrows, and spends $5.2 billion more than it takes in. The interest alone is $2.6 billion a day. Dina Titus is not solely responsible for the debt; however, since she entered Congress, the national debt has nearly tripled. The Solution: We need to pass a law that says incumbents cannot run for reelection in any election cycle in which the government spent more money than it brought in. Issue #3: Elected officials spend too much time raising money and not enough serving constituents. The Problem: Members of Congress from each party are expected to raise money for their party and their reelection. Republican and Democrat parties own buildings on Capitol Hill where members go to “dial for dollars.” Plum committee assignments are doled to the members who raise the most money. The Results: Our congressional committees may not comprise the most qualified members but rather the most prolific fundraisers. For example, with 30 years of experience in the military and 20 years in financial services, you might think I would be selected for the House Armed Services or Financial Services Committees. However, these are highly sought-after committees, and thus, party leaders reserve these assignments for members who raise the most money. Committee chairmanships are doled out the same way. The Solution: We need to select committee members according to merit and qualifications. Fundraising should not play a role in committee selection. I’m running for Congress to change the direction our country is headed. We cannot afford to continue to spend money we don’t have. I will join other fiscal conservatives to fight the big spenders in both parties. Dina Titus has been part of the problem for far too long. It doesn’t make sense to expect the people who created these problems to now fix them. It is time for a change! [](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gijgll-duchtdja-y/) **[So, will you please make your most generous contribution in the amount of $75.60, $56.70, $37.80, or even $18.90 to help us distribute our yard signs in Florida](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gijgll-duchtdja-j/)?**

If passed, Florida’s referendum would:

• Overturn the _Heartbeat Abortion Prevention Law,_ which currently prohibits abortions after six weeks of a pregnancy – the only thing stopping Florida from becoming the abortion destination of the South;

• Legalize abortion, for any reason, through at least six months of a pregnancy;

• Allow for “health” abortions – which would allow for things like 'sadness _(mental health)_ about being pregnant' as a reason to obtain a legal abortion at any stage. This would effectively mean Florida would be no different than states that allow abortion up until birth;

• Allow abortionists to commit abortions on minors WITHOUT parental consent, which is an assault on parents' rights _and_ opens up minors to abuse situations.
Pro-Life Friend, Florida is our best chance at winning simply because we have a pro-life Governor in Ron DeSantis who is fighting with us – instead of remaining silent.

For months now, we’ve had teams on the ground knocking on doors.

But this new yard sign effort is going to be a critical complement to our other efforts – much like our Ballot Referendum Kits, Digital Advertising, and Postcards Campaigns — to educate voters and get them to hear directly from our students who are out in their town!

With these materials, out student activists are being deployed in Florida and across the country to:

[](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gijgll-duchtdja-t/) **● _CONDUCT GRASSROOTS TRAININGS_** – where we train new young activists so they can start making an impact, effectively knock on doors, make phone calls, and stay in the fight for years to come;

**● _RAMP UP DOOR-TO-DOOR CANVASSING_** – where our students will personally knock on hundreds of thousands of doors and even collaborate with homeschool groups and church communities to expand our reach;

**● _HOLD EARLY VOTER AND VOTER REGISTRATION EVENTS_** – where we target ideal voter bases like mega-churches, church conferences, and Christian college campuses to beat the Left to the punch on early voting;

**● _EXPAND OUR ON-CAMPUS OUTREACH_** – where we’ll host campus voter rallies and educational displays, recruit volunteers, organize door-to-door canvassing deployments, and even bus pro-life voters to the polls who don’t have a ride; and

**● _RUN NON-STOP PHONE BANKS AND TEXTING PROGRAMS_** – where we’ll conduct peer-to-peer text messaging and phone calls which are a must in any effective Get-Out-The-Vote programs.
Studies show yard signs are "social proof" that help sway voters' opinions – not to mention remind like-minded voters to vote Pro-Life on their upcoming ballots.

But only with your help can we distribute our pro-life yard signs like the one you see above in Florida and other Battleground States across the nation!

**[A contribution of $113.40 will put a sign in the yards of 30 homes](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gijgll-duchtdja-i/);**

**[A contribution of $75.60 will put a sign in the yards of 20 homes](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gijgll-duchtdja-d/);**

**[A contribution of $56.70 will put a sign in the yards of 15 homes](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gijgll-duchtdja-h/);**

**[A contribution of $37.80 will put a sign in the yards of 10 homes](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gijgll-duchtdja-k/); and**

**[A contribution of $18.90 will put a sign in the yards of 5 homes](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gijgll-duchtdja-u/)!**

The cost to print and ship yard signs is more than you’d think; even I was shocked when I saw the quotes!

But time is running out and I’m afraid we’ll fall short come November without your support.

With early voting in some states beginning in September, there’s no time to waste!

Thank you for everything you do for Life.

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, _Students for Life Action_

P.S. – Learn more about your state's pro-abortion Ballot Initiative by visiting **[abortionballot.com](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gijgll-duchtdja-o/).**

At our first-ever Believers Summit in West Palm Beach, Florida, we were blessed to welcome over 3,000 believers. ## $30 Million Tax Refund Fraud Ring Sentenced
Seven people--six from Texas--have been sentenced for their involvement in a $30 million [stolen identity tax refund scheme](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJxskDHTnCAUAH8Nds9BwFMKijR2lzalg_A4mSA68E69f5-51F-9xe7sn-f8tDHF_PptNzR0h322juKJswYNQs2q8WbhXncNmm4Q_TgqxUWzml5aLofF4WPocQlBuVFyOzohfZB68U00ggvFNdcd7x9St4qrbhxscG4cdddxpjj6SHtpaUXC29aQPvuJpXX71iSzEh2VyV9MTExM13W1f2-bv5CJKeNVmZhciRsyMVU8sdgEB-5HQqiYCbNDDzFDpT1hhugxU6QPkL2hYHhnD9WtuCHQagk8hmLfHj3QihBLhT2A5F9ZU4w_rphSrI-BKf7abEz_K-nnZ6cR_wIAAP__jmVxmg) in which they posed as authorized agents for taxpayers and directed the IRS to send fraudulent refunds to prepaid debit cards. The perpetrators filed over [370 fraudulent tax returns](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJxskD2PhCAUAH8NdhhAXKGguMZur73SIDzWlyAYefv17y979ZWTTDGZn-ty9Zix3L79Do5eqS4-ED5gsdxypRfdRbeKaGUHTk5qNEZrobrNDaNR67rGNVzsKkOCabQp6dEb4wPooUOnhNLCCivFeBlsr4WWZvIpBGOslIJpARGpnj1tQPDyLeV3fcDZh7p32W1ER2PDF1MzU_O9HTUjYWg9YCnwbB-Nqfk4lw8xNU9aamWGSTE1Z_ARTl4Tb_XYsBEGTxB5o5qhcIxQCOnNyb_4CeleIm9hgx14g0JQAsTudPF4Ys7YLhPT4rZ7zH9t9P-ph1O_AQAA__8WQ25B), using the money to purchase designer clothing, home renovation materials, and used cars at auction. They laundered the proceeds through money orders. The ringleader, [Abraham Yusuff of Round Rock](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFyhCAUQNGvwQ4HkBUoKNLYbdqUDsJjJYPiwFvd_ftMUqe_xZ3zdZ_vLuW0Pz7dBhZfsczOYzphNtRQIWfZBbuwYHgHlitx01pKJrrVeoijVuFmmFqi4tFF6RcRhiGokesldskKJiQzzHB2GwfTSya5Vi56r7XhnBHJICQstccVEF6uxfwuJ9Tel63LdkU8Ghk-iJiImK7r6r-fDZOH_lFOIqZyOCKmoxIxZXABKm3lWNNv4hACbVgy7DQF2DHhm6J70QrxuQfa_Aob0AY7wu4hdNWG40o5pzYqItljcyn_beD_KKcVPwEAAP__iIpngg), was sentenced to 14 years in prison and ordered to pay over $30 million in restitution.
## Paxton Sues For Access to Abortion Records
Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton has [sued the Biden administration](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJxskLGOwyAQRL_G7oiWZY2hoLgmXa690loDTpBIsDDnJH9_currZjTS6On9XKYLp5we12--R9deS5nYt7THyQorkCbqg5shWNlHJ0ccjCEC7G8ONYLXRs8YIYCFURpJngdFQ2DP1CeHgAQWrIRBK3siIGlGXrw3xkoJHUEMqZV6arfY4ou3Jb_LHuvJl3uf3a21devUV4fnDs-8PuJzO6aj1JZ8jkeaS22pPMRa087-LWr0pYZNfA5F5uf2m5qww0hh0YNhpZTm2XBA45VkXEZrUPbVhfWZck6bHjuC651T_nC0_63sDv8CAAD__wd_Yzo) over a federal rule that restricts access to the medical records of women who cross state lines for abortions, claiming the rule undermines the state's law enforcement capabilities. Finalized in April, the rule is an update to the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act of 1996, which [prohibits the release](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJxskDFvwyAQhX8NbERwPmIYGLp4S9eOFjaX-CRsIkyd5N9XzVap25Pe0_uk7-syXiJn3m6fcaXQntcyxrnxQaNXXgGOKFOYdPJGUjA9WOcQNcglIPZdnJ2zaCdrTercFKmnLhmYEiFIDqABtdfeaHvu_Ak1GtfH6zw7543RAjUlbqWe2kKNnnG_5lc5qJ7mssocltbuu-g-BAwChrbQwjn_dgKGpay00WMXMMS08sZ7q7Fx2QQM6M5WY6fel2riRJv6O1JxKvUd7pWPOL9U_c4kYJA1pPuDc-b93AvUtzXyGynb_3KOAD8BAAD__8AYaH4) of medical information about patients but provides exceptions for law enforcement investigations. A group of Republican attorneys general [opposed the update](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJxskLGO8yAQhJ8Gd1hA1rEpKP7GXf72SguzS4KEQwSbOPf2J0e67sr5Rp80mq_LcvEpp_v1v9_I8TuWxQdOL1qstNLAAh26VaHVHTk9mmGaAJTpbk7bgDrAgKtaCTycdRwGE0c8-UgYsUvOKAPKKqvVcD7ZHhToafQxhGmyWisBijBxqT3fiOntW8zf5UW1D2XrsrsxP5o4_RNmFmbe970Pa7vT3o5emPmjCDMf6DfK7Pf2TCwjIVWfZX1mko9amAI3uRGmcFAKpWKTfi2VU7kfflcdPvaUc2rnUYC6bj7lzxT--5iXMz8BAAD__2e8aPs) when it was proposed last year, saying it interfered with their states' authority to enforce abortion restrictions. Texas' abortion ban exempts women from criminal charges but punishes those assisting with up to life imprisonment.
## Texas Civil War Museum to Close, Sell Artifacts
The Texas Civil War Museum in White Settlement, a Fort Worth suburb, [will close permanently](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJxskLGuozAQRb_GdEZmsMEuXGxDl223RIM9DpZMiGCCs3__lNSvusWVjo7Ov9t8w1zy4_4XN_L8TvuMgfNFs5NOgp51E_2iousa8t0IxlqtFTSrR0IFTneq16Y3iwnBGogmLb2xKaq-yR4UaOWU65QZetdqpTs7YgrBWtd1SmhFMfN-tLwS0xvPVP7vFx1t2Lem-JX5eYr-j4BJwFRrbWtC_JwCJjw4h0ICppLTZ74AGfKVi6x4yO110muToewnybpmJnkSc6GNHizTfrCs-8GrgAnsKIcxAMQF5aBxlNoEJ9HGIAMlRGdsGNLYHD4-ay4ln8MotLpvmMtXln9Pd3n4CQAA___TDXAs) on Oct. 31 after 18 years in operation, citing a decision by the family owners and board of directors. The museum, which houses [the largest collection](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJxskL2uozAQRp_GdIPGjvlx4SINW2XbLZGBcbBkIGtPcPL2V0l9q6_4pKOj8-823lyIYb__dRtZfvljdDOHk0YDBpQedbXYCRcjK7KyU03fa42qWq1H6iUt2LReeymnZpL6gv3U6kYqP2EVrEKl0aCR2LQXU2vUsu-cn-e-N1Ki0EhL4CPVvBLTy2Uf38dJqZ6PrYp2ZX5kcbkKNQg1lFLqLe-fT6iBdnhmoYadymcOXikJNXwpMIczRCguwfbM9NyAD5jjkQmcZ0ogO3iTSxnCDmUNTJCJOdJGOws1uATXq_zv_qCpkl0eJcQYctsJjffNhfjV499jnVb9BAAA___y-mzK) of Civil War artifacts west of the Mississippi, announced that its building has been sold, and most artifacts will be transferred to The Horse Soldier Antiques in Gettysburg, PA. Owned by North Texas oilman Ray Richey and his wife Judy, the 15,500-square-foot museum has faced criticism for "presenting an unbalanced view" of Civil War history.

They don’t want you to see the level of complete chaos unfolding: illegal crossings at record highs, deadly fentanyl pouring into our communities, and cartel violence running rampant. And who’s responsible? Vice President Kamala Harris, the so-called "border czar" who’s been AWOL since day one. If the mainstream media won’t say it, I will...

Vice President Harris was put in charge of the border, and what has she done? Nothing but make the problem worse. This dadgum crisis is getting [Americans killed](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=1aa34e673c5d4825b9e02f52957fb837&_e=1R9nPnvk5E8gCTR1uxr_yjsMp5mtoAX2HmAaeAESvVnj4NRk0R8DLN_p8LdK5h5DbzaMUicFp8BuQ_pSPB2PEfFqyCfjASjRy4YjxERanlnkTCxARgk3JgoZkYDMcGqjM_ZklQMysNaOCn86eUBGcOc7eO-5gjWmtbQKG-s_WYZPHB-tD6LTn3DtxLuRltekGB2Fo0VbHqbALwgnO_gkkwje7S0s25ZN8FPQeeseUHQ%3D), and yet she’s bopping around the campaign trail without a worry in the world. The media won’t report it because they’re too busy protecting this administration. They want you to believe everything is fine. Well, we know the truth—our [communities are suffering](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=1aa34e673c5d4825b9e02f52957fb837&_e=1R9nPnvk5E8gCTR1uxr_yjsMp5mtoAX2HmAaeAESvVlpkHF6Kq95VBsVaZmNWMZ804JtWOFgglnZSVpjUMRN5OIfm_WSe_F6Zonz7dMNGQS6kYIbAqBXNdx6Bj8HSQhGJAd-WEZ1yr8aNm-V-s7Y4hIBUTNJIFh8DApH72tslYssARmNVN3vy31vim18DjN0t2GbNVfHMQwJwF9YQ1zO24wIuDMNjZqlKuQGP-5cuQJD9Uaipg3GvPqWICRWIwS-8trLe-u2jI5Gf2-Gtl2OPnkc0j2sVZBGZy7CWRJCZomk0On1vgf4A_FdfKZ09mqANWVxUS3KE5wRCG1EI03xaA%3D%3D) while Vice President Harris plays politics. Can you think of a more complete betrayal of the American people? Biden handed over the keys, and she’s [driven us](http://links.burchettforcongress.com/u/click?_t=feefb5ad83f24ba4b99ac997c1b47e86&_m=1aa34e673c5d4825b9e02f52957fb837&_e=1R9nPnvk5E8gCTR1uxr_yjsMp5mtoAX2HmAaeAESvVnCe9vAYiNhZ711MbCDwWv-4MdV5mQgRZvp60JOPaK7fsqYBxtlYnH2LMbGNnJUC6J5LjUVzU9-LWBzEBhsE56X9YjSEq7Xbk5FyB-ZLxqd1fLf0q-m9w0g01G1QnwQ-4pZCR2FyajNxE4eBcijt3EW2YpSz0jAaS0419AqTjE9-dmKst3XQoK2wCk8cEHm9FubKbDnv9Q6pfSIsqNWg94QGvO6QjlGZAdf6d39IGhrBop_wFs4FoxU_QeYWJ72eMbV8RsuD1YP03Gj_muRhOlXgbXXk-aE1J2sX3aGDG7jUg%3D%3D) straight into chaos. The mainstream media is complicit in this cover-up, refusing to show the real devastation happening at the border. But I won’t stay silent, friend. I’m calling for accountability. Vice President Kamala Harris needs to own up to her failures and fix it as border czar. The American people deserve leaders who will secure the border, not sit back while the crisis worsens. We’ve had enough. The media can lie all they want, but we see the truth—and it’s time to take a stand.

# [ABC now says it won't commit to fact-checking Trump in debate. Tell them they must.](https://default.salsalabs.org/T100766a7-365a-42bf-99d9-84a16e146d41/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

---
| | | And just like that, [ABC News is now saying](https://default.salsalabs.org/T44dffe76-3bfc-4726-9928-c5230141a487/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) it won't commit to fact-checking the presidential debate and calling out lies in real time. The network is deploying weasel language to avoid responsibility: _" We're not making a commitment to fact-check everything, or fact-check nothing, in either direction. We're there to keep a conversation going, and to facilitate a good solid debate, and that entails a lot of things in terms of asking questions, moving the conversation along, making sure that it's civilized." ([NYT](https://default.salsalabs.org/T93c040fe-717b-407b-93ac-9e1b25ba9acc/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9))_ **It's a presidential debate, not a tea party. The point is not to be civilized, it's to determine which candidate should be the leader of the free world.** What's the point of having moderators if they're just going to sit there and do nothing when a candidate tells lie after lie after lie?

[**ABC needs to reverse its decision and commit to calling out obvious lies in real time. Add your name, and tell them to do it.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T29816870-bcc6-45d6-884d-f3010551f8a8/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

---
September 10, 2024
You would think the pro-choice movement in Connecticut would be satisfied. Afterall, they are so powerful that any candidate who is pro-life gets slaughtered at the polls. Public opinion polls strongly support abortion rights, and every major Connecticut politician follows suit.
Yet, the pro-choice movement is never happy. Thus, they attempted to obtain legislative approval to force health care professionals to participate in abortions and permit abortionists to allow a baby to die when a failed abortion attempt results in a live baby. But even this was too much for Connecticut politicians.
Thus, the pro-choice movement is trying to bypass the legislative process by having the Department of Public Health (DPH) bureaucrats [rewrite the law](https://substack.com/redirect/43c87c7e-cd71-42ce-9a2c-ce901c74e5c6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
One change the pro-choice movement proposed was eliminating the following sentence in the [abortion statute:](https://substack.com/redirect/43c87c7e-cd71-42ce-9a2c-ce901c74e5c6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
"No person shall be required to participate in any phase of an abortion that violates the provider's judgment, philosophical, moral or religious beliefs."
But why is this necessary? Planned Parenthood (who performs the vast majority of abortions in Connecticut), has clinics all over the state. The logical reason is that the pro-choice movement cannot find enough personnel to participate in this gruesome procedure.
After the Dobbs decision (overturning Roe vs Wade), the Connecticut legislature responded by affirming abortion rights and allowing midwives, physician assistants and nurse practitioners to perform abortions.
What was fascinating about this was that the medical establishment voiced no objection. In general, physicians strongly object when non-physicians impinge on their turf, especially in performing a surgical procedure. Non-physician abortionists are not trained to handle a hemorrhaging uterus, a sudden drop in blood pressure, heart arrhythmias along with the dozens of other complications that can occur during an abortion. Physician abortionists are.
Yet when the Connecticut legislature proposed this, the medical establishment responded: "Be our guest."
Why? Because the vast majority of obstetricians - even those who support abortion rights - want nothing to do with abortions.
This [document](https://substack.com/redirect/43c87c7e-cd71-42ce-9a2c-ce901c74e5c6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) also has the following language:
"Abortions performed after the second trimester shall be performed only in a licensed hospital or licensed ambulatory surgery center."
The following language is to be removed:
"If the newborn shows signs of life following an abortion, those appropriate measures used support life in a premature infant shall be employed."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d79edccc-bda6-4182-a84d-6c44139c5426?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
A Newborn Baby
In other words, the pro-choice movement wants to legalize allowing a live baby to die if the abortion is unsuccessful.
Third trimester abortions are technically difficult, even for the skilled abortionist. The unborn child must be visualized with ultrasound and chopped apart with a scalpel. The head must be crushed with forceps. As the neurological system is developed at this point, the unborn child feels pain and thrashes around the uterus until death.

The dismembered parts are then removed through the dilated cervix and a nurse with a strong stomach must rearrange the parts into a macabre jigsaw puzzle. Finding a nurse willing to do this is one of the reasons the pro-choice movement wants to force health care professionals to participate in abortions.
Another method is to visualize the unborn child under ultrasound and inject a hypertonic potassium solution into the heart. But this too is technically difficult. The unborn child is going to naturally try to avoid the needle.
Thus, either technique can occasionally result in a live birth. As killing a baby is still illegal in Connecticut (at least for the time being), the DPH and pro-choice movement want to allow the baby to die by natural causes.
But how will this happen? If the baby is maimed by the procedure, perhaps the baby will be set aside howling while the hospital personal ignore her as she bleeds to death. But a healthy baby will have to be allowed to starve to death or placed in a plastic waste bag to suffocate.
Perhaps a more humane approach will be to allow the abortionist to pith the baby - that is severe her cord with trocar (a hollow miniature spear) or use the technique midwives in China used when an unwanted female child was born - drown the baby in a bucket of water.
Afterall, primitive cultures threw unwanted babies into volcanos or fires resulting in a painful but at least quick death. The pro-choice movement and the abortionists should have no problem advocating giving these poor unwanted babies the same treatment.

Thus, either technique can occasionally result in a live birth. As killing a baby is still illegal in Connecticut (at least for the time being), the DPH and pro-choice movement want to allow the baby to die by natural causes.

name: Jenny Beth Martin, Tea Party Patriots Citizens Fund
subject: Introducing the 8-Week Plan to Get Out The Vote through Election Day
body:
It’s time to roll up your sleeves and get into the issues that impact this election
| | | |
---
|
---
| Patriot-

---
| **************** There is no time like the present to get involved in the upcoming election, which is why we are introducing an 8-Week Plan to Get Out The Vote for Donald Trump. We are calling on you, concerned citizens, to take the power that the Constitution places in your hands and take back America.
This 8-Week Plan gives you the information and background materials to educate undecided voters about critical issues facing our nation - and we will tackle those issues for you one week at a time leading into the November 5, election.
Each week we will introduce you to a topic that is, or should be, important to voters and provide you with necessary information so that you can make a plan and take action to inform and educate others all the way to Election Day.
**Starting today, the next 8-Weeks ' topics will be**:
1. Kamala Quiz: do you really know her?
2. Only Citizens Vote
3. Big Government Socialism
4. Parents: taking power back
5. America Safe: Crime; Israel and Iran - avoiding WWIII
6. Economy and Inflation
7. Border Security
8. Kamala Quiz - in case voters forget, we'll tell them again
Each week you have the opportunity to participate in a Get Out The Vote activity that could change the course of the election:
* **Sunday** : Plan your week: Goal is to meet with your team and make a plan #plantowin.
* **Monday** : Write letters to editors and social media posts about the weekly issue.
* **Tuesday** : Phone banking and relational outreach #takeactiontuesday.
* **Wednesday** : Write those postcards!
* **Thursday** : House Party: invite your friends and family to become familiar with the weekly issue.
* **Friday** : Organize a sign-waving event: tell the residents where you live about the weekly issue.
* **Saturday** : Attend a door knocking event of your choice with one of our many partners.
You start now!

**This week 's topic is the [Kamala Quiz: Do You Really Know Her?](https://qcgp-cmpzourl.maillist-manage.com/click/1edb9794a4ef5f13/1edb9794a4ec6db9 "Kamala Quiz: Do You Really Know Her?")** We have created a 5 question quiz that you can use to help voters understand exactly who Vice President Kamala Harris is and her radical agenda. Use hashtag #KamalaQuiz when posting online. __******** **__****__**

body:

---
| | | | [](http://trk.faithandlibertymail._c291cmNlX2NvZGU9RkFMUjU0NTc1In0/msMr-UPG6xvalP8kqAxsoA)
---
Fellow American, _We can't let this happen again._ In the 2020 Election, more than 25 million Christians were eligible to vote... but never even bothered to register to vote. This year, the Institute for Faith & Culture is strategically partnering with **Vote Your Faith** to get **thousands of Christians in key states ready to vote** \-- so we can **turn our nation back to God**! [**Fellow American, will you help me and the Institute for Faith & Culture reach 1,000 more Christians in just the next two weeks with your gift of $20.24, $50, $100, or more today?**](http://trk.faithandlibertymail._c291cmNlX2NvZGU9RkFMUjU0NTc1In0/8j6rREhjiQ6fFaFkFHRNgQ) We must encourage and educate believers like never before to vote their biblical values in the 2024 Election.
---
[ **Help activate 1,000 new Christian voters >>**](http://trk.faithandlibertymail._c291cmNlX2NvZGU9RkFMUjU0NTc1In0/Jqyu4la43b_0xb9OQNwNHw)
---
[](http://trk.faithandlibertymail._c291cmNlX2NvZGU9RkFMUjU0NTc1In0/Nvrv_ClTJq-g0X1EOrb7Bw)
---
_Above: The Institute for Faith & Culture prepares Christians to lead in this cultural moment in America._ The Institute for Faith & Culture can lead the charge to reach and register Christians in key states - in a way that no other organization can. This year could be decisive for Christians' religious liberty (Matthew 22, Romans 13) ... for parental rights (Exodus 20:12; Colossians 3:20) ... for the protection of unborn babies' lives (Genesis 1:26-27; Psalm 139:13-16) ... and for God's design for marriage and family (Genesis 2:24; Ephesians 5:22-23). **That's why the Institute for Faith & Culture is doing all we can in our strategic partnership with Vote Your Faith to reach and register 1,000 more Christians for the 2024 Election ... in just the next two weeks!** **[**Fellow American, will you make your most generous gift of $20.24, $50, $100, or even $250 to help the Institute for Faith & Culture reach this important milestone?**](http://trk.faithandlibertymail._c291cmNlX2NvZGU9RkFMUjU0NTc1In0/PKt60-ZQRk98UxHD70GEoA)**
---
[ **Help reach 1,000 more Christian voters >>**](http://trk.faithandlibertymail._c291cmNlX2NvZGU9RkFMUjU0NTc1In0/aZacz_073poM4XgMa8Lnyw)
---
[](http://trk.faithandlibertymail._c291cmNlX2NvZGU9RkFMUjU0NTc1In0/nlh3wpweyurh8vdowSBcsA)
---
The Institute for Faith & Culture was founded in 2022 to help believers develop a Christian worldview ... to equip and support Christian leaders in every area of public life ... and to prepare believers like you to confidently engage in this cultural moment in America. [When you financially partner with the Institute for Faith & Culture, you will help us continue our critical work to](http://trk.faithandlibertymail._c291cmNlX2NvZGU9RkFMUjU0NTc1In0/RL8b4DsB1x_3nosL1KNrPg):
* Teach THOUSANDS of Christians how to connect their faith to their civic engagement,

* Prepare HUNDREDS of Christian pastors and ministry leaders to guide their congregations to vote their faith in the 2024 Election, and

* Reach and register 1,000 new Christian voters with our faith-filled message _in just the next two weeks_ - and then do even more before November 2024!

**[**Please, Fellow American, make your most generous gift to help the Institute for Faith & Culture reach and register Christian in key states ahead of the all-important 2024 Election.**](http://trk.faithandlibertymail._c291cmNlX2NvZGU9RkFMUjU0NTc1In0/q0wbI_pOvNVWyd2ymuL4Sw)**
---
[ **Help activate 1,000 new Christian voters >>**](http://trk.faithandlibertymail._c291cmNlX2NvZGU9RkFMUjU0NTc1In0/vxkiWVoTH206u4DXTc1nQg)
---
Religious liberty, the sanctity of human life, and the very heart of our nation are all on the line this year, and we must do all we can to prepare Christians across America to vote their faith in November. Together, we can -- and we will -- see America turn back to God.

| | Dear Friend,You've heard this tale before: A radical school district socially transitions a child behind the parents' back.**[**But when I tell you how far this school district went, you're going to want to donate $35 or more right away to help us win this huge lawsuit.**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z4p6sjbs7emp4a8tc7u8ujdt822fu9r8f60456oo_rp22sh2s8i6eoj5cjg68oj6chh2bs)** School District 27J, outside Denver, Colorado, provided our client's child with remote therapy sessions from a transgender therapist who counsels children toward a transition.No, Mom and Dad were not aware.In fact, the school went to great lengths to keep the counseling a secret! However, the child's mental health was deteriorating so badly the school guidance counselor felt the need to call home, but...**The guidance counselor intentionally deceived the parents by carefully using the child's real name and correct pronouns instead of the "chosen" name and pronouns the child uses at school.** Worse, the guidance counselor failed to mention the likely source of the child's mental health crisis -- the "social transition" taking place at school.If this was your child or grandchild, I know you'd be furious about this conspiracy! **[**That's why I'm asking you to help the Center for American Liberty win this lawsuit by donating $35, $50, $100 or more right away.**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zugmid0vnvc4k6c9mine2ir16oj4gu7cas1dlaa0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj5cjg68oj6chh2bs)** My name is Mark Trammell and I’m the Executive Director and General Counsel of the Center for American Liberty – a conservative non-profit law firm that defends _**your**_ constitutional rights. I'd like to share more details about this case with you. But our clients have chosen to remain anonymous for fear of retaliation from the woke cancel culture mob.But that won't stop the Center for American Liberty from fighting on their behalf.**As you know, parents have a fundamental right under the Fourteenth Amendment to direct the upbringing of their children.** That includes being made aware of life-altering decisions made at school.That's why we filed suit on behalf of John and Jane Doe against the Attorney General of Colorado and School District 27J challenging the policies that enabled school administrators to transition their child without notification or consent. **[**Will you donate $35 or more today to help fund this and our other parental rights cases?**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zp97dti6k6d4kjaikjc2eff4dv2lt5a17b5a6j1g_rp22sh2s8i6eoj5cjg68oj6chh2bs)** Your support is critical to making sure we have the resources to fight the radical transgender activists in schools and doctors in courtrooms across the country.Mark my words: These radicals won't stop preying on your children and grandchildren until the Courts slap them down by overturning unconstitutional state laws and issuing hefty financial penalties.I hope you will stand with John and Jane Doe in Colorado.

| Dear Patriots,

Judge Joe's Briefing A NEWSLETTER FROM THE CAMPAIGN TRAIL VOLUME 17 - September 2024 Dear Friend, Eric Sorensen is at it again peddling the same, tired lie he ran on last cycle. Sorensen is desperate to deceive voters into thinking he is a pragmatic moderate instead of the extreme, liberal partisan he has always been. After taking orders from Kamala Harris and Nancy Pelosi for the last two years, Eric Sorensen has shown his true colors. The facade is gone. Illinoisans know Sorensen is not the bipartisan problem-solver he plays on television. Sorensen’s latest ad asks ‘What does a meteorologist do in Congress?’ Here’s the real answer. Sorensen has voted in lockstep with Kamala Harris and Nancy Pelosi since the day he was sworn into office. He’s carried water for the failed Biden-Harris economic agenda that has crushed Illinois families, voted consistently against commonsense border security measures, and backed student loan socialism for the rich. It’s flat-out extreme. The forecast for a second Sorensen term is even worse – higher taxes, more inflation, government-run healthcare, millions of new illegal immigrants, untold amounts of fentanyl on our streets. I’m running to offer Illinoisans a better way forward – one in which our district is the best place to live, work, and raise a family. While Eric Sorensen is beholden to his party’s bosses and the liberal special interests, my allegiances are to the working men and women of IL-17 who have had the deck stacked against them for far too long. When I’m in Congress, we’ll restore economic opportunity, level the playing field for our farmers and manufacturers, lower taxes, secure the border for good, and clean up Washington. New Endorsements Last month, we released more than 60 new endorsements from a bipartisan group of current and former Illinois elected officials and public servants. Our campaign now has endorsements from over 100 Illinois leaders, as well as the Illinois Fraternal Order of Police. subject: Blinking red lights
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELISSA SLOTKIN FOR MICHIGAN
body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1896%2E135344%2EmqYzKZ)

I am not one who is prone to hyperbole, but there are some blinking red lights demonstrating this is a very competitive race. The outside spending is already off the charts.
First, there was the AARP poll showing that our race is tightening and is now within the margin of error. A Fox News piece dropped at the same time with Republican strategists signaling outside groups to send and spend money to elect our opponent.
Then there's the fact that for the past few weeks, no media market has seen more political spending than Detroit, Michigan. In both my race and the presidential -- campaigns and outside groups are pouring money into Michigan to reach as many voters as possible. To make this specific: at this moment, the other side has $17 million against me on TV, with TV spending in the presidential race in Michigan expected to clear at least $100 million.
Now, The Hill says that our Senate race is one of the top three to potentially flip into Republican hands this November. And recent polling has my race in a dead-heat, with Harris and Trump TIED in Michigan.
Any one of these in isolation does not mean the sky is falling. But taken together they should make crystal clear that now is the time to donate if you want to keep this Senate seat blue. And that good energy on the Democrats’ side does NOT mean we waltz to victory in November.

Peter, let this sink in:
56 days from now, voters around the country will decide control of the White House, the Senate, the House, and every office down the ballot.
I know it may seem like a long road ahead, but the reality is that every moment between now and November 5th is a critical opportunity to talk to voters, to solidify our chances at holding the Senate, and to continue working hard for the American people.
**And let me tell you – our Democratic majority in the Senate is far from guaranteed this year. Every day, I see headlines like this from polling experts:**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/92456695/497180383/-1442630867?source=LOC_EM_FR_2024.09.09_SenControl_B1_F1_S1_C1_200DO_RS-T1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODQ4OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MzQ3ZDY0OC1iNDZlLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=dDkatrXD10MlfEusZikMUYdJon5bCOlTc0zNK5Q0NEI=)

That means between now and November 5th, it’s essential for Team Durbin to hit every single one of our monthly fundraising targets so we have the resources to reach undecided voters and turn out Democrats.

subject: Perhaps the worst attack yet
body:
You've heard this tale before: A radical school district socially transitions a child behind the parents' back.

| |
---
| | We just received an encouraging sign from the Ninth Circuit Court of Appeals in the Regino case...
---
| |

| | Dear Friend,You've heard this tale before: A radical school district socially transitions a child behind the parents' back.**[**But when I tell you how far this school district went, you're going to want to donate $35 or more right away to help us win this huge lawsuit.**](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zp8mdjnfi52t6vb2mg06o0gvj4cfmb5jd5h1mns0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj5cjg62o72cph2bs)** School District 27J, outside Denver, Colorado, provided our client's child with remote therapy sessions from a transgender therapist who counsels children toward a transition.No, Mom and Dad were not aware.In fact, the school went to great lengths to keep the counseling a secret! However, the child's mental health was deteriorating so badly the school guidance counselor felt the need to call home, but...**The guidance counselor intentionally deceived the parents by carefully using the child's real name and correct pronouns instead of the "chosen" name and pronouns the child uses at school.** Worse, the guidance counselor failed to mention the likely source of the child's mental health crisis -- the "social transition" taking place at school.If this was your child or grandchild, I know you'd be furious about this conspiracy! **[**That's why I'm asking you to help the Center for American Liberty win this lawsuit by donating $35, $50, $100 or more right away.**](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z7fdoskhptm0v68s0hiee9a73auurmgu1vmaqt38_rp22sh2s8i6eoj5cjg62o72cph2bs)** My name is Mark Trammell and I’m the Executive Director and General Counsel of the Center for American Liberty – a conservative non-profit law firm that defends _**your**_ constitutional rights. I'd like to share more details about this case with you. But our clients have chosen to remain anonymous for fear of retaliation from the woke cancel culture mob.But that won't stop the Center for American Liberty from fighting on their behalf.**As you know, parents have a fundamental right under the Fourteenth Amendment to direct the upbringing of their children.** That includes being made aware of life-altering decisions made at school.That's why we filed suit on behalf of John and Jane Doe against the Attorney General of Colorado and School District 27J challenging the policies that enabled school administrators to transition their child without notification or consent. **[**Will you donate $35 or more today to help fund this and our other parental rights cases?**](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zsd3u8lv2de3frf4toc9gh35kgsjgemlfledal30_rp22sh2s8i6eoj5cjg62o72cph2bs)** Your support is critical to making sure we have the resources to fight the radical transgender activists in schools and doctors in courtrooms across the country.Mark my words: These radicals won't stop preying on your children and grandchildren until the Courts slap them down by overturning unconstitutional state laws and issuing hefty financial penalties.I hope you will stand with John and Jane Doe in Colorado.
---
| | Sincerely,Mark Trammell, Executive Director of Center for American Liberty

name: Dr. Robert Jeffress
subject: Let’s walk together along the path of Jesus Christ
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vW0MZ-hWUN
Many of us are familiar with the life and teachings of Jesus
Christ.
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oW0MZ-hWUN

Hello
Friend,
Many of
us are familiar with the life and teachings of Jesus Christ. But
have you ever wondered where these amazing stories took place?
In our
fast-paced society, the average American travels about 30 miles a
day. As a result, it can be hard to picture the ministry of
Christ as he walked from town to town and village to village
healing the sick, raising the dead, and giving sight to the
blind.
Jesus
didn't zoom around on the expressway, he walked an average of
about three miles-per-hour, slow enough to minister to everyone
His father put in His path.
To help
you better understand Jesus' area of ministry and the
world-altering impact it had, I created The Jesus Map. It traces
the life and ministry of Jesus Christ, including 52 key events
from His birth in Bethlehem to His ascension on the Mount of
Olives
This
unique reference tool will let you see where he fed the 5,000,
walked on water, and was tempted by Satan. As you walk with
Christ and the Apostles down those dusty Israeli roads, you will
better understand the questions people asked Him and the needs he
confronted.

I pray it
will also inspire you with ways God wants to use you in your area
of influence. Many times, we only need to slow down enough to see
what God has in mind.
Here's
your link to get the map and begin your journey of discovery:
https://ptv.org/nna/the-jesus-map

Let's
walk together along the path of Jesus Christ.

Dr.
Robert Jeffress
Senior
Pastor, First Baptist Dallas

body:
Dear Peter, We just finished filming a new ad that, for the first time on television, tells my story to our voters. [You can watch it here.](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/rNgY9ruCCJGyLh83WPeIfA/bdTqTMnqpRgzOcpFR4yXAg) The good news is we've received extremely favorable feedback on this ad. The bad news? We're running out of money to keep it on the air. Times have changed: we don't just need to pay to get this on over-the-air TV and cable, but also on digital devices, YouTube, Facebook, and through text messaging. Will you contribute to our specific project to get this ad up and keep it running by donating at [http://JoeKentforCongress.com/KeeptheAdUp](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/ERxMDUaHu8921WEXJT763jSaxQ/bdTqTMnqpRgzOcpFR4yXAg)? The ad discusses my childhood growing up in the Pacific Northwest, where I did rescue missions in the Cascades as an Eagle Scout, my enlistment at Ft. Lewis that began my twenty years of service in the Special Forces, my return to the area to raise my family, and my current mission to win this election so I can go to Congress and fight for all our families. Please take a look and share your feedback! And if you can, help us keep it on the air by donating today at [https://JoeKentforCongress.com/KeeptheAdUp](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/6AaGy3bcjsrfckwoe5yBGQ/bdTqTMnqpRgzOcpFR4yXAg)! Respectfully, Joe Kent [](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/ZlJvJT4Sx3qGjEn2oED31Q/bdTqTMnqpRgzOcpFR4yXAg) _Paid for by the Joe Kent Victory Fund_

name: Katrina
subject: Campaign Update: Connecting with Voters and Upcoming Events
body:
Only 56 more days | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/b1eb732e2f38/campaign-update-connecting-with-voters-and-upcoming-events?e=830e7edf7b)
---
|

|
---
| Dear ,
I wanted to take a moment to share some exciting updates about the campaign and connect with all of you on what's happening next.
---
| | | | | | | | | |
---
| This past Saturday, I had the pleasure of attending a Meet and Greet hosted by Zach Angell, alongside [**Natalie Pinkney**](https://katrinaforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6fba8715e0ee626118d4f1cfa&id=0dbaacd0d1&e=830e7edf7b), who is running for Salt Lake County Council At-Large C, and [**Sheila Srivastava**](https://katrinaforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6fba8715e0ee626118d4f1cfa&id=e487efe581&e=830e7edf7b), a CPA running for Salt Lake County Treasurer. I had a wonderful time talking with Zach’s neighbors, and it was inspiring to hear directly from community members about the issues that matter most. I’d love to attend more house parties like this! If you're interested in hosting an event, I’d be thrilled to come over and talk to your neighbors about what we can achieve together for Utah's 4th District.
---
| | | | | | | | | | | On Sunday, I was at the **Utah State Fair** , enjoying the dancing, music, and most importantly, connecting with voters—both Democrat and Republican—at the Salt Lake County Democrats booth. I’ll be back at the booth on **Thursday** evening and again on **Saturday** evening, and I would love to see you there!
---
|
---
|
### Upcoming Events:
###
#### Jordan River Walk and Talk Series - Week 2
Monday, September 9th, 5:30 PM – 7:00 PM
[**REGISTER HERE**](https://katrinaforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6fba8715e0ee626118d4f1cfa&id=807cad430c&e=830e7edf7b) Join me at the Center for Documentary Expression and Art and the Jordan River Commission as we explore the history and ecology of the Jordan River Migratory Bird Reserve. The event includes a nature photo activity, meditation, and writing exercise.

#### Phone Banking Sessions
Wednesdays from 6:00 PM – 8:00 PM
[**REGISTER HERE**](https://katrinaforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6fba8715e0ee626118d4f1cfa&id=1fbfb32eea&e=830e7edf7b) Saturdays from 12:00 PM – 2:00 PM
[**REGISTER HERE**](https://katrinaforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6fba8715e0ee626118d4f1cfa&id=a0c57de5c9&e=830e7edf7b) Let’s make the best use of our dialer! If we all call at the same time, we’ll reach more voters. Plus, we’ll announce some exciting prizes for the volunteers who make the most calls!

#### Presidential Debate Watch Party
Tuesday, September 10th, 6:30 PM Green Pig Pub, 31 E 400 S, Salt Lake City, UT 84111 Join us as we cheer on Vice-President Kamala Harris during the debate. I’ll be available for comments, alongside other state and county Democratic candidates.

#### Saturday’s Voyeur 2024: “You Ain’t Seen Nothin’ Yet
Saturday, September 14th 3:00 PM – 4:00 PM: Matinee Performance 4:00 PM – 5:00 PM: Endorsed Candidate Mingle 5:00 PM – 6:00 PM: Evening Performance
[**TICKETS AVAILABLE**](https://katrinaforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6fba8715e0ee626118d4f1cfa&id=9f0c98a9a2&e=830e7edf7b) Hosted by Salt Lake County Democratic Party and Women’s Democratic Club. Proceeds benefit GOTV efforts and candidates in 2024
---
| | | | | | | | | | | As always, thank you for your continued support. Every conversation, every connection, brings us closer to creating the kind of future we all want for our families. If you have any questions or want to get more involved, don’t hesitate to reach out!
---
| | | | | | | | | |
---
| | Best wishes, warmest regards,
**Katrina Fallick-Wang** _Candidate for Congress, Utah’s 4th District_

Republican leaders in Washington have made their loyalty to Trump no secret—all the way up to House GOP leaders.

Some Republican House leaders have even publicly refused to commit to certifying the election results this November!
