name: Power the Polls
subject: Reminder: Get paid to support democracy!
body:
You’re receiving this email because you have expressed interest in the
past about applying to be a poll worker in your community. Power the Polls
is here to help connect people to their local elections offices. If you no
longer wish to receive emails from Power the Polls, [ https://act.powerthepolls.org/cms/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?akid=8534.934366.S0cMze&t=1001&akid=8534%2E934366%2ES0cMze ]you can safely
unsubscribe here.

[ https://act.powerthepolls.org/go/42?t=1002&akid=8534%2E934366%2ES0cMze ][IMG]

Hi Peter,

We’re so grateful for your interest in serving as a poll worker – an easy
way to help local and national elections run smoothly and securely (and
often get paid)!

But there’s still a critical step you have to take: [ https://act.powerthepolls.org/go/4704?t=1003&akid=8534%2E934366%2ES0cMze ]You must complete
an official application with your local elections office so they know
you’re interested. You can get started right now and it only takes a few
minutes.

[ https://act.powerthepolls.org/go/4704?t=1004&akid=8534%2E934366%2ES0cMze ]Checked box: Sign up with Power the Polls to show your interest |
Unchecked box: Complete your official application | Visit
powerthepolls.org/search | Power the Polls logo

[ https://act.powerthepolls.org/go/4704?t=1005&akid=8534%2E934366%2ES0cMze ]Complete your official application now

Almost everywhere in the country, poll workers can get paid to help their
neighbors vote. The amount varies by jurisdiction but can be as much as
$200 or more for one day of service.

Some jurisdictions also offer additional payment for training or early
voting.

So what’s stopping you, Peter?
[ https://act.powerthepolls.org/go/4704?t=1006&akid=8534%2E934366%2ES0cMze ]Complete your official poll worker application right now. You just have
to enter your ZIP code to get started.

Once you submit your application, your local election officials will
handle the selection, training, and placement of poll workers. Timelines
differ across jurisdictions, so please be patient and wait for a call,
email or letter from your local elections office detailing the next steps.

Thank you for taking action to support our elections.

—The Power the Polls Team

P.S. Did you already complete your application? That’s great! [ https://act.powerthepolls.org/survey/2024_poll_worker_status_survey_step_1?t=1007&akid=8534%2E934366%2ES0cMze ]Let us
know you’ve submitted it (and we’ll stop sending reminders).

P.P.S. Your local jurisdiction might call poll workers something different
– like “election workers” or “election judges” – but no matter the name,
the need for temporary employees to help elections run smoothly is real!

You can unsubscribe from this mailing list at any time:
http://act.powerthepolls.org/cms/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?akid=8534%2E934366%2ES0cMze

| This week marks eight weeks until voters in Alabama's Second Congressional District choose more of the status quo or lower prices, safer communities, and more opportunity.

Two weeks ago, I visited the U.S. Mexico Southern Border and met with border patrol agents and local law enforcement in El Paso and San Elizario to get the facts. I saw firsthand the serious national security and humanitarian crisis unfolding at our southern border — a crisis my opponent denies has any impact on Alabama families. While he worked for Biden's transition team and helped put policies in place that opened our border and endangered our children, innocent 19-year-olds like Adam Luker have been robbed of their lives at the hands of illegal aliens, and thousands of Alabamians have faced the flood of drugs like fentanyl.

This is a close race, and victory is no sure thing as we begin the eight-week sprint to Election Day. In the coming weeks, we will devote all of our remaining time and resources to the 13 counties that make up District Two. Team Dobson will be reaching voters who, in many cases, have just begun to pay attention to the election, and we need your help.

Now is the time to join our fight for Alabama families, and every little bit makes a difference. We are hosting phone banking and door-knocking events across the district, planting yard signs in every community, and finishing out a strong third-quarter fundraising showing. If you are willing to volunteer, able to give, or want to request a yard sign, please visit [www.dobsonforcongress.com](https://SRCOMM.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b15308cf5f888e47b0c8aa13d&id=ed5dd063ff&e=701cbbe14f).

Please continue to talk to your friends and family in the coming weeks, and most importantly, I ask for your continued prayers and vote on November 5.

Thank you,
Caroleene

| | Fellow American,

Over the last year, the agenda of the far Left, along with its media and Big Tech allies, has become all too clear.

Together, these forces want to **circumvent the First Amendment, suppress conservative speech and political activity** , and push their own **false** and **dishonest** narrative about American history and about what's happening today.

More and more, stories that question the far-Left's narrative are dubiously "fact-checked" or censored outright, while conservative opponents of the Left are "de-platformed."

**We have never seen anything like what we are seeing today in America!**

The roots of our current crisis can be traced to the late 1960s when radicals who scorned America and its way of life began taking over our colleges and universities.

It took them several decades to cement their dominance over American higher education, but we are seeing the fruits of their labors today: we see it in the media, and we see it in Silicon Valley.

We are also seeing it in professional sports, in corporate America--much of which is now capitulating to far-Left demands--and increasingly in K-12 education.

**Liberty in America is under serious threat. As I travel around the country, worried citizens ask me if there is a way to meet this crisis. I never hesitate to say there is, despite how uphill the fight may seem.**

A vital part of the fight--and one in which Hillsdale College is uniquely able to lead--is to reach and teach additional millions of citizens with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty.

**You are making that fight possible by supporting our educational outreach efforts, such as _Imprimis_ , America's leading digest of liberty.**

Hillsdale launched _Imprimis_ over 50 years ago to promote limited government, free enterprise, individual rights, personal responsibility, and a strong national defense. Each issue covers a timely political, economic, or cultural issue from a constitutional perspective.

Today, with the far Left's dramatic escalation of its assault on free speech and informed patriotism, _Imprimis_ is more critical than ever.

Think of what we have seen in the last few years: unprecedented and unconstitutional lockdowns, lawless violence in our cities, and even the destruction of historical monuments.

On top of this, we are now seeing an escalation of the effort to shut off any debate about these issues--an effort to limit or curtail speech that is **simply** and **clearly un-American**.

There is a good reason that conservative radio and TV host Mark Levin says _Imprimis_ is the publication he most looks forward to reading each month.

You'll be pleased to know that its circulation has grown this year to more than 6.6 million. That's 6.6 million paper copies that are **mailed to homes and businesses** ten times per year.

Our research also shows that _Imprimis_ subscribers share their copy with two to three other people on average, giving _Imprimis_ even greater reach and influence.

And while a circulation of more than 6.6 million is undoubtedly impressive--_Imprimis_ has a greater circulation than the _Wall Street Journal_ and _The New York Times_ --we are determined to do more.

Since _Imprimis_ launched in 1972 with a circulation of about 1,000, **Hillsdale College has never charged for a subscription.**

**But the fact that we offer _Imprimis_ free of charge does not mean that producing and mailing _Imprimis_ is without cost. **

Even using non-profit postage rates, the price for printing and mailing each issue of _Imprimis_ to so many subscribers ten times a year is a significant financial undertaking.

**Our immediate goal is to increase the circulation of _Imprimis_ to over 7 million American households and businesses this year. To do so, we must address the question of production and mailing costs.**

Your generous support today will help us reach our _Imprimis_ goal and expand our other successful educational outreach efforts.

You know that education is liberty's surest defense--and that education is needed now more than ever!

That's why, in addition to _Imprimis_ , we are investing in our other educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. We're doing this through our **[Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=852fa0424d664fe196a20ec9cfa57689&_e=M9icxk6HpX5Xw8jugHvThnXB7dX3AtdY1C1_n5h4UMVNVJVppuzFP_u-6LALACBsbKZ_wthBbv1wkl12nqbBTl9SC7oLLRqxv9MMW0PcsTl366lVQN0wkbbFWd9UCKbVKjT2Ys1MlENSuoLOOF3ifx5NPrhiobBmtKwJLrDWnhDSVR_Wa6WUvgyHy-QtBSvwJp4s6XRQHlUVyHmDZCu-4wyDuh4a3w0LR9SCR6--_vddPo6F-0giIVIzxSyT6xhfL9o7Dn2sHP-PMlb8AvgDE_DkTmgj8sBXvxzTG6A4c4x5yBj92uHYGI3lBojRH9KJRCHvEy_RJGlsFNktBcaTPe8QT0pCsv3FLFioNmzaWQakgUlirx_mbn51hGdYU-ojgI_X7zODwR1z7EwGSF5yuQ%3D%3D).**

These efforts include:

* **Educating millions of Americans, especially younger Americans, through free online courses** --on topics including the Constitution, American history, and free-market economics.

* **Providing hundreds of thousands of young Americans with free copies of the Declaration of Independence and Constitution** --Hillsdale has already distributed over 600,000 free copies of these founding documents, and we receive more requests every week.

* **Educating thousands of K-12 students** in Hillsdale-affiliated classical K-12 public and private schools--there are already more than 90 such schools across the country, each having a strong curricular component in American civics.

I hope you'll agree that after everything we've seen in the last few years, the need for _Imprimis_ and Hillsdale's other educational outreach efforts is undeniable.

Hillsdale is the only college in America equipped to **reach** and **teach** increasing millions of Americans about our nation's great heritage of liberty and about the need to defend freedom and limited government.

Almost unique among American colleges and universities, Hillsdale refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans. This frees us from much burdensome and corrupting federal regulation.

**This independence from the government also means that our work is entirely dependent on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.**

[ Will you give generously to our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions** --which includes expanding the reach and influence of _Imprimis_](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=852fa0424d664fe196a20ec9cfa57689&_e=M9icxk6HpX5Xw8jugHvThnXB7dX3AtdY1C1_n5h4UMVNVJVppuzFP_u-6LALACBsbKZ_wthBbv1wkl12nqbBTl9SC7oLLRqxv9MMW0PcsTl366lVQN0wkbbFWd9UCKbVKjT2Ys1MlENSuoLOOF3ifx5NPrhiobBmtKwJLrDWnhDSVR_Wa6WUvgyHy-QtBSvwJp4s6XRQHlUVyHmDZCu-4wyDuh4a3w0LR9SCR6--_vfTq45IeVdq5LAUXybc3aLBQyihj1KhZga4-SqSzukD6HBxvqq6ygYB2hW-3LxHi8ztxleeqWTD5cCuia9ojBCbqGuEpfTvG36DjR3uSl6O4PGSWkWyiP9jwaw2dWlfymGWCLxT7LVPfxcWhlqAMRLZkQGHg5oAclbY6xaGQ8hTAw%3D%3D)?

If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on American principles and the American way of life, please show your support for Hillsdale College with a generous tax-deductible gift today.

I hope you will stand with us as we engage the far Left, along with its media and Big Tech allies, on the battlefield of education.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

P.S. Liberty in America is under threat, and education is the only long-term solution. That's why we are greatly expanding our national educational outreach, such as _Imprimis_ , free online courses, K-12 curricula and support, and much more. And we need your help to do so! Please make a generous, tax-deductible gift in support of liberty and education at this secure link: **[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/defend-liberty](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=852fa0424d664fe196a20ec9cfa57689&_e=M9icxk6HpX5Xw8jugHvThnXB7dX3AtdY1C1_n5h4UMVNVJVppuzFP_u-6LALACBsbKZ_wthBbv1wkl12nqbBTl9SC7oLLRqxv9MMW0PcsTl366lVQN0wkbbFWd9UCKbVKjT2Ys1MlENSuoLOOF3ifx5NPrhiobBmtKwJLrDWnhDSVR_Wa6WUvgyHy-QtBSvwJp4s6XRQHlUVyHmDZCu-4wyDuh4a3w0LR9SCR6--_vfu6-tpJkBvTTmv0ap15zgFfXhmBj90HPXky3CfBjnUDOQ1XfqOocYskgeGJdtdW2VWA01L2LI5hUwiZc_qgcPWV2yyDPNQCj9Od9554ooTwox0v8Sjck6LptgPwyWBXfGleJb8OxEbZwD_yGd-j4-njFm21f9yJRI8MSRCqRDP4Q%3D%3D)**.

Thank you again for saving young people through education.

body:
#
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/71020?refcode=em20240909-7604&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=7604%2E614464%2EBKTI3-)
Peter — born-and-raised Missourian John Goodman here.
**In a moment, I’ll ask you to[join me in supporting Lucas Kunce in the critical U.S. Senate race happening in my home state against Josh Hawley this year.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/71020?refcode=em20240909-7604&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=7604%2E614464%2EBKTI3-) But first, I think we need to talk about family values.**
**[CHIP IN NOW](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/71020?refcode=em20240909-7604&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=7604%2E614464%2EBKTI3-)**
I learned what family values meant while growing up in Missouri, the most beautiful state in the union.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/71020?refcode=em20240909-7604&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=7604%2E614464%2EBKTI3-)
I also learned what that didn’t mean.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/71020?refcode=em20240909-7604&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=5&akid=7604%2E614464%2EBKTI3-)
Family values didn’t mean cruelty. It didn’t mean fake patriotism. It didn’t mean telling people how to live, or family profits. It didn’t mean making life harder for hardworking people. And it sure as hell didn’t mean robbing people of their rights or tax dollars.
**None of that is family values... that’s something else.**
**[CHIP IN TO BEAT HAWLEY](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/71020?refcode=em20240909-7604&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=6&akid=7604%2E614464%2EBKTI3-)**
Growing up in working class neighborhoods in Missouri, Lucas and I both learned what it meant for a family to live paycheck to paycheck.
We also learned the real meaning of family values — but not from rich politicians and self-help authors like Josh Hawley.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/71020?refcode=em20240909-7604&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=7&akid=7604%2E614464%2EBKTI3-)
**We’re the Show Me State. People showed us.**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/71020?refcode=em20240909-7604&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=8&akid=7604%2E614464%2EBKTI3-)
**[CHIP IN TO SUPPORT LUCAS](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/71020?refcode=em20240909-7604&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=9&akid=7604%2E614464%2EBKTI3-)**
People like the neighbors and church friends that helped Lucas’ family get by when his parents were bankrupted by medical bills. People like the Scout master, track coach, and public school teachers who mentored and supported Lucas growing up. People like the veterans at Lucas’ local Marine Corps league in mid-Missouri, who taught him that he could honor and protect everyone who took care of him by serving like they did.
Lucas and I both learned that family values are really about people taking care of each other and doing the right thing. Through good times, and tough times.
**All that other noise from the politicians...**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/71020?refcode=em20240909-7604&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=10&akid=7604%2E614464%2EBKTI3-)
**That’s something else.**
In Missouri this November, there’s a real choice in the Senate race. Josh Hawley only won his last race with 51% of the vote — and that was before he helped overturn Roe, enacted a total abortion ban, voted against IVF and birth control, stalled healthcare for veterans, and cost taxpayers $250,000 by breaking transparency laws to help his own campaign.
Lucas Kunce is the Marine veteran who can beat him. It won’t be easy, but it will be worth it.
**So I’m asking:[Will you join me in supporting Lucas Kunce in Missouri’s U.S. Senate race by making a donation of any amount today? clean_body: - Peter — born-and-raised Missourian John Goodman here. In a moment, I’ll ask you to- But first, I think we need to talk about family values. - I learned what family values meant while growing up in Missouri, the most beautiful state in the union. - I also learned what that didn’t mean. - Family values didn’t mean cruelty. It didn’t mean fake patriotism. It didn’t mean telling people how to live, or family profits. It didn’t mean making life harder for hardworking people. And it sure as hell didn’t mean robbing people of their rights or tax dollars. None of that is family values... that’s something else. - Growing up in working class neighborhoods in Missouri, Lucas and I both learned what it meant for a family to live paycheck to paycheck. We also learned the real meaning of family values — but not from rich politicians and self-help authors like Josh Hawley. - We’re the Show Me State. People showed us. - - People like the neighbors and church friends that helped Lucas’ family get by when his parents were bankrupted by medical bills. People like the Scout master, track coach, and public school teachers who mentored and supported Lucas growing up. People like the veterans at Lucas’ local Marine Corps league in mid-Missouri, who taught him that he could honor and protect everyone who took care of him by serving like they did. Lucas and I both learned that family values are really about people taking care of each other and doing the right thing. Through good times, and tough times. All that other noise from the politicians... - That’s something else. In Missouri this November, there’s a real choice in the Senate race. Josh Hawley only won his last race with 51% of the vote — and that was before he helped overturn Roe, enacted a total abortion ban, voted against IVF and birth control, stalled healthcare for veterans, and cost taxpayers $250,000 by breaking transparency laws to help his own campaign. Lucas Kunce is the Marine veteran who can beat him. It won’t be easy, but it will be worth it. # It’s Crunch Time and We Need YOU!
---
| Dear Peter,
---

An article in a nonpartisan news site recently asked the question, “is Virginia ‘Youngkin Country’ now”?
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024]
Look, it’s a fair question given what’s happened in our Commonwealth recently.
Last month, Glenn Youngkin and my opponent for U.S. Senate hosted a campaign event together, then welcomed Donald Trump for a stop on a campaign trail in Northern Virginia.
And let’s face it, Virginia’s been a deep red state for most of my life.
So when pundits wonder if Virginia is “Youngkin Country,” I get where they’re coming from.
The truth is, Democrats are still underdogs in the 2024 elections — and Trump, the NRSC, and my opponent are poised to spend huge sums to flip our state red in November.
I refuse to accept that Virginia is “Youngkin Country” — but as Michelle Obama said in her DNC speech last month, we can’t just say something, we’ve got to DO SOMETHING.
September is the most critical month yet for campaign fundraising because every single dollar we’re able to bring in by the end of this month will be made public in the next FEC report — so now, more than ever before , we need you to get involved.

Last week [a federal jury convicted Former Customs and Border Patrol agent Aaron Mitchell of kidnapping and rape of a child](https://substack.com/redirect/8faefaa5-3074-4196-a4d7-f895c1692780?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Mitchell approached a minor school girl and demanded "her papers." Mitchell then arrested her, kidnapped her, and took her to his apartment where he raped her for several hours. Afterwards he returned her to school and threatened her to "not tell anybody." The [DOJ reported](https://substack.com/redirect/6ff3af6c-b7a9-4d72-827f-b057488e62e6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> Mitchell found the child waiting for school to start, introduced himself as a law enforcement officer, and asked for her papers. Next, after flashing his police badge and credentials, Mitchell ordered the child into his car and explained that he was taking her to the police station. Instead, Mitchell drove the child miles away from her school, pulled over and restrained her hands and feet with two pairs of handcuffs. Once the defendant forced the victim into his apartment, he repeatedly sexually assaulted her over the course of several hours. The defendant had conducted numerous searches regarding rape and how to stop someone from screaming, and how long it takes to smother someone.
Mitchell's story is one example of consequences for an abusive Boarder Patrol Agent, for which he will likely spend life in prison. Yet horrifyingly, his story of facing some consequence is by no means the exception. And the lack of meaningful reform and accountability all but assures Mitchell won't be the last to commit such horrific crimes. **Let 's Address This.**
**Let's Address This with Qasim Rashid is a reader-supported publication. Consider becoming a free or paid subscriber.**

| [](https://substack.com/redirect/19b83191-0c5f-456b-a480-28e387a852a8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
A report released by the Department of Health and Human Services way back in 2019 documents nearly 5000 cases of sexual assault and rape committed by US Customs and Border Patrol Agents. [The Guardian reports](https://substack.com/redirect/9c6123b6-2e4e-41d2-ad1f-1af14fb4041a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> Almost 5,000 complaints of sexual abuse and harassment of migrant children in US custody have been filed over the past four years, according to government documents released this week. The allegations range from adult staff members having relationships with minors, and the showing of pornographic videos, to forcible touching. According to Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) documents released on Tuesday, the reports date back to October 2015, during the Obama administration. However, most of the sexual abuse and harassment reported occurred since Donald Trump took office.
Little, if anything, has been done to follow up on these cases of widespread abuse and hold accountable those committing or enabling these cases of abuse. Another study by the NGO Freedom for Immigrants found a similar trend of abuse and lack of accountability. The [study found that](https://substack.com/redirect/fc283ac0-5fe3-40e1-89a9-df3e6324333b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> Between January 2010 and July 2016, the inspector general received 84 complaints of coerced sexual contact against U.S. Customs and Border Protection, which includes Border Patrol. The inspector general opened just seven investigations, none of which are known to have led to charges.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..InxwfZq4eXcgm8Uuc9PiVsk0Osk-pwvmiLDt1BrmBOY?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=148612235)
And under the Biden administration, this abuse of power by Border Patrol has continued. A comprehensive report by two human rights NGOs known as the Kino Border Initiative (KBI) and Advocacy for Human Rights in America (WOLA) conclude the following harrowing data. KBI and WOLA document thousands of cases of abuse, and thousands of cases of abuse that goes unaddressed, [reporting](https://substack.com/redirect/fb28e0cd-d9fb-4b71-bd20-061aa8f1236a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> KBI has assisted migrants in filing formal complaints about their treatment by CBP, and by Border Patrol in particular, since 2015. From this work, KBI concludes that **abuse by U.S. authorities during the migration journey is unfortunately common**. The prevalence of abuse by Border Patrol reported to KBI is likely an undercount, as it requires that migrants self-report to KBI staff and therefore recognize that their experience of being abused was not, in fact, just the normal cost of crossing the border. Further, many other migrants who faced abuses and were removed to Nogales may never have arrived at KBI and did not have a chance to report.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/3dec7bed-a209-4032-8504-047c203e48c3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

And sadly, the future does not look too bright. Speaking of, Donald Trump is already promising immunity for abusive agents.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/f9733d91-5cea-4fc0-aa3e-e3c8502f145f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
One of Donald Trump's promises if reelected is to grant federal immunity to all police officers, which would ostensibly include Border Patrol. Doing so would further decrease oversight over Border Patrol, and enable further abuse of already marginalized migrants and American citizens alike.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..InxwfZq4eXcgm8Uuc9PiVsk0Osk-pwvmiLDt1BrmBOY?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=148612235)
And where is the outrage? For as much as MAGA politicians (falsely) allege immigrants are rapists and crime ridden, the data shows ongoing systemic abuse by U.S. Border Patrol agents against immigrants and U.S. citizens who don't "look" American. The deafening silence from those who claim to condemn sexual abuse reveals that their true outrage is not against sexual abuse, but against the very idea that immigrants exist. Otherwise, they'd demand Donald Trump prosecute those Border Patrol agents who commit sexual abuse--not given them federal immunity.
Here's the hard truth. The United States has never had a just immigration policy, and sadly that lack of justice has only further devolved over the last 40 years. A nation of laws must also be a nation of accountability for those who abuse their law enforcement power. In their press release announcing the conviction of the aforementioned pedophile rapist, the DOJ declared:
> The heinous crimes committed against a young middle school student by an individual sworn to uphold the law are unspeakable. This defendant had a duty to protect his community but instead he abused his power. With this verdict, the jury has done us all a great service by holding accountable this former federal law enforcement official. The Justice Department will continue to stand up for sexual assault victims, especially children, and we will prosecute law enforcement officials who break the law with every tool at our disposal.
While Mitchell's conviction is a step towards accountability, nothing will undo the horrific harm done to the young girl who suffered his abuse. And likewise, for the thousands of unaddressed cases of abuse, those victims continue to wait for some semblance of justice. For the above commitment from the DOJ to have meaningful accountability, it must apply to excise the systemic abuse that has infected our Border Patrol to _prevent_ abuse, not just sparingly punish it. This means ridding the cancer of qualified immunity, comprehensive investigations into all cases of abuse, and meaningful accountability for those who commit and enable abuse.

| Friend,
---
| I know it’s hard to believe, but we’re already in the home stretch of the 2024 election. At the end of this month, every Vermonter will be able to begin voting in the General Election.

**[The stakes are high and I need your help](https://philscott.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=bbb0245bb16226cd6570f0156&id=e4f04eb667&e=19cebfe173).** Over the past 8 years, I’ve continued to focus on growing the economy, making Vermont more affordable, and protecting the most vulnerable – even with all the headwinds we’ve faced, like the pandemic and never-ending flooding.

And while we’ve made progress, **there’s still a whole lot of work left to do.**

**Unfortunately, the Super Majority in the Legislature hasn’t been a willing partner.** Instead of working with me to find ways to allow Vermonters to keep more of what they earn and make our state more affordable, they’ve used their newfound power to increase taxes, fees and costs on working families, seniors on fixed incomes, small businesses, and more.

**We desperately need more balance in Montpelier**. We need more elected officials who agree the solutions to our problems do not come from the extremes of either party, but somewhere in the middle.

The answer is electing more pragmatic, common sense and fiscally conservative Vermonters.

So I need you to hold your representatives accountable. If they’ve been part of the problem, and voted for things like the enormous property tax hike, the new $100 payroll tax, a 20% DMV fee hike, increased costs for electricity and home heating bills (just to name a few), then it’s time for a change.

I know many are stretched pretty thin as a result of this Legislature. But if you’re able to pitch in and help me and other like-minded candidates, we’ll make a dent and help rebalance the Legislature.

If you can’t help with funding, there are other ways to get involved, and I encourage you to send us an email at phil@philscott.org and we’ll find ways for you to pitch in.

It’s been the honor of my life to serve as your Governor and I hope I can count on your continued support as we work to make our state a better place to live, work and enjoy.

Sincerely,

Gov. Phil

Hello,
The day before the anniversary of the Supreme Court’s disastrous _Dobbs_ decision, I woke up to Fox News and Lauren Boebert attacking my sister and my 81-year-old father.
For decades, Dad was an OB-GYN. He delivered thousands of babies and wrote books on how to get pregnant and to navigate menopause. Dad provided women with full access to all kinds of reproductive health care, including abortions, in the years right after _Roe_ – and he has now had to watch as women’s reproductive rights are gutted in the aftermath of _Dobbs_.
Dad and his clinic faced many threats over the years. It’s no exaggeration to say that he put his own safety – and that of his family – at risk in order to protect the rights of women to make their own medical decisions.
But I’m not sure he ever expected to see a sitting member of Congress attacking him – or my sister who followed in his footsteps – in a national news outlet. **It’s disgusting. These kinds of personal attacks against my family have no place in our politics and do nothing to serve the people of Western and Southern Colorado.**
If extremists like Lauren Boebert and my new Republican opponent want to have a conversation about reproductive rights in this country, I am more than happy to have that debate. We can talk about how I support _freedom_ and _liberty_ – and how they support big government intruding into the lives of women. We can talk about how they support a national ban on abortion – with no exceptions for rape, incest, or the life of the mother. And we can talk about how they are so extreme, they even want to ban the pill that’s been used by women for decades.
I am willing to talk all day about the fringe view that the government should be dictating women’s medical decisions. **But what I won’t accept is extremists like Lauren Boebert and Fox News attacking my father and my sister.**
I am _incredibly_ proud of my father. He provided health care to women when they needed it during some of the happiest – and most devastating – moments of their lives. Before retirement, he would drive two hours to Planned Parenthood and help teach the next generation of health care providers, like my sister. And no one – not Fox News, and especially not extremists like Lauren Boebert or my new Republican opponent – is going to stop my family from continuing to stand up for a woman’s right to choose.
**We already scared off Lauren Boebert. In 2022, I came just 546 votes shy of winning this House seat. I’m ready to finish the job and replace Boebert in Congress in November, but these are the kinds of ugly attacks that I’m already up against.**
[**Please, if you can afford to, will you give $5 or more right now to my campaign to help me win this critical House seat? Our race was the closest in the entire country in 2022. But I’m not taking money from corporate PACs, so I’m counting on grassroots donors like you if I’m going to win.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/92471142/497221255/1610638071?refcode=em20240909mid-nd&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C35%2C50%2C100%2C250&refcode2=6b60e48f-c46e-ef11-991a-6045bdd9e096&recurring=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2YjYwZTQ4Zi1jNDZlLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=r_NffCx51YpNXB54ofGr3coehD34cdKQRZAWZYSLxAY=)

| | **Kean Bill Aims to Provide Extended Care Services to Spouses of Veterans**
---
| | On Tuesday, Tom introduced the _[Home Health Aides for Veterans’ Spouses Act](https://link.tomkean.com/u/click?_t=9b7a451def6d4254858fc869cf07cd48&_m=0e2317d1203f4db09137040d9fba7971&_e=oQ0o3b9lsf5i86wQWnpWZYVihOhoy675yrhOpsAEZ4ABvSy48XE8Rz6x-kCZPumVqQKba_logDawZmIVpnNzNc6xt1Jnc5FcHA-izmNK7OwIF3XLR7UIK6MWpe_J4VKjAp5uHdDs8MjCajh9NIP_rT4sQsiPq8vg-RIHuFjQzZ_EY9SOGMm3WRDz8R89gJBc9knPaJt9kMo6D-1zPtzlmefz1N3SytKrlEhWAvgIJGuvLbAXCgVJh2qxgK5CQaWbBVLNeV_qfvlCh_NXs0BR7FWke26KVlp6_Z8WuuCGhzl56mi9JHFyrRY_9RHNCB0g)_ , a bill that would allow veterans who are over the age of 75 to defer their home health aide benefits to their spouses in extenuating circumstances.

This legislation was inspired by a 92-year-old Berkeley Heights veteran, Mr. John O’Connor, who requested that a VA home health aide assist his wife. The VA would not permit this and rejected this veteran’s appeal numerous times despite his pleas. Spouses of veterans can only obtain VA home health aide benefits upon the passing of their veteran spouse. This issue leaves some with limited to no access to home health aide services.

“Just as veterans have given so much in service to our country, their spouses have given just as much in support and sacrifice. This commonsense legislation was a direct response to Mr. O’Connor’s concern. He was informed by the VA that the only way he would be able to pass these benefits on to his wife were to pass away himself. The VA should have the leeway to share these benefits with veterans’ spouses if the need arises.” \- _**Congressman Tom Kean, Jr.**_

clean_body: Updates from our week in the field| | | | | Friend, | | Happy Monday! Welcome back to another edition of our weekly Kean for Congress newsletter update! Have you been keeping count? There are only 57 days until the Election. As November nears, we will all certainly be busy. But, if you could spare a bit of your time to help re-elect Tom, and help get the rest of our Republican ticket across the finish line, it would be greatly appreciated. We must hold this seat. The DCCC and far-left, extreme, groups are beginning to parachute into the district to work against us. We can beat them, but we need all hands on deck. A lot has happened since last Monday's update to you. Tom participated in Labor Day activities across two counties, wrapped up the final week of his In-District work period during the Summer Congressional Recess, we launched our first TV ad of the cycle, and announced another major endorsement. Our Field Team launched their new voter contact universe - focused on Get Out The Vote (GOTV) - and invested heavily in new volunteer recruitment. We expanded our door and phone schedules, and have have stocked-up on TK palm cards, lawn signs, and swag! More on all this hard work below. Use the sign up links below to find out how you can access some of these great perks. In my next edition of the newsletter, we will be launching a "VOTING RESOURCES" section which will outline important dates, FYIs, and everything you will need to know to cast your vote for Tom. Are you ready to work hard to deliver Republican victories in November, and send Tom Kean, Jr. back to Congress? To get involved,. Read more below to stay up-to-date on everything Kean for Congress has been up to! | | | | | | | 📺 Tom Kean, Jr. Launches First TV Ad "Trust" 📺 | | We just launched a BRAND NEW AD highlighting Tom’s proven track record of EXPELLING corruption— even within his own party —and being a Congressman worthy of your trust. The ad, "Trust" highlights Tom's work in Trenton and Washington, D.C. standing up to corrupt politicians, and his support of legislation to ban members of Congress from trading stocks and investing in America’s foreign adversaries. You need to see this... | | | | Kean Bill Aims to Provide Extended Care Services to Spouses of Veterans | | On Tuesday, Tom introduced the , a bill that would allow veterans who are over the age of 75 to defer their home health aide benefits to their spouses in extenuating circumstances. This legislation was inspired by a 92-year-old Berkeley Heights veteran, Mr. John O’Connor, who requested that a VA home health aide assist his wife. The VA would not permit this and rejected this veteran’s appeal numerous times despite his pleas. Spouses of veterans can only obtain VA home health aide benefits upon the passing of their veteran spouse. This issue leaves some with limited to no access to home health aide services. “Just as veterans have given so much in service to our country, their spouses have given just as much in support and sacrifice. This commonsense legislation was a direct response to Mr. O’Connor’s concern. He was informed by the VA that the only way he would be able to pass these benefits on to his wife were to pass away himself. The VA should have the leeway to share these benefits with veterans’ spouses if the need arises.” \- Congressman Tom Kean, Jr. | | | | | Field Update | | | | | | | | | | | | | | This past week, Tom attended the Mendham Borough Labor Day Parade, as well as the Scotch Plains UNICO Festival with many of our great local leaders. Tom also was able to door knock in Scotch Plains with members of the Scotch Plains GOP and the candidates running locally. Later in the week, Tom hosted a Senior Town Hall at Lantern Hill in New Providence, as well as a business round table with some of the state's leading business advocates in Westfield. In the meantime, our Field Team was busy throughout the week recruiting new volunteers, delivering yard signs, coordinating upcoming launches, and recruiting a fall internship class. Our door knocking program has continued with efforts covering towns like New Providence, Bridgewater, Warren, Westfield, Raritan Borough, Hillsborough, Hackettstown, and more! We also are hosting launches in coordination with our county and municipal organizations in the coming weeks in Springfield , Scotch Plains , Long Valley, Mountainside , Summit , Sparta , Washington Township , Chester Borough, Mendham Township , Raritan Township , Washington Borough , and more. We hope to see you there. Kean for Congress has expanded our phone banking efforts to three standing phone banks a week! This past week, we held our phone bank in Warren, Union, and Somerset counties. There, we launched our new phone universe to engage in conversations with our targeted Get Out The Vote (GOTV) voters. Last week alone, we matched our last week total with over 10,700 calls made! In the past two weeks, we have made over 23,000 calls to voters across both our GOTV and persuasion targets. We have a few more phone banks lined up in the coming weeks that you can join! Call for Volunteers!! The Kean for Congress team will have a significant door launch efforts in the coming weeks. Join Team Kean and local candidates as we knock on key swing-voter doors. Want to join us? Use the SIGN UP TO VOLUNTEER button below and details will be provided. Want to get involved? Join us at some of our upcoming weekly events! | | | | | | | | | | | | | | 🚨 UPCOMING EVENTS 🚨 | | | | | | | | 🚨 Endorsement Alerts 🚨 | | | | Since my last update, Tom has announced another major business endorsement: the U.S. Chamber of Commerce. See what they are saying: "We are proud to endorse Tom Kean for re-election. Tom has been a steadfast advocate for policies that promote economic growth and support the vitality of our business community. His dedication to cutting bureaucratic red tape, addressing labor shortages, and fostering innovation aligns perfectly with our mission to make New Jersey a more competitive state for business. We are confident that Tom's leadership will continue to drive prosperity for the 7th District." \- Nick Vaugh , Director of Government Affairs Follow our using this link for more endorsements to be announced in the coming days! | | | | | 🎥 More Local Leaders Endorse Tom Kean, Jr. 🎥 Click to watch! | | | | | | | Tom In The News | | | | | | | RESERVE A TOM KEAN LAWN SIGN | | | | | | | | | Get Involved : Join our team and help spread our message in the community. : Your contributions power our grassroots efforts and make a difference. mailto:JJ@TomKean.com "JJ@TomKean.com": The Kean for Congress Team is looking for dedicated and responsible high school and college age Republicans that are interested in a campaign internship. This is a great way to learn the ins and outs of campaign-style politics and have a true on-the-job campaign experience. We can also offer college credits and signing service hours. **From GoFundMe:** It is with heavy hearts that we announce the unexpected passing of **Wolfgang Niedert**. To honor his lifelong dedication to education and philanthropy, we ask that memorial contributions be made to a college fund for his beloved daughters, Sophie (9) and Oliva (5). In this time of overwhelming sorrow, we are incredibly grateful for the love and support from those whose lives were touched by Wolfgang.

**Personal note** : Wolfgang and I have been friends for at least ten years, with Texas athletics being our top shared interest. I have known Wolfgang and Julie both very well and their darling daughters are precious. His loss was sudden and shocking. His philanthropic work in Eanes ISD, at UT and across our community was significant. His large network of friends across Austin and Texas is understandably devastated. We must lift up this family. **I hope you will join Amy and I in supporting them at this time**.

* **TOP NEWS**

**" Texas Gov. Greg Abbott prepares emergency response for potential storm,"** Houston Chronicle's **Michael Garcia** -- "Gov. **Greg Abbott** on Sunday directed the Texas Division of Emergency Management to [prepare for additional state emergency response resources](https://substack.com/redirect/7acc8e29-b52a-42cf-a877-c08ddd832c50?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) ahead of potential impacts from [Tropical Storm Francine, which could form soon in the Gulf of Mexico](https://substack.com/redirect/27a38b11-4a08-4d6b-acfc-a8224507d7e4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
This comes as CenterPoint Energy representatives [announced they were monitoring and preparing for severe weather](https://substack.com/redirect/5b88b4f4-0b74-490c-8e75-113824b00e47?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) as a way to avoid widespread power outages such as those following Hurricane Beryl this summer.

According to the National Weather Service, a storm system moving through the Gulf of Mexico is likely to develop into a tropical storm, then to a hurricane before it arrives on the Gulf Coast. [According](https://substack.com/redirect/7acc8e29-b52a-42cf-a877-c08ddd832c50?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to Houston Chronicle's meteorologist **Justin Ballard** , heavy rain could come to the Houston area, with the potential for localized flooding.
[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER: $7/mo](https://substack.com/redirect/0bb77e18-ff71-431c-9705-a878bcb57342?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
"Texas stands ready to provide all available resources needed to support Texans as a severe storm system begins to move along the Gulf Coast that will bring potential flash flooding threats and heavy rain," Gov. **Greg Abbott** said in a statement, noting the state's division of emergency management would be deployed Monday morning. "Texans are urged to take the necessary precautions for potential tropical weather, including remaining weather aware, monitoring road conditions and having an emergency plan to ensure safety of themselves and their loved ones."

The Texas Division of Emergency Management issued an activation notice to the Texas Emergency Management Council agencies, increasing readiness level of the Texas State Operations Center to a 24-hour escalated response operations, a news release stated.
[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER: $70/yr](https://substack.com/redirect/0bb77e18-ff71-431c-9705-a878bcb57342?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Additional resources include search and rescue boat teams, helicopters with hoist capabilities, medical support teams, saw crews, support for agriculture and livestock needs, and teams to monitor road conditions and outages. These resources come from several agencies including the state's department of public safety, transportation, health services; Texas National Guard, Texas A&M, Texas Parks and Wildlife, Public Utility Commission of Texas, Railroad Commission of Texas and Texas Commission on Environmental Quality.

The tropical wave had been in Mexico's Bay of Campeche as of Sunday afternoon, the same time experts suggested the disturbance had a 90% chance of developing into a tropical depression or storm, according to the National Hurricane Center." body:
| | | |
---
| FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE: September 9, 2024
---
| Contact: Derek Dufresne derek@ascent-strategic.com; 202-809-6013
---
| MEDIA ADVISORY: Russell Prescott Election Night Party
---
|
---
| Kingston, NH \- Russell Prescott, small business owner, engineer, and former citizen legislator, is hosting an election night party at his historic property in Kingston, a popular venue for past Republican events.
The party will include primary night poll watching and the presidential debate! Free food and beverages are provided, and all are welcome and encouraged to bring fellow supporters.
Date: Tuesday, September 10, 2024
Location: 50 Little River Road, Kington, NH
Time: Doors open at 6 PM
For press attendance or to schedule an interview with Russell Prescott, please email Derek@Ascent-Strategic.com or text 202-809-6013.
---
|
---
| More about Russell Prescott: A New Hampshire native of the Seacoast, Russell Prescott grew up in Exeter and currently lives in Kingston. For several decades, he was the co-owner and vice-president of R.E. Prescott Company, a wholesale distributor and manufacturer of water treatment systems. He purchased the business in 2020 and is now the president and sole owner.
Russell practiced Professional Engineering for 30 years and designs many of the products his company manufactures. As a result, he holds several patents for removing arsenic and radon from water. The company, founded in 1954 by his father, employs approximately 50 people and has operated in the same Exeter building since 1963.
Wanting to give back to his community, Prescott served five terms as a New Hampshire State Senator, being first elected in 2000 for two terms. He was re-elected in 2010, 2012, and again in 2014. As Senator, he represented Senate Districts 19 and 23, including towns from Newmarket to Plaistow and Derry to Seabrook.
Prescott was then twice elected to the Executive Council, once in 2016 and again in 2018. He decided to retire from the Executive Council in 2021 after purchasing his company.
Russell enjoys home restoration and recently finished a restoration of a 1737 colonial barn and grist mill in his town. His community service included Exeter Rotary Club, Kingston Lions Club, and the board of directors for the Exeter Area Chamber of Commerce.
He and his wife, Susan, have been married for 42 years, and they have five grown children and eight grandchildren. Following in their grandfather's and father's footsteps, his oldest three children are heavily involved with the daily operation and vision of the family business.

clean_body: I want to take a moment to tell you what I know about Sue Altman — my friend, and one of WFP’s own, who is now running for Congress in one of the biggest House races of the year. | | | Hey Peter, it’s Maurice. I want to take a moment to tell you what Iknow about Sue Altman — my friend, and one of WFP’s own, who is now running for Congress in one of the biggest House races of the year. But before I get into it, I have to ask: Sue, an anti-corruption organizer, former teacher, professional basketball player, and four-year leader of the New Jersey Working Families Party, is the kind of leader who doesn’t just talk about change, Peter — she makes it happen. Throughout her career, she’s battled corruption, pushed for reforms, and has stood up for working people time and again. If there’s a picket line, you can bet Sue is right there. And if there’s an opportunity to lift up working people, she’s already seizing it or throwing her full weight behind it. I’ve seen firsthand how she’s gone toe-to-toe with some of the most entrenched political forces in the state, never backing down, even when the odds were stacked against her. From former Governor of New Jersey Chris Christie, to the “Dark Lord of South Jersey,” George Norcross, Sue has taken on corruption on both sides of the aisle — because she knows that fighting for working people means standing up to the powerful, no matter who they are. Now, Sue is running for Congress in New Jersey’s 7th District against Tom Kean Jr., an incumbent who has enabled the most extreme factions of the GOP. This is one of the highest-profile swing districts in the country, and it’s one of our best opportunities to take back the House and build real power for working families. I know Sue well enough to say this, Peter: she’s not only in this to block the far-right’s dangerous agenda. She’s in this to build something better — a government that works for all of us. She’s running to represent the people, not the powerful, and she’s running with the same fearless spirit that has defined her entire career. So I’m asking you today to stand with my friend, and beloved comrade, Sue Altman, as she runs for Congress in New Jersey’s 7th Congressional District. Let’s show her the strength of our movement and what we can achieve when we come together. In solidarity, Maurice Mitchell National Director, Working Families Party Thoughts? Feedback? body:

Vice President Kamala Harris and former President Donald Trump debate for the first time on September 10. It is the highest-stakes event to date for both candidates. In a race this close, it's not an exaggeration to say that the outcome in November could rest on how this 90-minute debate goes. Traditionally the viewership is the highest for the first debate between opponents as well, so this is the big one.
I debated Harris five times during the primary season of 2020, literally standing next to her several of those evenings. To say that I debated her is a little bit misleading though — she and I never got into a direct argument as it never made sense for either of us to be attacking the other. We had a good, friendly relationship on the campaign trail, and Harris was generally focused on the candidates above her, most notably Joe Biden in the first debate. I was focused on trying to get my message out and keep the campaign going; I tended to get less airtime than other candidates because I got fewer questions and generally played nice.
So, what would I say about Harris as a debater? She gets high marks for poise and being able to recall and deliver messages. She prefers to use notes, which makes sense given her legal background — she used the time before the moderators got started to reproduce notes on the notepaper we were given. (Note: I did the exact same thing.) She certainly has the stamina for a 90-minute debate. She'll expect hostility from Trump, and I expect her to be steady and strong. She was taken by surprise by Tulsi Gabbard's pointed and persistent attacks four years ago but there will be no surprise here. Outside of the primaries, she debated former Vice President Mike Pence four years ago, and I thought that she was clear and composed throughout.
Trump's debate style, on the other hand, is based on appearance and attacks — he'll stand there and run down his opponent. He's pugnacious, spontaneous and not overly substantive; some of what he says won't necessarily make sense or be true. He's a performer. The main way to prepare to face him is to load up with substance to be able to confidently call out his record and his misrepresentations and to match his energy. It's particularly important to come in strong at the beginning when viewership is highest, and the tone is set. I would literally be playing pump-up music and have Harris prepare for a prizefight. I'd also give her a bit of time away from the trail to make sure that her energy is high.
A lot of debate prep is memorizing 90-second responses to questions on different subject areas: foreign policy, economy, immigration, health care, education, etc. Harris' team has been preparing her for the debate for weeks, including mock debates with an experienced Trump stand-in. I'm sure she's had talking points accompanying her on the campaign trail to study and that recalling them won't be an issue. The truth is that when you're campaigning, you're often on a bus or a plane and either calling people or studying notes. She's had plenty of opportunity to get the substance down.
That said, I was a little bit surprised that some of these talking points weren't more clearly evident in her recent CNN interview. You can often pick up on debate prep in interviews, because if someone has been memorizing paragraphs in response to various cues they will naturally utilize them when asked any related question.
Harris will benefit from the visual — she is 19 years younger than Trump and looks like it. She is almost always clearer and more coherent. For her, the main issue is to come across as presidential and commanding for 90 minutes. If she does this, she'll have a good night.
Trump, on the other hand, could stand to demonstrate some self-control and that he's still sharp. President Joe Biden's performance in June was so abysmal that Trump benefited from the contrast. He won't have that advantage against Harris.
Which candidate has more to gain or lose? It's clearly Harris. Trump is a known quantity, while for many Americans Harris is still new and introducing herself. Can people see her as president? Are the memes of her delivering faulty responses simply internet fodder that she can dismiss with a strong performance? If she is resolute, confident and unflappable for 90 minutes against Trump she'll be in a much stronger position.
Some debates don't change a race that much; viewers simply think that the candidate they prefer did great. This race remains neck-and-neck, and the debate is the most important night for both campaigns. The last debate knocked a candidate out. Will history be made on Tuesday night?
If I were advising Harris' team, the main thing I would emphasize is to give her the chance to do whatever she finds most rejuvenating the day before and the day of the debate to make sure she is feeling good, energized, and ready to go. Make it so she's happy to be there to take it to Trump.
Campaigns have a tendency to overwork candidates — Biden showed up to the first debate under the weather and overprepared, and was reduced to grasping for factoids that were clearly eluding him.
I had a bad night my first debate, so my team switched gears from having me do interviews the day before to me shooting hoops with friends. My performance went up, so we stuck with that as a new routine for debate day for the next five debates. It made me happier to be on the stage because I would have had a good, invigorating day the day before.
Harris struck me as a bit worn down during her CNN interview. And she has never met Trump face-to-face, so it will feel awkward and uncomfortable. I have the sense that her team is treating everything as a sprint given the compressed time frame and her relative youth. That would be a mistake. Harris will have to bring a much higher level of energy next Tuesday than she did for the joint interview with her vice-presidential pick, Minnesota Gov. Tim Walz. After all, Joe Biden didn't get a second debate this season. Harris and her team should approach this as if it's the only debate of the year, because it might as well be.

clean_body: Vice President Kamala Harris and former President Donald Trump debate for the first time on Sept. 10. It is the highest-stakes event to date for both candidates. | | | September 09, 2024 | | | | Vice President Kamala Harris and former President Donald Trump debate for the first time on September 10. It is the highest-stakes event to date for both candidates. In a race this close, it's not an exaggeration to say that the outcome in November could rest on how this 90-minute debate goes. Traditionally the viewership is the highest for the first debate between opponents as well, so this is the big one. I debated Harris five times during the primary season of 2020, literally standing next to her several of those evenings. To say that I debated her is a little bit misleading though — she and I never got into a direct argument as it never made sense for either of us to be attacking the other. We had a good, friendly relationship on the campaign trail, and Harris was generally focused on the candidates above her, most notably Joe Biden in the first debate. I was focused on trying to get my message out and keep the campaign going; I tended to get less airtime than other candidates because I got fewer questions and generally played nice. So, what would I say about Harris as a debater? She gets high marks for poise and being able to recall and deliver messages. She prefers to use notes, which makes sense given her legal background — she used the time before the moderators got started to reproduce notes on the notepaper we were given. (Note: I did the exact same thing.) She certainly has the stamina for a 90-minute debate. She'll expect hostility from Trump, and I expect her to be steady and strong. She was taken by surprise by Tulsi Gabbard's pointed and persistent attacks four years ago but there will be no surprise here. Outside of the primaries, she debated former Vice President Mike Pence four years ago, and I thought that she was clear and composed throughout. Trump's debate style, on the other hand, is based on appearance and attacks — he'll stand there and run down his opponent. He's pugnacious, spontaneous and not overly substantive; some of what he says won't necessarily make sense or be true. He's a performer. The main way to prepare to face him is to load up with substance to be able to confidently call out his record and his misrepresentations and to match his energy. It's particularly important to come in strong at the beginning when viewership is highest, and the tone is set. I would literally be playing pump-up music and have Harris prepare for a prizefight. I'd also give her a bit of time away from the trail to make sure that her energy is high. A lot of debate prep is memorizing 90-second responses to questions on different subject areas: foreign policy, economy, immigration, health care, education, etc. Harris' team has been preparing her for the debate for weeks, including mock debates with an experienced Trump stand-in. I'm sure she's had talking points accompanying her on the campaign trail to study and that recalling them won't be an issue. The truth is that when you're campaigning, you're often on a bus or a plane and either calling people or studying notes. She's had plenty of opportunity to get the substance down. That said, I was a little bit surprised that some of these talking points weren't more clearly evident in her recent CNN interview. You can often pick up on debate prep in interviews, because if someone has been memorizing paragraphs in response to various cues they will naturally utilize them when asked any related question. Harris will benefit from the visual — she is 19 years younger than Trump and looks like it. She is almost always clearer and more coherent. For her, the main issue is to come across as presidential and commanding for 90 minutes. If she does this, she'll have a good night. Trump, on the other hand, could stand to demonstrate some self-control and that he's still sharp. President Joe Biden's performance in June was so abysmal that Trump benefited from the contrast. He won't have that advantage against Harris. Which candidate has more to gain or lose? It's clearly Harris. Trump is a known quantity, while for many Americans Harris is still new and introducing herself. Can people see her as president? Are the memes of her delivering faulty responses simply internet fodder that she can dismiss with a strong performance? If she is resolute, confident and unflappable for 90 minutes against Trump she'll be in a much stronger position. Some debates don't change a race that much; viewers simply think that the candidate they prefer did great. This race remains neck-and-neck, and the debate is the most important night for both campaigns. The last debate knocked a candidate out. Will history be made on Tuesday night? If I were advising Harris' team, the main thing I would emphasize is to give her the chance to do whatever she finds most rejuvenating the day before and the day of the debate to make sure she is feeling good, energized, and ready to go. Make it so she's happy to be there to take it to Trump. Campaigns have a tendency to overwork candidates — Biden showed up to the first debate under the weather and overprepared, and was reduced to grasping for factoids that were clearly eluding him. I had a bad night my first debate, so my team switched gears from having me do interviews the day before to me shooting hoops with friends. My performance went up, so we stuck with that as a new routine for debate day for the next five debates. It made me happier to be on the stage because I would have had a good, invigorating day the day before. Harris struck me as a bit worn down during her CNN interview. And she has never met Trump face-to-face, so it will feel awkward and uncomfortable. I have the sense that her team is treating everything as a sprint given the compressed time frame and her relative youth. That would be a mistake. Harris will have to bring a much higher level of energy next Tuesday than she did for the joint interview with her vice-presidential pick, Minnesota Gov. Tim Walz. After all, Joe Biden didn't get a second debate this season. Harris and her team should approach this as if it's the only debate of the year, because it might as well be. subject: [SIGN ON] Demand the Supreme Court support gender-affirming medical care
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
Tennessee’s ban on gender-affirming care puts trans people at greater risk of gun violence and suicide
#

Friends -
In Tennessee, there is a dangerous law in place that makes it unlawful for doctors to prescribe puberty blockers or hormones to youth as part of gender-affirming medical care, even when individual patients, their parents, and their healthcare providers agree that such care is medically necessary. Now, it has been brought to the Supreme Court in the case _United States v. Skrmetti._
Tennessee’s ban on gender-affirming care puts trans people at greater risk of gun violence and suicide. That’s why we filed an amicus brief last week with other gun violence prevention organizations to call on the Supreme Court to strike down this harmful law.
[**If you agree that Tennessee's ban on gender-affirming medical care must be struck down, please sign our petition today to demand action from SCOTUS:**](https://go.giffords.org/signup/giffords_em_skrmetti_pet_sep24/?source=em240909-1-30&refcode2=8896.3935704.D0qIHF&akid=8896%2E3935704%2ED0qIHF)
**[ADD YOUR NAME](https://go.giffords.org/signup/giffords_em_skrmetti_pet_sep24/?source=em240909-1-30&refcode2=8896.3935704.D0qIHF&akid=8896%2E3935704%2ED0qIHF)**
Transgender youth should be able to access medically necessary care, which includes gender-affirming care. Laws that deny gender-affirming medical care endanger young people. Forty percent of transgender people report having attempted suicide, and with firearms in the mix, suicide attempts are significantly more fatal.
The Supreme Court must do the right thing and strike down Tennessee’s dangerous ban on gender-affirming medical care. Tennessee's law is an egregious violation of LGBTQ+ rights and a danger to the trans community.
[**Please, join us in demanding that the Supreme Court strikes down Tennessee's ban on gender-affirming medical care.**](https://go.giffords.org/signup/giffords_em_skrmetti_pet_sep24/?source=em240909-1-30&refcode2=8896.3935704.D0qIHF&akid=8896%2E3935704%2ED0qIHF)

Thank you for using your voice. Trans people deserve to live as their truest selves, and we will always fight for their safety and mental well-being.
\- Team GIFFORDS

### Feature:
### Part I: DeSantis' office releases personnel file of state parks whistleblower
If you haven't caught up with my Substack in a while, here's the recap:[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/cec7c95b-8420-4d03-9d8d-bf3cbabb0566?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[James Gaddis](https://substack.com/redirect/cec7c95b-8420-4d03-9d8d-bf3cbabb0566?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) is the Department of Environmental Protection geographer who blew the whistle on DeSantis' secret plan to turn state parks into private resorts and golf courses.
The state recently[ fired him](https://substack.com/redirect/d67c0706-bdad-4570-a66d-066f94186234?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for leaking documents to the press about the Desantis administration's detailed plans to privatize some of Florida's most coveted state parks.
Yes -- another geographer turned whistleblower retaliated against by the state for alerting the public about wrongdoing by DeSantis. Deja Vu.
In lock-step with the retaliation experienced by myself and [other whistleblowers](https://substack.com/redirect/8a697029-1982-428e-b2fc-25fa4bcf59a5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), members of DeSantis' media team (which you can read about [here](https://substack.com/redirect/a10b96bc-aabf-41bc-b478-6dc5f193ea91?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), [here,](https://substack.com/redirect/2aff9ae8-b3fe-45d0-9ba7-98d6ffae2981?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) [here](https://substack.com/redirect/6975dd8d-8958-41f9-9cf7-76eba90f2973?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), [here](https://substack.com/redirect/66d1995a-2830-4e09-b702-9638ebad36e6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and [here](https://substack.com/redirect/87bce91f-9f2c-4d92-a2f6-faf61d0a5cc4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)) leaked James' personnel file to the press.
I am not going to link to the file because the story here is not the contents of his file -- which posed no issue with the state _before_ James blew the whistle -- it's the retaliation.
I was fired without cause. The libelous justifications came after the media got ahold of the story.
James was fired, according to his termination letter, for releasing information to the public that he was not authorized to release - plans that should have gone through a lengthy review and public comment period but instead were being rushed to approval under the radar.
Yet, officials from DeSantis' office have released a file that _they_ have no authority to release to retaliate against James for single-handedly shutting down the plan to destroy Florida's public parks.
No one expects DeSantis' criminal media gang to be fired for that. DeSantis' administration has been defined by law-breaking and revenge. It's to be expected now.
What disappointed me was how quickly Florida media -- media that know the playbook, know why the state released the file, know how they're being manipulated -- published the details of the file anyway.
A few of Florida's best reporters [called out](https://substack.com/redirect/7a2b893b-6fa8-4810-b419-bdee5ece2887?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the leak for what it is -- retaliation. A few [noted ](https://substack.com/redirect/3b9e7697-f3aa-436c-9161-e4c2bf30f9f6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)how "unusual" it was for the state to provide information on an employee that they would otherwise never get, but published it anyway.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/35f8f9c6-8ced-4c84-be8b-db32beb9f1ce?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
_At what point does the media become culpable for enabling retaliation?_
I've asked myself this question a lot over the years, but seeing it happen to another person puts the issue in stark perspective.
Reporters _should_ have covered how someone in DeSantis' comms team, per their own policies, should be fired for releasing another department employee's personnel file.
They _should_ have written about DeSantis' previous use of such documents to smear and retaliate against whistleblowers.
They _should_ have merely summarized the report, stating "none of the contents in the personnel file are relevant to what James Gaddis blew the whistle on, nor were they of concern before he blew the whistle."
Max Chesnes of the Tampa Bay Times did a fairly decent job summarizing DeSantis' history of retaliating against whistleblowers (with one glaring omission), but even he included the details of the report, none of which had been substantiated. Reporting another person's accusations without any evidence is giving legitimacy to something that has never been proven. It's reckless, at best.
The leak appears to have come from Jeremy Redfern -- DeSantis' press secretary. He got his job after spending months defaming and trolling me online. He had no relevant experience or expertise for the position he was initially hired to -- which was press secretary for the Florida Department of Health.
Given the[ recent coverage ](https://substack.com/redirect/87bce91f-9f2c-4d92-a2f6-faf61d0a5cc4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)of how these online trolls are paid handsome sums of money to spread conspiracy theories and propaganda online, the question of how unqualified internet trolls got into six-figure salary positions in the Governor's office should be asked -- and the media needs to demand an answer.
That brings us to Part II of this piece:
### Demand transparency from online influencers -- conservative _and_ liberal
A lot of people are paid to be online.
Whether it's ad revenue sharing programs, like those on TikTok or Twitter, or direct sponsorships, partnerships or "investors," you should always demand to know who is paying the people you follow, listen to, buy from or subscribe to.
To keep in line with my own professed ethics, here's a summary of what I make, from where/whom, and the average per year from each source. Some of these sources are highly variable, and change from year to year. This is my best, most honest attempt to give you a full accounting based on the last three years of activity:
**Through ad revenue sharing programs*:**
* $500/year from Twitter. I monetized my account there last year. My average monthly payment from Twitter has been between $40-$100, regardless of whether I've gotten 1 million view or 1 million views in a month.
* Negligible amount from Meta (<$300 a year). Only my Instagram is monetized with Meta and it's the account I have the smallest reach of all my social media profiles.
* TikTok: monetized last year and highly variable, between $200-$1,800 per month, including brand offers (e.g. stitchfix or products) and bonuses. I've only done one brand partnership so far. I've been offered others and tried their products but I promised not to advertise bad products so only one met my standards.

*Ad revenue sharing programs are, theoretically, based on the number of views your content receives (TikTok), or the number of people of who see ads underneath your content (Twitter). Since advertisers pay these social media sites money to place ads, you are given a small fraction of the revenue the site gets from putting it on your content.
**Through subscriptions:**
* Substack: $15-22k/per year
I started my Substack in February 2021. I did not put any of my work with tracking COVID-19 in Florida or in schools nationwide behind a paywall because I did not believe that information should cost money. Instead, I posted it for free and people donated whatever they could or wanted to.

**Through direct payments:**
* About $1-2k per year combined for op-ed honorariums [like this one](https://substack.com/redirect/1933d04a-8092-4afb-92c3-5950ece6fd60?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

Full disclosure: I have been offered fairly large amounts of money to speak in foreign countries, but I've never done it. The one offer I would have liked to take was to speak at the AGI annual conference in Scotland (I was offered twice). I might take them up on that next year. My flight and hotel during my recent trip to Greece were paid for by a French-based legal organization that represents international whistleblowers, but I received no direct payment.
I have been paid a percent to help Democratic candidates fundraise in the past, but I'm not going to have the time to do that now that I've started working.
That's it. No private investors, no special interests, no secret Soros money.
Just you guys. That's how I've survived these past few years.
Whether it's an influencer or a media group, demand that all online personalities, creators and political people online be as transparent with you as I have been.

I have been a known conservative in Hollywood throughout my career. It wasn’t always easy, but the latest from the bankrupt elites in my town really got to me.

After President Trump was shot, the only echo reverberating through my so-called “community” was a regret that the assassin failed to kill him. Weeks later, on a zoom call: White Dudes for Kamala. In a masterpiece of intolerance, in a breathtakingly short period of time, we learned what they are all about: _Hatred and Racism._ **Pathetic**.

I refuse to rail about the Democrats and what they have inflicted upon this country. We all know about their shortcomings, and we all know the kind of future we can bank on should they remain in power.

[**I believe Curtis Bashaw is the right kind of man to send to Washington to promote well-being in New Jersey and the United States at large. We can look to him to protect the Jersey Shore.**](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=5b243d04e31f4aff890813eb1bf96e46&_e=FMQR88VtUvG9F6cG2KBMfuHhbiWQgHO7t67B8tFQwk5FWqt6Mvul5HSBturv_Fa2QcOeicOYUCzQzty2UgdvqDqwE2kMHwIhM3o-Op3XSkxD_jxSbu1tGIXYxJXGo2bdhrGs1PAbJaiP74H8ddiCLmY8GVWAJAXoJd-Oa8Lz2S9ruycGbeQB4JUXUoEBhN18AydiknkwOTssIcGS-tG8UqHCMKcofsN8g8iaKEIQcZ_BcTm8tkC_388GieX7U8lrP4ynf15OTBsa93Ceqk_mEKAR_2_XxX4lYFrwjrsZ1k8A76vQl73ziMlFpf0LHUAzhd6eDgN3FKMUTduvfqxIhctShX1uKWEsIRlAX26CuLI3ovpVY5AlJyYWInh7nvxFnLmjgns1FKHQAQRjx9jYspfWNr9lqDS0-cdP_LhsZgQ%3D)

We can look to him to promote prosperity for all—a good paycheck and food we can afford. But more importantly, he is a good man. A man of good character. A man whose voice can be trusted as he raises his hand to preserve the Constitution of the United States. Our Constitution.

[**There comes a time when we have to speak out in support of our nation’s traditional values. For Patriotism. For the right to pursue happiness on our own terms.**](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=5b243d04e31f4aff890813eb1bf96e46&_e=FMQR88VtUvG9F6cG2KBMfuHhbiWQgHO7t67B8tFQwk5FWqt6Mvul5HSBturv_Fa2QcOeicOYUCzQzty2UgdvqDqwE2kMHwIhM3o-Op3XSkxD_jxSbu1tGIXYxJXGo2bdhrGs1PAbJaiP74H8ddiCLmY8GVWAJAXoJd-Oa8Lz2S9ruycGbeQB4JUXUoEBhN18AydiknkwOTssIcGS-tG8UqHCMKcofsN8g8iaKEIQcZ_BcTm8tkC_388GieX7U8lrP4ynf15OTBsa93Ceqk_mECyNYdJKIQ6XjXJjtXhEU7CPNY5lBXTNUJHB3gHA80ldnG3uf0M0Rad9ZDqduydxLWL5_pZuIQkzWOn30Lejd9efnFhMoln6iAXm0fk0AF0QoscZT5ZkaF_oYuRrjjVUnQPa2gPNbhVfdnmP2cdcP9c%3D)
