We need a remedy for what Washington has been doing.

Curtis Bashaw in the United States Senate could be that remedy or at least a good part of it.

Please join me in supporting Curtis Bashaw.

Cheerfully and flag-wavingly yours!

Kelsey Grammer

| **_GET TO KNOW CURTIS_**

**Curtis Bashaw is a hotel entrepreneur, job creator, and preservationist. He's running for United States Senate to provide greater freedom and opportunities for all New Jerseyans.**

A lifelong New Jersey resident, Curtis grew up in Camden County and spent his summers at the Jersey Shore working as a bellhop and waiting tables at Congress Hall in Cape May. He has spent his life in the real estate and hospitality industries, and is the Founder and Managing Partner of Cape Resorts, a hotel company focusing on the restoration and operation of classic American resort properties in New Jersey and New York.

Throughout his career, Curtis has worked to build communities and bring people together. He is widely recognized for leading the landmark restorations of Congress Hall and the Virginia Hotel in Cape May, and for launching creative programming to dramatically extend Cape May's season, a catalyst for the economic rebirth of one of the Jersey Shore's most beautiful communities.

Curtis is a successful businessman and job creator, employing more than 1,000 people in New Jersey and New York. Curtis' company owns and operates eight hotels, ten cottages, six restaurants, four retail outlets and a working farm, all on the Jersey Shore and Long Island's East End. Curtis lives in Cape May with his husband, Will.

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

body:
Last week, Pennsylvania saw...
#
Derek,
Last week, Pennsylvania saw:
✔️Beta Simp McCormick confuse Philadelphia, Mississippi with Philadelphia, Pennsylvania
---
Well, that’s what happens when you only learn about “Philadelphia” through a Google News alert from your mansion in Connecticut. The GOP loves propping up any Joe Schmoe from out of state who has every intention to sell out Pennsylvanians the minute he gets to Washington DC. _(Remember Dr. Oz?)_
This year, the GOP wants to elect a puppet to sign a blank check to corporations and millionaires looking to pass bills that support their interests at the expense of the American taxpayer. In order to do so, they need a good, honest man like Bob Casey to lose his election.
Truth is, they don’t like the way Senator Casey advocates for everyday, hard-working Pennsylvanians. I’ve seen it firsthand as the other Senator from PA. Bob Casey is a man who fights the good fight.
**[If you can afford to contribute $5 to his election campaign right now, click this link here.](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/50012?refcode=em20240909-9365&t=1&akid=9365%2E434096%2EGtl9cc)**
**[DONATE TO BOB CASEY »](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/50012?refcode=em20240909-9365&t=2&akid=9365%2E434096%2EGtl9cc)**
✔️Alpha Simp Vance lie to Erie
---|---
Junior Senator JD Vance had a lot to say about how his ticket was going to help average Americans and lift Erie up from the “failed policies of Joe Biden.” He lied about Kamala Harris wanting to put truckers out of jobs and about taking jobs away from Erie.
I’ve got news for you, JD: Erie has _not_ failed. Instead, President Biden and Vice President Harris’s Investing in America Agenda has unleashed nearly $4.5 billion in private sector investment in PA. That’s on top of $18.1 billion in public investments in clean energy, infrastructure, and manufacturing.
We’ve created 544,200 new jobs under the Biden administration and business has been booming in PA with 527,400 applications filed to start a new business under the Biden-Harris administration.
Under soon-to-be President Kamala Harris, we’re going to continue that direct investment into every Pennsylvanian community. We’re going to lift up the middle class and make sure policies that benefit the taxpayer – not corporations or billionaires – get signed into law.
✔️And now Trump is twisting the truth about his proposed tariff tax hikes. Even right-wing experts are calling him out.
---|---|---
Economists agree. Trump’s proposed tax benefits will add THOUSANDS to household costs just like they did under his first term. Don’t take my word for it:
**[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240909-bc?refcode=em20240909-9365&refcode2=9365_434096_Gtl9cc&akid=9365%2E434096%2EGtl9cc)**
Trump kinda just says stuff. He needs to put out zingers to deceive folks into voting for him but we all know what’s going to happen if he gets into the Oval Office – he’s going to serve himself.
On the other hand, we have an experienced prosecutor, legislator, and sharp legal-mind running to move this country forward with joy and happiness. The choice almost makes itself!
Pennsylvania has had to endure a lot of tomfoolery coming from Republicans this week. Why don’t we make sure PA has joy instead for years to come by supporting Democrats up and down the ballot in November?
**[This November we need to elect Democrats into the White House, Senate, House of Representatives and other critical offices all around the nation. Will you consider making a $5 donation right now to keep the Senate blue in PA?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240909-bc?refcode=em20240909-9365&refcode2=9365_434096_Gtl9cc&akid=9365%2E434096%2EGtl9cc)**

❤️ John
John Fetterman
U.S. Senator from Pennsylvania

Hi there, Travis Brimm here, DASS Executive Director. Like many, I’m sure you’ve been laser-focused on the presidential race. I know I have! With Kamala Harris and Tim Walz at the top of the ticket, it’s an exciting time. But there is one race NO ONE is talking about: **Democrat Elaine Marshall’s re-election for North Carolina Secretary of State. ** Marshall holds the pivotal role of certifying election results for both federal and state elections in this crucial swing state. | Friend,
There is little question this great nation is faced with serious issues that need to be addressed at the state and federal level. Montanans face $11,400 higher annual costs due to skyrocketing debt, $5.5 trillion in new spending, and record inflation. Strong leadership is essential as the Democrat Party continues its unsuccessful progressive experiment. We are only a couple short weeks away from absentee ballots being sent out here in the Treasure State. Now, more than ever, I need your help in reaching voters to communicate our common sense, conservative, Montana First message. I am asking for friends like you to help me over the November finish line.

body:
Please read the following message from our sponsor.

Dear Fellow Conservative,

The anti-critical race theory movement
is gaining traction both ideologically and politically. And that
has progressives both outraged and panicked.

They'll do anything they can to stop
this movement. Their latest strategy is to distort the truth and
mislead the American people so that they can continue to push
their Marxist agenda. And they are using their friends in the
establishment media and Big Tech to do so.

But these lies are being unmasked and
exposed by The Heritage Foundation.

That's why I'm sending you this email
today.

I'm told that you are an American who
is concerned about the levels of indoctrination we've seen from
Critical Race Theory-and what that could mean for the future of
our country.

So, today, I want to send you a FREE
copy of The Heritage Foundation's latest eBook, The 5 Lies of
CRT.

Inside this important resource, you'll
not only learn the 5 lies Progressives have employed in their
campaign to push Critical Race Theory, but you'll also discover
that:

None of CRT's policy approaches
would help people of any race or national origin.

All of the biggest names pushing
CRT have affirmed that they are promoting Marxism.

The Left is using CRT to wage a
battle royal for the soul of America-and even the West itself.

You can get instant access to your FREE
eBook right now using this secure link:
https://secured.heritage.org/5lies-of-crt-ebook/

As the Left ramps up their campaign

really going on.

I hope this is a helpful resource for
you.

Best,

We’re only going to win this fight with broad grassroots support from patriots like you. | Dear fellow patriot – I’m going to simplify this as much as I can.

We have _**two months**_ until election day. We’re trailing Sherrod Brown by single digits but being massively outraised and outspent. Ohio is one of the few toss-up Senate races in the country that we can flip to give conservatives back the Senate majority. Even if we get President Trump back in the White House, we can’t pass anything without that majority. We’re only going to win this fight with broad grassroots support from patriots like you, fellow patriot. You may not think your $5 contribution today will make a difference in this race, but it all adds up. We need your support. Are you in?

Sincerely,

Through his relentless work ethic and untamable entrepreneurial spirit, he turned the first car dealership that he purchased in 2005 into one of the largest dealership groups in America.

In 2016, Bernie recognized the value and transformational potential of blockchain technology, before it received mainstream attention, and moved much of his volunteer time and investment dollars into the space. In 2018 he co-founded ChampTitles, which grew to be quite successful as Bernie served as Chairman of the Board.

After a long, successful career, Bernie sold most of his business to begin focusing on his calling: protecting the American dream for another generation.

Solving our country’s problems requires common sense. In Washington, Bernie will fight to shrink government, protect our freedoms, stop the Chinese Communist party from taking our data and land, and always put America First.

Ohioans are done with politicians who talk a big game and do nothing. Bernie wants to go to D.C. to get work done – just like he always has.

body:
it’s no secret that Congress is a pretty dysfunctional place

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/92482689/497261730/-240735101?refcode=email-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NTc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzZWUyOTVlNC1kYjZlLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=eMQIa4xlRyLAZPAfgfayi9qqAXLtToi19dSlTrRXn80=) It’s no secret that Congress is a pretty dysfunctional place. Far too often, partisan politics takes precedence over what’s best for the American people. You would think, then, that when something real got accomplished, it would be big news. But in reality, some of the most important accomplishments end up flying under the radar. So when I helped seniors across Kansas save hundreds of dollars in insulin every year, there weren’t exactly wall-to-wall cable news headlines. When the bipartisan infrastructure law I fought for kickstarted over 300 construction projects here in Kansas, it didn’t trend on Twitter. And when we brought in millions of dollars to fund broadband expansion in rural communities, no, the New York Times didn’t send a camera crew to our office to cover it. **The fact is, I’m proud of my record** of cutting through the partisanship and delivering real progress for Kansas families. But we can’t expect anyone to get that message out for us — **it’s up to us, this team, to reach every single voter and show them what we’ve gotten done.** [_**Can I count on you to pitch in a few dollars today and help us do exactly that? We need to show the people of KS-03 what this campaign is about — before our well-funded opponents try to define us first. body:
freedomva.org [freedomva.org]
Friends-
Halloween is well over a month away, so why are Virginians being spooked by surprise junk fees? Hotels, airlines and other industries with hidden fees are making it harder for people to see their loved ones. Surprise junk fees continue to burden hard working families, with consumers often paying 20% more at checkout than was advertised [https://www.whitehouse.gov/wp-content/uploads/2023/03/WH-Junk-Fees-Guide-for-States.pdf] .
Earlier this year, the Biden-Harris Administration and the FCC worked to crack down on surprise junk fees, citing new research showing how corporate price gouging harms Americans and small businesses.
https://www.whitehouse.gov/briefing-room/statements-releases/2024/03/05/fact-sheet-president-biden-announces-new-actions-to-lower-costs-for-americans-by-fighting-corporate-rip-offs/ [https://www.whitehouse.gov/briefing-room/statements-releases/2024/03/05/fact-sheet-president-biden-announces-new-actions-to-lower-costs-for-americans-by-fighting-corporate-rip-offs/]
See the Full Fact Sheet Here [https://www.whitehouse.gov/briefing-room/statements-releases/2024/03/05/fact-sheet-president-biden-announces-new-actions-to-lower-costs-for-americans-by-fighting-corporate-rip-offs/]
As work is being done to ban surprise junk fees at the federal level, we are fighting to ban surprise junk fees here in Virginia. We stood behind SB388 [https://lis.virginia.gov/cgi-bin/legp604.exe?241+sum+SB388] , which was dubbed “ the most sweeping consumer protection measure to emerge in this year’s General Assembly session [https://richmond.com/news/state-regional/government-politics/virginia-junk-fees-ticket-prices-general-assembly/article_cc8b56d0-d1d2-11ee-9b8c-6b88a06b9349.html] ” by the Richmond Times Dispatch. Though SB 388 did not make it to the governor’s desk, we are working harder than ever to ensure that Virginians are able to keep more of what they earn in the fight against corporate price gouging.
We are so thankful for your support in making Virginia affordable.
Shinji Oh

Here’s what I’m fighting for:
| | |

Can I tell you a story about my family farm, friend?
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/92484172/497267323/1743277108?refcode=jtk4711-bu-nd&amounts=250,100,50,25,5&&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzYjc4MzM2NS1kZTZlLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=unSaJuzo8Z1PY42OkCePARqx2LEQVFNxTjuZOMz3XZY=)
In 1910, my grandfather came to Montana. He found a piece of grassy land, took a look at it, and said, “This is the place.” And that’s where the farm began.
He farmed the land until the early 1940s, and then passed it down to my folks. In 1978, my wife Sharla and I took over the farm and we’re still here today, three generations and more than 40 years later.
We’ve made a lot of progress here – Sharla and I built a new home, several steel buildings, and more storage.
The truth is, I love this work. Yes, it makes for early mornings and late nights during planting and harvest seasons – but it also keeps me grounded, and it gives me perspective on the issues we face every day.
When I think about climate change, I’m thinking of folks on farms like mine, struggling with catastrophic droughts or historic levels of flooding. When I think about reforming the USPS, I’m thinking of the people in rural communities across Montana who rely on timely mail delivery for their medication or Social Security checks. And when I think about infrastructure, I’m thinking of the rural towns near mine that need access to affordable, high-speed internet.
**These aren’t abstract issues or talking points. They’re very real challenges that deserve real solutions, and that’s what I’m fighting for in Washington. I spend every single day trying to do right by working families, farmers, students, and veterans here in Montana and across the country.**
**[I’m running for reelection because there’s still work to be done. Just like my parents and grandparents on the family farm, when I commit to something, I see it through. Can you make a split donation of any amount today between my campaign and Jacky Rosen’s to help me keep up the fight in Washington?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/92484173/497267324/1743277108?refcode=jtk4711-bu-nd&amounts=250,100,50,25,5&&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzYjc4MzM2NS1kZTZlLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=unSaJuzo8Z1PY42OkCePARqx2LEQVFNxTjuZOMz3XZY=)**

I’ll leave you with one last truth about farming: Some years you get the right amount of rain, and things work out really well. Other years, you get a whole lot less.
That means it’s important to be prepared for any outcome, and to have a support system by your side when things get difficult. We don’t know what this campaign will look like, or what Republicans will throw our way over these final few months. But with your support, we’ll be ready.

clean_body: Here’s what I’m fighting for: | | | Can I tell you a story about my family farm, friend? = In 1910, my grandfather came to Montana. He found a piece of grassy land, took a look at it, and said, “This is the place.” And that’s where the farm began. He farmed the land until the early 1940s, and then passed it down to my folks. In 1978, my wife Sharla and I took over the farm and we’re still here today, three generations and more than 40 years later. We’ve made a lot of progress here – Sharla and I built a new home, several steel buildings, and more storage. The truth is, I love this work. Yes, it makes for early mornings and late nights during planting and harvest seasons – but it also keeps me grounded, and it gives me perspective on the issues we face every day. When I think about climate change, I’m thinking of folks on farms like mine, struggling with catastrophic droughts or historic levels of flooding. When I think about reforming the USPS, I’m thinking of the people in rural communities across Montana who rely on timely mail delivery for their medication or Social Security checks. And when I think about infrastructure, I’m thinking of the rural towns near mine that need access to affordable, high-speed internet. These aren’t abstract issues or talking points. They’re very real challenges that deserve real solutions, and that’s what I’m fighting for in Washington. I spend every single day trying to do right by working families, farmers, students, and veterans here in Montana and across the country. = | | = I’ll leave you with one last truth about farming: Some years you get the right amount of rain, and things work out really well. Other years, you get a whole lot less. That means it’s important to be prepared for any outcome, and to have a support system by your side when things get difficult. We don’t know what this campaign will look like, or what Republicans will throw our way over these final few months. But with your support, we’ll be ready. body:

Friends,
Let me cut right to the chase this afternoon...
We’ve got good news and bad news situations on our hands.
The good news?
August was our best fundraising month yet and we’re already outpacing our August numbers this month.
The bad news?
We need to double what we raised in August to hit our goal of $1 million for September, and we’re not quite there yet.
Our grassroots power is shaking the ULTRA-MAGA world to its core—and that’s exactly why we need your help to raise $1 million this month. Every dollar brings us closer to a victory for the people, not billionaires. Chip in now and show Jim Jordan we’re not backing down! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240909_1m_goal_link1]
You might ask yourself, why does this race need so many contributions and resources?
Well, since we’re a transparent, honest campaign built by the people, I’m going to give it to you straight and break down exactly what’s at stake here.
Polling shows we’ve closed the gap on Jim Jordan. He’s even losing Republican support because of his dysfunction, conspiracy theories, and his reputation as an abuse enabler.
We’re investing our resources in educating voters, but we need more to reach the voters who are on the fence.
Every dollar you give is a direct hit to his reputation. Let’s fight back with grassroots strength—can you pitch in today and help us hit our $1M goal? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240909_1m_goal_link2]
This race isn’t just about taking down Jordan; it’s about change, I’m standing up for the future my constituents really want.
Do we want a future led by a community-raised fighter for the people?
Or a future where right-wing cronies continue to prop up the most toxic, morally bankrupt man in Congress?
The ULTRA-MAGA world is seeing our polling numbers, and they’re sweating.
They know their puppet’s in trouble and are about to dump truckloads of cash into this race to save him.
We’ve got the people, the momentum, and the energy to win, but we need the funds to go head-to-head with the ULTRA-MAGA money machine. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240909_1m_goal_link3]
We’ve got the power to make history – and with your help, we will do it together.
Working for US,
Tamie Wilson

Friend -
Over the last month and change, there has been a lot of focus on the presidential race, and rightly so. We have also strongly encouraged you to pay attention to the U.S. Senate, and the impact it will have on our future, no matter who wins the race for the White House.
Then there is the U.S. House, the body that I currently serve in. Republicans currently have the narrowest of majorities and Democrats need to net just 5 seats to take control of the chamber.
Here’s the catch: it’s not just about flipping 5 Republican held seats, but about defending all of the seats currently held by Democrats.
And two of those critical races are very close to home for me.
In Michigan’s 8th congressional district, State Senator Kristen McDonald Rivet is running to replace the great Representative Dan Kildee. In the 7th district, Curtis Hertel is running for my seat. I’m proud to be supporting both of these fantastic candidates with records of fighting for Michigan’s working families.
Please use this link to split a donation to their campaigns:

Can I tell you a story about my family farm, Derek?
[](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=sept2024_abs_em_tester.YX0MSm&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_GEN_AC90_20240909_PM1_V1_S1&t=3&akid=7450%2E5257348%2Ewp82Tn)
In 1910, my grandfather came to Montana. He found a piece of grassy land, took a look at it, and said, “This is the place.” And that’s where the farm began.
He farmed the land until the early 1940s and then passed it down to my folks. In 1978, my wife Sharla and I took over the farm and we’re still here today, three generations and more than 40 years later.
We’ve made a lot of progress here — Sharla and I built a new home, several steel buildings, and more storage.
The truth is, I love this work. Yes, it makes for early mornings and late nights during planting and harvest seasons — but it also keeps me grounded, and it gives me perspective on the issues we face every day.
When I think about climate change, I’m thinking of folks on farms like mine, struggling with catastrophic droughts or historic levels of flooding. When I think about reforming the USPS, I’m thinking of the people in rural communities across Montana who rely on timely mail delivery for their medication or Social Security checks. And when I think about infrastructure, I’m thinking of the rural towns near mine that need access to affordable, high-speed internet.
**These aren’t abstract issues or talking points. They’re very real challenges that deserve real solutions, and that’s what I’m fighting for in Washington. I spend every single day trying to do right by working families, farmers, students, and veterans here in Montana and across the country.**
**[I’m running for reelection because there’s still work to be done. Just like my parents and grandparents on the family farm, when I commit to something, I see it through. clean_body: | Can I tell you a story about my family farm, Derek? In 1910, my grandfather came to Montana. He found a piece of grassy land, took a look at it, and said, “This is the place.” And that’s where the farm began. He farmed the land until the early 1940s and then passed it down to my folks. In 1978, my wife Sharla and I took over the farm and we’re still here today, three generations and more than 40 years later. We’ve made a lot of progress here — Sharla and I built a new home, several steel buildings, and more storage. The truth is, I love this work. Yes, it makes for early mornings and late nights during planting and harvest seasons — but it also keeps me grounded, and it gives me perspective on the issues we face every day. When I think about climate change, I’m thinking of folks on farms like mine, struggling with catastrophic droughts or historic levels of flooding. When I think about reforming the USPS, I’m thinking of the people in rural communities across Montana who rely on timely mail delivery for their medication or Social Security checks. We’ve got great candidates taking on Kamala’s Democrats in close races, but they need our help to secure critical seats to take back the U.S. Senate. |
_Fellow American, this is a longer email, so I hope you will read it in its entirety. But if you're pressed for time, here's the CliffsNotes version:_

| Winning a Republican majority in the Senate is about resources, truly. With less than 60 days, we have got to keep fighting not only on the campaign trail but also on the fundraising side. We NEED the resources to get our message out against the most liberal candidate for President we have seen in our lifetime. **If you like San Francisco politics, you are going to love Kamala Harris.**

**[Please help us take back the US Senate today. We've recruited the strongest candidate class in history to take on Kamala Harris and the radical left Senators who seek to destroy the America we love and replace it with a corrupt socialist failed state.](http://links.action.supportstevedaines.com/u/click?_t=71faa67ca88f4c4b899697b6a4621901&_m=8495665665f047489c5151a6f4461349&_e=me0hQMkehYyiq5zPCj2pKaL86LZHT1zmDCQhD-QL2TxlgTHG6nuFBc7HNm6VAyd2eVFQ--6ZKPAUiTzmq4EdXVh8MdgZMrKaD4xdLc1IYk7NGYanyHnVq10YyxTFRMmqQ7HPSspWM0d49HwaGbFY9vnRTgxYUAYJfCg8zi8VDEdCK_CpTKr5J-BqpSbuQFZvODzJe3K5STAuA3aVE02AfVeh68kKP-wk43MAbuFjoqabqXuEgjsRsYJf5GmBvTG9nTbotWYgL9zVshnwT6KviE58mxB8vbk-t_5pOlfZrni_wukPqAYMxSzi0tcO_mzrq0qrlzCqZRuTgioEqdlEA423UbiNyrdLEJuhnL1yR9h2kXfR9EcVF1XO7LzDtm2T)**

_**That's the secret sauce to winning.**_

-- Senator Steve Daines, NRSC Chairman

---

Fellow American,

I recently spoke with Larry Kudlow to give a rundown of the state of the race to take back the U.S. Senate. _Below is a snapshot of what I had to say:_
> _**MONTANA**_
>
> _We've got a great candidate in**Tim Sheehy**. He's a Naval Academy Graduate with 200 combat missions as a Navy SEAL, and the last couple of polls have Tim Sheehy up over Jon Tester. This could be the 51st seat. _
>
> _**OHIO**_
>
> _In Ohio - another red state that Trump will win by 8 to 10 points - there is a great candidate, **Bernie Moreno**. That will be a tight race to the finish, but I like our odds in Ohio._
>
> _**MICHIGAN**_
>
> _There's an open seat in Michigan, where**Mike Rogers** just won his primary. As we speak, the race is low, single digits, in a state where Trump is going to be very competitive and has a great shot of winning. _
>
> _**MARYLAND**_
>
> _In Maryland, there's another open seat.**Larry Hogan** is a very popular Republican Governor and a great candidate, so it's going to be another competitive race. _
>
> _**ARIZONA**_
>
> _**Kari Lake** is running for an open seat against the most liberal, far-left candidate on the battlefield, Ruben Gallego. We just got out of the field polling, where the race is tied 46-46._
>
> _**PENNSYLVANIA**_
>
> _Then you go into these other states like Pennsylvania.**Dave McCormick** is running against a vulnerable Democrat incumbent. Dave is a West Point Graduate, 82nd Airborne, a business guy, and an excellent candidate_.
>
> _**WISCONSIN**_
>
> _**Eric Hovde** is running in Wisconsin against one of Kamala Harris' most reliable supporters. You've got another businessperson - a banker - who is polling close to his Democrat Senate incumbent._
>
> _**NEVADA**_
>
> _Another great state that's very much in play is Nevada;**Sam Brown** , another West Point Graduate, was wounded in Afghanistan. Remember, in the last election in Nevada in 2022, they elected a Republican Governor, Governor Lombardo, but we failed to flip a Senate seat. That was the tightest loss; we had 8,000 votes when Laxalt lost that race in 2022._
The opportunity is with Republicans. Democrats are defending ten seats, and our Republican candidates lead in the three critical open seats.

**But Democrats maintain their brutal 2-and 3-to-1 financial advantages across the board. Our candidates are losing the fundraising race and need our support to close this gap.**

If the election were held today, I'm not sure we would take back the Senate. But the good news is that we still have time to catch up. **[Please help our GOP candidates in neck-and-neck races reduce their financial disadvantage and take back the Senate from the socialist Democrats.](http://links.action.supportstevedaines.com/u/click?_t=71faa67ca88f4c4b899697b6a4621901&_m=8495665665f047489c5151a6f4461349&_e=me0hQMkehYyiq5zPCj2pKaL86LZHT1zmDCQhD-QL2TxlgTHG6nuFBc7HNm6VAyd2eVFQ--6ZKPAUiTzmq4EdXVh8MdgZMrKaD4xdLc1IYk7NGYanyHnVq10YyxTFRMmqQ7HPSspWM0d49HwaGbFY9vnRTgxYUAYJfCg8zi8VDEdCK_CpTKr5J-BqpSbuQFZvODzJe3K5STAuA3aVE02AfVeh68kKP-wk43MAbuFjoqY_cOggUJ--xYGW90Ny38VtCpVcMhf5hUtsYZpgL9rTGy-PQw4mYUpnf6qsO5yvLlTQp9sDLyI_AJHAYEIaAu3B3LHPdJyCuhY7SqvNNGeiohhV0Bi9ufyNZZzUUBYIa8bC0TOCuw8GVSGzbiegDfMQ)**

_Any donation you can spare makes a vital impact in these final days._

Thank you for standing with us,

name: Kamala Harris for President
subject: Not great...
body:
[ https://act.kamalaharris.com/go/65?t=1001&akid=51%2E2563979%2EPx7tG- ][IMG]

Please see an update we sent out a few days ago to press. As one of the VP's top supporters, I think you'll find it interesting as well. - Jen O'Malley Dillon

To: Interested Parties
From: Harris-Walz Campaign Chair Jen O’Malley Dillon
Date: September 1, 2024
Subject: The State of the Race 65 Days Out

Vice President Harris is running for the future and to turn the page on the division of Donald Trump - and Americans are energized behind that message. Since Vice President Harris entered the race in late July, our campaign has seen record fundraising numbers, a surge in volunteer interest, and a spike in enthusiasm to participate in this November’s election.

However, make no mistake: we head into the final stretch of this race as the clear underdogs. Donald Trump has a motivated base of support, with more support and higher favorability than he has had at any point since 2020. In just a few short days, Vice President Harris will face Trump on the debate stage, where we expect him to be a formidable opponent. In 2020, the election came down to about 40,000 votes across the battleground states. This November, we anticipate margins to be similarly razor-thin.

The difference maker will be which campaign has the candidate, the infrastructure, and the grit capable of expanding their support to build the type of broad, diverse coalition that wins elections. Every day, Vice President Harris proves she is that candidate.

Vice President Harris is running on a popular agenda that matters to voters at the ballot box. Trump will have to answer for Project 2025.

Vice President Harris comes to the job of president as someone acutely focused on the issues that matter to voters most when they get home from work at night. She grew up in a middle-class household and her agenda reflects those values: a plan to cut taxes for the middle class, lower grocery costs, and make housing more affordable for every American. Her economic vision is both good for the country and popular with the voters who will decide this election: Vice President Harris’ plans are pragmatic and focused on solutions, while a clear majority of swing voters see Trump as more extreme. They also prefer a candidate who is “honest,” and “fights for the working class,” — key elements of Vice President Harris’ pitch to voters this fall.

Vice President Harris is also running on one of the most galvanizing issues in recent elections: restoring reproductive freedom. Voters identified reproductive rights as a top issue influencing their vote in the 2022 midterm elections: In CNN’s 2022 pre-election poll, nearly three-quarters of voters called abortion very important to their vote, and a majority of voters called it extremely important. This trend continues in 2024, where 76% of voters have identified abortion as an important issue in this election, and nearly half of voters ranked it as very important. Vice President Harris’ steadfast support for reproductive rights and her clear-cut messaging on restoring the protections of Roe is a powerful piece of how this campaign will expand our coalition and path to victory.

Recent polls show Vice President Harris has room to expand her support with voters, as she makes significant inroads with voters and holds leads on core issues like crime (+1), democracy (+5), abortion (+17), health care (+7), gun violence (+5) and gaining and even leading (+1) on the economy, an issue where Republicans often hold large leads.

Meanwhile, Trump is burdened with defending the indefensible: Project 2025. New polling shows that voters are strongly aware of Trump’s extreme Project 2025 and the more they learn, the more they oppose it. And no matter how hard he tries to separate himself from Project 2025 and its litany of unpopular proposals (cutting Social Security, defunding K-12 education, and instituting a nationwide abortion ban to name a few), Trump won’t be able to shake his ties to Project 2025 thanks to our team’s aggressive efforts online and through paid media to cast a spotlight on Trump’s connection to Project 2025 for every day between now and Election Day.

Elections are a choice, and the choice between turning the page toward the future with Vice President Harris or going backwards with Trump will be on full display at the September 10 presidential debate. With hundreds of millions of dollars in paid media creative already lifting up Trump’s extreme and losing agenda, the debate will be another opportunity for us to break through and showcase the two very contrasting visions for the future of our country.

In an election that will be decided in the states, ground game matters more than ever.

Since Vice President Harris became the nominee, we have seen tremendous momentum and gains across every battleground. We maintain multiple pathways to 270 electoral votes, and are growing strength across the types of voters who decide elections in every battleground. However, the race remains very close, and will be decided by a small number of undecided voters. That universe of voters does not like Donald Trump, but needs to hear relentlessly from us about Vice President Harris and her vision for the country. That’s what makes our operational strength so critical.

Heading into the final stretch, our operational strength matters more than ever. Since Vice President Harris entered the race, she’s raised more than $540 million - a historic sum. That money is going directly to a relentless battleground operation, with more than 312 coordinated offices and 2,000 coordinated staff in the states — a reflection of a campaign with presences in every corner of every battleground state and with the communities critical to victory. During a recent Weekend of Action, more than 10,000 volunteers made nearly 900,000 calls and knocked on 150,000 doors, contacting more than 1 million voters.

In the battlegrounds, we are working to persuade moderate and Republican voters, and cut Trump’s margins in rural areas and red counties. We have offices in rural counties like Washington and Jenkins in Georgia, Union and Jefferson in Pennsylvania, Jackson and Wilson in North Carolina, and Waushara and Rusk in Wisconsin.

Recently, we launched the Latinos con Harris-Walz WhatsApp channel, a first-of-its-kind effort to reach Latinos on the election in a place where many get their news from.

Team Harriz-Walz is bolstering its efforts to reach Black voters by continuing to partner with community and faith leaders across battleground states to host events within the communities that will decide this election – including during the upcoming HBCU homecoming season.

Last week, we announced a ramp up of efforts on hundreds of college campuses to engage students.

And just this Tuesday, we will launch our “Fight for Our Reproductive Freedoms” bus tour – an effort that will last until Election Day to drive home the threat Trump poses to women’s reproductive rights.
On the airwaves, we are ceding no ground: through a landmark $370 million investment on digital and television advertising between Labor Day and Election Day, the Vice President will be making the case everywhere to battleground voters on the issues that matter most to them – all the while Team Trump has reserved virtually zero media reservations for the long-term.

In an election that will be decided on the margins, Trump’s campaign still lags far behind in the infrastructure needed to win in key battleground states. In Nevada, Team Harris has 14 offices and more than 100 full-time employees, while Trump has just five offices and about 24 staff. In Pennsylvania, we have 50 coordinated offices while Trump’s campaign trails and won’t say where they are located. In Georgia, we have 24 offices while the Trump team didn’t open their first until June. And while we go on offense to expand our map, the Trump team is on its back foot. In states like North Carolina and Georgia, Team Trump is being forced to spend in ways they did not plan to originally.

The Road Ahead:

While Donald Trump is a heavily defined candidate, voters do not know Vice President Harris or Governor Walz as well. While we continue to ramp up our organizing and paid efforts, over this final stretch, an aggressive campaigning schedule to introduce and define our ticket to the voters that will decide this election will be critical.

From Labor Day through November 5, Vice President Harris, Governor Walz, and our army of trusted, mobilizing surrogates are hitting the road to do the work to win every single vote. The campaign plans to ramp up our aggressive principal travel schedule to continue to build a presence in the communities and states we need to win on Election Day. On Labor Day alone, the Vice President will travel to Detroit, Michigan and then join President Biden in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, while Governor Walz and First Lady Gwen Walz will spend their Labor Day in Milwaukee, Wisconsin. The Harris-Walz campaign also plans to send key surrogates including Governor JB Pritzker, Mitch Landrieu, and Tom Perez, and others to top battlegrounds including North Carolina, Nevada, and Georgia.

Key moments ahead, like the September 10 presidential debate and the start of Hispanic Heritage Month, will be critical in activating supporters and surrogates to campaign in battleground states.

Labor Day also brings the start of voting season, with the first ballots of this election being mailed to voters later this week. As Americans begin to cast their votes, Team Harris-Walz and Democrats across the country are focused on making sure every eligible voter can cast a ballot and have that ballot counted.

With tools like IWillVote.com, Democrats are giving voters all the resources they need to make their voices heard in this election. Our campaign is also building the largest voter protection program in American presidential history. We have more than 100 voter protection staff across a dozen states, with thousands of volunteers nationally. We are continuing to recruit poll and count observers as well as volunteers for our hotline, which will bolster other state and national hotlines. And as more Americans begin early voting, we will work to make sure every single eligible voter has a plan to make their voices heard.

Bottom line: Make no mistake: the next 65 days will be very hard. This race will remain incredibly close, and the voters who will decide this election will require an extraordinary amount of work to win over. But we have the candidate, message, and operation that brings Americans together to chart a new way forward, so we can once again defeat Donald Trump.

----------------

Before you click away!

This is the most important election of our lifetime, and it's critical we do everything we can to defeat Donald Trump and J.D. Vance this November.

If everyone reading this email donated just $20, we would reach our fundraising goals and have what it takes to win. But not everyone gives.

We are counting on supporters like you who know the stakes of this election to chip in today. If electing Kamala Harris and Tim Walz and defeating Donald Trump seems worth $20, donate to the campaign today: https://act.kamalaharris.com/go/503?akid=51%2E2563979%2EPx7tG-

Vice President Harris comes to the job of president as someone acutely focused on the issues that matter to voters most when they get home from work at night. She grew up in a middle-class household and her agenda reflects those values: a plan to cut taxes for the middle class, lower grocery costs, and make housing more affordable for every American. Her economic vision is both good for the country and popular with the voters who will decide this election: Vice President Harris’ plans are pragmatic and focused on solutions, while a clear majority of swing voters see Trump as more extreme. They also prefer a candidate who is “honest,” and “fights for the working class,” — key elements of Vice President Harris’ pitch to voters this fall. Vice President Harris is also running on one of the most galvanizing issues in recent elections: restoring reproductive freedom. Voters identified reproductive rights as a top issue influencing their vote in the 2022 midterm elections: In CNN’s 2022 pre-election poll, nearly three-quarters of voters called abortion very important to their vote, and a majority of voters called it extremely important. This trend continues in 2024, where 76% of voters have identified abortion as an important issue in this election, and nearly half of voters ranked it as very important. Vice President Harris’ steadfast support for reproductive rights and her clear-cut messaging on restoring the protections of Roe is a powerful piece of how this campaign will expand our coalition and path to victory. Recent polls show Vice President Harris has room to expand her support with voters, as she makes significant inroads with voters and holds leads on core issues like crime (+1), democracy (+5), abortion (+17), health care (+7), gun violence (+5) and gaining and even leading (+1) on the economy, an issue where Republicans often hold large leads. Meanwhile, Trump is burdened with defending the indefensible: Project 2025. New polling shows that voters are strongly aware of Trump’s extreme Project 2025 and the more they learn, the more they oppose it. And no matter how hard he tries to separate himself from Project 2025 and its litany of unpopular proposals (cutting Social Security, defunding K-12 education, and instituting a nationwide abortion ban to name a few), Trump won’t be able to shake his ties to Project 2025 thanks to our team’s aggressive efforts online and through paid media to cast a spotlight on Trump’s connection to Project 2025 for every day between now and Election Day. Elections are a choice, and the choice between turning the page toward the future with Vice President Harris or going backwards with Trump will be on full display at the September 10 presidential debate. With hundreds of millions of dollars in paid media creative already lifting up Trump’s extreme and losing agenda, the debate will be another opportunity for us to break through and showcase the two very contrasting visions for the future of our country. In an election that will be decided in the states, ground game matters more than ever. Since Vice President Harris became the nominee, we have seen tremendous momentum and gains across every battleground. We maintain multiple pathways to 270 electoral votes, and are growing strength across the types of voters who decide elections in every battleground. However, the race remains very close, and will be decided by a small number of undecided voters. That universe of voters does not like Donald Trump, but needs to hear relentlessly from us about Vice President Harris and her vision for the country. That’s what makes our operational strength so critical. Heading into the final stretch, our operational strength matters more than ever. Since Vice President Harris entered the race, she’s raised more than $540 million - a historic sum. That money is going directly to a relentless battleground operation, with more than 312 coordinated offices and 2,000 coordinated staff in the states — a reflection of a campaign with presences in every corner of every battleground state and with the communities critical to victory. During a recent Weekend of Action, more than 10,000 volunteers made nearly 900,000 calls and knocked on 150,000 doors, contacting more than 1 million voters. In the battlegrounds, we are working to persuade moderate and Republican voters, and cut Trump’s margins in rural areas and red counties. We have offices in rural counties like Washington and Jenkins in Georgia, Union and Jefferson in Pennsylvania, Jackson and Wilson in North Carolina, and Waushara and Rusk in Wisconsin. Recently, we launched the Latinos con Harris-Walz WhatsApp channel, a first-of-its-kind effort to reach Latinos on the election in a place where many get their news from. Team Harriz-Walz is bolstering its efforts to reach Black voters by continuing to partner with community and faith leaders across battleground states to host events within the communities that will decide this election – including during the upcoming HBCU homecoming season. Last week, we announced a ramp up of efforts on hundreds of college campuses to engage students. And just this Tuesday, we will launch our “Fight for Our Reproductive Freedoms” bus tour – an effort that will last until Election Day to drive home the threat Trump poses to women’s reproductive rights. On the airwaves, we are ceding no ground: through a landmark $370 million investment on digital and television advertising between Labor Day and Election Day, the Vice President will be making the case everywhere to battleground voters on the issues that matter most to them – all the while Team Trump has reserved virtually zero media reservations for the long-term. In an election that will be decided on the margins, Trump’s campaign still lags far behind in the infrastructure needed to win in key battleground states. In Nevada, Team Harris has 14 offices and more than 100 full-time employees, while Trump has just five offices and about 24 staff. In Pennsylvania, we have 50 coordinated offices while Trump’s campaign trails and won’t say where they are located. In Georgia, we have 24 offices while the Trump team didn’t open their first until June. And while we go on offense to expand our map, the Trump team is on its back foot. In states like North Carolina and Georgia, Team Trump is being forced to spend in ways they did not plan to originally. The Road Ahead: While Donald Trump is a heavily defined candidate, voters do not know Vice President Harris or Governor Walz as well. While we continue to ramp up our organizing and paid efforts, over this final stretch, an aggressive campaigning schedule to introduce and define our ticket to the voters that will decide this election will be critical. From Labor Day through November 5, Vice President Harris, Governor Walz, and our army of trusted, mobilizing surrogates are hitting the road to do the work to win every single vote. The campaign plans to ramp up our aggressive principal travel schedule to continue to build a presence in the communities and states we need to win on Election Day. On Labor Day alone, the Vice President will travel to Detroit, Michigan and then join President Biden in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, while Governor Walz and First Lady Gwen Walz will spend their Labor Day in Milwaukee, Wisconsin. The Harris-Walz campaign also plans to send key surrogates including Governor JB Pritzker, Mitch Landrieu, and Tom Perez, and others to top battlegrounds including North Carolina, Nevada, and Georgia. Key moments ahead, like the September 10 presidential debate and the start of Hispanic Heritage Month, will be critical in activating supporters and surrogates to campaign in battleground states. Labor Day also brings the start of voting season, with the first ballots of this election being mailed to voters later this week. As Americans begin to cast their votes, Team Harris-Walz and Democrats across the country are focused on making sure every eligible voter can cast a ballot and have that ballot counted. With tools like IWillVote.com, Democrats are giving voters all the resources they need to make their voices heard in this election. Our campaign is also building the largest voter protection program in American presidential history. We have more than 100 voter protection staff across a dozen states, with thousands of volunteers nationally. We are continuing to recruit poll and count observers as well as volunteers for our hotline, which will bolster other state and national hotlines. And as more Americans begin early voting, we will work to make sure every single eligible voter has a plan to make their voices heard. Bottom line: Make no mistake: the next 65 days will be very hard. This race will remain incredibly close, and the voters who will decide this election will require an extraordinary amount of work to win over. But we have the candidate, message, and operation that brings Americans together to chart a new way forward, so we can once again defeat Donald Trump. Before you click away! This is the most important election of our lifetime, and it's critical we do everything we can to defeat Donald Trump and J.D. Vance this November. If everyone reading this email donated just $20, we would reach our fundraising goals and have what it takes to win. But not everyone gives. We are counting on supporters like you who know the stakes of this election to chip in today. If electing Kamala Harris and Tim Walz and defeating Donald Trump seems worth $20, donate to the campaign today: - You can unsubscribe from this mailing list at any time: -

name: David Hogg (Leaders We Deserve)
subject: Change IS possible
disclaimer_text: Paid for by VPP
body:
They told us we couldn’t do it – but we did it anyway.
| Folks,

The reason change doesn’t happen is not because it’s impossible — but because people think it is impossible.

I believe this idea that change is impossible is the single greatest threat to American democracy. [**Before I tell you more, can you take a moment to support our mission to elect young, progressive leaders by splitting a small donation with Voter Protection Project and Leaders We Deserve?**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/77803?t=6&akid=16710%2E878179%2EOhSGr2)

After Parkland, many adults said: **“What happened is terrible and it’s amazing you kids are standing up,_but you’ll never change anything because this is Florida.”_** But guess what?

Outraged students and parents of victims — like Fred Guttenberg and Manuel Oliver — said we don’t care; we’re still going to try. We showed up and protested by the thousands in Tallahassee. And guess what? We actually did change gun laws. We raised the age to buy guns in Florida to 21 and passed a red flag law.

**Later, my mother got a death threat from an NRA supporter that said: “F with the NRA and you’ll be DOA.”**

We used the law we passed after Parkland to disarm the man that threatened to kill my mother, and since the passage of that law, **over 12,000 other people who were a risk to themselves or others have been disarmed.**

[**Folks, if we didn’t have the audacity to hope – I may have had to bury my own mother. That’s why I’m still fighting to keep others safe from gun violence. Can you give $10 between Voter Protection Project and Leaders We Deserve to support the work we’re doing to create a safer future?**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/77803?t=7&akid=16710%2E878179%2EOhSGr2) | [CONTRIBUTE $10 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/77803?t=8&akid=16710%2E878179%2EOhSGr2)
---
A few years later, I hired a young guy named Maxwell Frost from my freshman dorm room in college to be the March for Our Lives National Organizing Director. In my junior year of college, he called me up and said he would have to leave March for Our Lives because he wanted to run for Congress and asked for my help.

Before this, I hadn’t really helped anyone run for office in a major way because I didn’t trust politicians who only wanted to use me to get elected and then do nothing about gun violence.

But I didn’t see Maxwell as a politician – I saw him as a friend, so I did everything I could to help him run.

Once again, I heard the same thing from professors and “experts”:
“He’s too young.”
“He doesn’t have the political or donor connections to win.”
“How is he going to win against two former members of Congress?”
I didn’t care and decided to keep supporting him because I knew what an incredible leader he could be, and I wanted to prove everyone who said it wasn’t possible wrong. So, I helped Maxwell raise $380,000 in his first two quarters, which helped him win by a margin of 10% — and he became the youngest member of Congress.

Once elected, Maxwell’s first bill was to create a Federal Office of Gun Violence Prevention (something March for Our Lives had been pushing for over three years) and within 1 year of his election, Maxwell was introducing the President of the United States, who was announcing the creation of the Office of Gun Violence Prevention. That office has overseen a 20% reduction of gun homicides in the first quarter of 2024.

If we listened to the people who said Maxwell couldn’t win, and if he didn’t bother to try, we wouldn’t have:
* The youngest and first Gen Z member of Congress;
* an Office of Gun Violence Prevention;
* first member of March for Our Lives in Congress.

[**Folks, we’re changing the status quo and getting more young leaders elected to office. Can you donate $10 between Voter Protection Project and Leaders We Deserve to fuel our work to elect young progressives up-and-down the ballot?**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/77803?t=9&akid=16710%2E878179%2EOhSGr2)

We are in a vicious cycle of cynicism and hopelessness that will destroy us if we don’t break it. Hopelessness is a self-fulfilling prophecy. If we never think things can get better, they never will.

That’s why – with Maxwell’s campaign manager, Kevin Lata – we created Leaders We Deserve. An organization dedicated to funding and advising the best Democrats of our generation to get them elected, so we can have leaders in office that will inspire young people to vote.

Our candidates are pro-gun reform, pro-choice, and pro-environment. They also don’t take money from large corporations and neither does Leaders We Deserve.

Just recently, we spent $300,000 supporting Molly Cook, who won by just 62 votes, and is now the youngest member of the Texas Senate.

CHANGE IS POSSIBLE! And we’re making it happen.

Friend, join the thousands of people supporting a better, more progressive future. We rely on grassroots support to get young progressives elected to office, and with November 5 getting closer, we need a big surge of donations to get across the finish line. [**Can we count on you to split $10 between Voter Protection Project and Leaders We Deserve to support the work we’re doing to build a better future for the next generation?**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/77803?t=10&akid=16710%2E878179%2EOhSGr2)
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Leaders We Deserve and VPP will go through immediately:

Thank you,

**David Hogg**

Peter, I’m going to shoot you straight. We’re coming up on the final stretch of the campaign, and every day that we’re not reaching voters is a missed opportunity that could cost us the election come November. This isn’t an easy fight — _we knew that when we signed up to take on a billionaire with deep pockets and no respect for our Montana_ — but it’s a critical one. This November will determine if we can take back our public lands, fund our children’s public schools, defend a woman’s right to choice and privacy, and put an end to the tax hikes that Gianforte has imposed on everybody **BUT** himself. **September 15th marks our second to last public fundraising deadline before Election Day, but let me be clear:_this is without a doubt the most important one we’ve faced to date._** There haven't been many polls done in this race, and the ones that have been done are hyper-partisan. body:
We need your support to win | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/e5b987777fd9/why-would-you-want-an-extreme-politician-at-the-montana-supreme-court-14171466?e=5e62e9066d)

# ,

We’re a week into September. [**Every day and every donation counts at this point.**](https://erinformontana.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=846aeb55e2fc599e968ca8fae&id=6e3f289ed6&e=5e62e9066d)****
I am facing a tough race, and the competition in this race only makes our circumstances more dire. I expect a very negative campaign, maligning my record as a public servant and an advocate for access to justice for all Montanans. The corporate lobbyists and extreme right-wing agenda fueling my opponent's campaign have nothing but their own selfish interests at heart. And my opponent? He buys into their agenda big time.
---
[](https://erinformontana.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=846aeb55e2fc599e968ca8fae&id=6744298348&e=5e62e9066d)
| With hyper-partisan and corporate interests investing millions into Montana’s election this year, the race for Clerk of the Supreme Court is more important than ever. Montana is at a crossroads. I’ll keep Montana out of the Clerk’s office, focusing on improving access to justice for all Montanans and improving the efficiency of the judicial branch.
We do NOT need a Clerk who seeks to end Montana womens’ privacy rights to make our own medical decisions. We do NOT need a Clerk who openly brags about helping his hyper-partisan extremists seeking to undermine the Montana State Constitution.
---
[SUPPORT TODAY!](https://erinformontana.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=846aeb55e2fc599e968ca8fae&id=6eedf19f44&e=5e62e9066d)
| We must hit our goals in order to mobilize the votes we need to make our Montana Supreme Court accessible to all and working toward the betterment of our future.
[**To stay on track to hit our fundraising goals, all we need is for you to chip in. A donation of $50, $100, or even $150 would go a long way in helping us get squared away and able to do what we need to win.**](https://erinformontana.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=846aeb55e2fc599e968ca8fae&id=a4017b12df&e=5e62e9066d)
Thank you in advance for your support.

Regards,
**Erin**

[**PS: Your personal donation of $100, $50, $25 - but no more than the $790 legal limit - will help fuel my successful grassroots campaign.**](https://erinformontana.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=846aeb55e2fc599e968ca8fae&id=d05ea63fa3&e=5e62e9066d)**** Please join our movement and encourage friends, family and professional colleagues to do the same.

#
Dear Friend,

Every 80 seconds, a preborn child loses its life at the hands of Planned Parenthood. This means that by the time you finish reading this email, another innocent life will be gone.

Despite the Supreme Court ruling in the overturning of _Roe v. Wade_ , Planned Parenthood continues to receive taxpayer funding, effectively subsidizing the intentional killing of preborn children. Since 2000, nearly $10.7 billion of taxpayers' money has funded their life-ending work.

Contrast this with the nearly 3,000 Pro-life pregnancy centers nationwide dedicated to supporting expectant mothers. Planned Parenthood only operates about 600 facilities and primarily offers one service: abortion. Alarmingly, they perform 62 abortions for every prenatal care service they provide, and prenatal care services are down 80% since 2010.

As a pro-life individual, I know you don't want your hard-earned tax dollars to support an organization that prioritizes abortion.

That's why I'm urging you to join us to demand an end to this taxpayer-funded ongoing tragedy. A new Congress and president will be chosen this November, and they need to hear from us _now_ that America does NOT support funding Planned Parenthood.

Make your voice heard. Sign our petition before midnight to demand an end to this grave misuse of your taxes. **[https://www.liveaction.org/defund-planned-parenthood-petition/](http://links.redconservatives.com/u/click?_t=66ce1250519441959ebe70cf27686494&_m=4724972bb49e491c9ba0dccfc55fadfc&_e=K9BRGY9OnzYzD7_d2GkeGxAJsUMNhxxJgtYaJy2JGHvNeTWMh161mlL1r6T3OX4NkxXNOfDzmWEUn5qsUqNXmUvQ_FUnQ2I1aKjN2_EEVySLocfBy3DEgW8FrTgI9IaM26k3Vlw1vzVBkluvF94w2E7fluXHeNKdmwMg5pkrhSu0RROn8j2Za8lk4W81vQ7g2Xctx7H6Pof6SRBp7IATMONXLZsJBYMazO2CyAJwtfLL7UgW_636YCbFuvS5mkF3dI8DwQdzGPDn5BFgx7IhKTWX9NTMJlPNQ0nNQeufaQuGqRXL7aBYdKehzKygrkvC7zAv9z40J3XcOAMs65b1yLq7Qotr3cAzT_MQnE7mKi-df74Z9BQTUx72oNWXDsF8id8MNkBILyQ01HAHKYrJ3g%3D%3D)**

Thank you for standing with us for the protection of future generations!

For Life,

Lila Rose
**President and Founder**

I gotta tell you, as a parent in Tennessee, I'm not sure I feel that excitement this year.

| | | | | [ ](https://zg05qvsd.r.us-east-2.awstrack.me/L0/https:%2F%2Fourtenn.org%2F/1/010f0191d8957f2b-74cb08c6-d2ac-41cb-933a-62b2be9b23f1-000000/RcLXHCidt0it9Fg7TrJ8jIIe9s0=175)
---
Hello Peter,
---
| | I remember as a kid when “Back to School” was met with a little bit of dread, but mostly excitement. New friends, new teachers, maybe even a new backpack.

But I gotta tell you, as a parent in Tennessee, I'm not sure I feel that excitement this year.

I'm scared.

I'm scared that the MAGA extremists in our legislature do nothing to stop school shootings.
I'm scared (and pissed off) that the bigots at the Capitol are more concerned about outting Trans kids than protecting them.

I'm scared that instead of teaching science and world cultures, whackjobs on our School Boards are banning books.

But, I learned a few lessons in school and one of the most important was to stand up and fight back when you saw something wrong.

That's why I started Our Tennessee Future.

I know we can stand up to the extremists (and frankly weirdos) that run our state. If you can, get in the fight with me and chip in what you can afford, even just $20, to make sure we have the resources to help Tennessee Democrats win this November, and protect the futures of our children.

Hello Friend,

Despite court rulings in Louisiana and Oklahoma that make the teaching of the Bible and the 10 Commandments mandatory in public schools and universities, we still live in a time when the foundational teachings of the Ten Commandments are no longer emphasized in our public schools and daily lives. As a result, our children are growing up without these essential, God-honoring rules for living.

In this culture of moral confusion, the Ten Commandments provide clear, simple answers about what it means to live a righteous life. Teaching these commandments to children not only instills a sense of security and purpose but also fosters emotional resilience, intellectual acuity, and ethical integrity. The Ten Commandments uphold traditional values and celebrate the family unit as foundational to society, helping children navigate life's challenges with confidence and grace.
---
| | That's why I'm excited to introduce my brand new kids book, _The 10 Commandments for Kids_ book. This book offers kids ten Bible lessons about God's simple rules for living, with each chapter explaining one commandment, discussion questions, applications, and prayers to say together. It's a trustworthy resource for children to read on their own, during church services, or as part of vacation Bible school studies.

Voter Action Project Logo [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-weekly?refcode=090924_2&amount=25]
Folks, The truth is clear:
We need to act to save the United States Postal Service from Wall Street and Trump-appointed Postmaster General Louis DeJoy.
It’s no accident that DeJoy -- the first Postmaster General in two decades without experience working in the postal service -- was appointed just months after Trumps’ Office of Management and Budget released recommendations that the USPS should be privatized. The result has been the slow decimation of one of America’s most treasured institutions.
Mail slowdowns and historic price hikes have made DeJoy’s claim that the USPS is in a “death spiral” a self fulfilling prophecy . More mail slowdowns would hurt rural communities the most because -- unlike UPS and FedEx -- the USPS is required by law to deliver all mail to all regions timely, and at a flat rate.
This year, our movement, working with Congress, forced DeJoy to pause closures of USPS processing centers until at least January 2025, to help protect vote-by-mail in this crucial election year .
Now it’s time to do it again -- This time to stop the new mail slowdowns set to hit rural communities the hardest, and demand service delivery be restored to 2012 standards to completely erase the damage done by Louis DeJoy.
Sign our petition now: Don’t let Louis DeJoy privatize the USPS! >> [https://actionnetwork.org/letters/dont-let-dejoy-privatize-the-usps/?source=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fifvap-actions]
SIGN HERE NOW ⇨ [https://actionnetwork.org/letters/dont-let-dejoy-privatize-the-usps/?source=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fifvap-actions]
DeJoy sees mail service drop off as “inevitable” and says his price hikes aren’t speeding up the decline. He’s wrong. The combination of higher prices and slower delivery virtually guarantees the USPS will lose more customers. Since slowdowns started a little over a decade ago, and accelerated under DeJoy, first-class mail volume has shrunk by 28%.
His decisions affect us all, but folks in rural areas, including many Indigenous communities, seniors, and veterans are the ones who will pay the greatest price, because for many -- the post office is their lifeline . These communities rely on the postal service to receive medications and to vote-by-mail, because some towns are too small for polling places and don’t have a pharmacy.
When DeJoy has faced pressure from Congress and everyday people like you and me, we’ve won . On electric vehicles, he agreed to make a minimum of 62% of new USPS vehicle purchases electric, up from his initial plan of just 10%. We didn’t stop the pressure and he then also committed to a 40% reduction in overall USPS emissions by 2030. We all must step up one more time.
Send a message directly to your members of Congress and the USPS Board of Governors demanding they stop mail slowdowns and price hikes, and restore 2012 delivery standards, to save the post office now >> [https://actionnetwork.org/letters/dont-let-dejoy-privatize-the-usps/?source=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fifvap-actions]

Okay, Peter, hear me out: All these pumpkin pie spice flavors are _just_ like redistricting. I honestly loved seeing pumpkin items on the menu before August was even over. For the pumpkin aficionados among us, the early arrival of these Autumnal flavors is a welcome development. But _technically_ , pumpkin pie spice is meant to be just a _seasonal thing_ , served when temperatures drop and we start thinking about Halloween costumes and seasonal gourds. And _technically_ , redistricting is meant to be just a _once-in-a-decade thing_ , done after the census to update maps according to change in populations. But these days, we’re drinking pumpkin beverages and reshaping congressional maps basically all the time!! **(The reason we’re drinking pumpkin beverages all the time is because they are delicious.) ** **The reason we’re redistricting _all the time now_ (and not just every ten years) is because opponents of fair maps are continually undermining redistricting reforms, electing Election Deniers, and threatening mid-decade map redraws. The fight to make maps fairer can take many years and requires ongoing work to deliver victories for voters.** As of last month, congressional and/or legislative maps around the country have been challenged in a total of _84 cases_ since the 2020 census. There are ongoing redistricting cases in ten states _right now_ that could change the makeup of up to 27 congressional districts. **We’re working to rebuild a democracy where voters pick their politicians — not the other way around. It’s grueling, detailed, and non-stop work because there are people on the other side willing to unfairly get and unjustly keep power.** [**We have to stay on the offense in the fight for fair maps _all the time_ — even/especially when it’s not technically a “redistricting” year. clean_body: These days, we’re drinking pumpkin spice beverages and reshaping congressional maps basically all the time!! | Okay, Peter, hear me out: All these pumpkin pie spice flavors are just like redistricting. I honestly loved seeing pumpkin items on the menu before August was even over. For the pumpkin aficionados among us, the early arrival of these Autumnal flavors is a welcome development. But technically , pumpkin pie spice is meant to be just a seasonal thing , served when temperatures drop and we start thinking about Halloween costumes and seasonal gourds. And technically , redistricting is meant to be just a once-in-a-decade thing , done after the census to update maps according to change in populations. But these days, we’re drinking pumpkin beverages and reshaping congressional maps basically all the time!! (The reason we’re drinking pumpkin beverages all the time is because they are delicious.) The reason we’re redistricting all the time now (and not just every ten years) is because opponents of fair maps are continually undermining redistricting reforms, electing Election Deniers, and threatening mid-decade map redraws. The fight to make maps fairer can take many years and requires ongoing work to deliver victories for voters. As of last month, congressional and/or legislative maps around the country have been challenged in a total of 84 cases since the 2020 census. There are ongoing redistricting cases in ten states right now that could change the makeup of up to 27 congressional districts. We’re working to rebuild a democracy where voters pick their politicians — not the other way around. Fellow American,

Why are you hearing from me?

**Well, I was raised in New Jersey. I love this state._And I love this country._**

[**I would like you to check out what Curtis Bashaw has to say, and if you agree with him, join me in supporting him in his bid for the US Senate.**](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=3a163b8bdc4b45a9aa36c31e9a0bdf6f&_e=ZtmQhtihMewaSiBaOcZsQxR5sGaT1cH68hs_8GClLWwGnBoMHGo8IxTIET3BOrZCJASK97Pwvwc8swjMf5Uh4ctBcuzMurKSJ1FDaDsLRkaGQW-gBRKt_Vh1YlB1Sv-73kwc34mSsNvR_2KEtNm7jdO93prGNrdUJXBkJ2l_fsw6O311pc9cd8213cFjB3aZGkmqDIvsowDc0-wQmv5X3HKlYs9uCjOp2a2G5FMphIAsZXCszCe75ALMRdV7HerD9V2W-sasACTxObduqpfe9D4dgr0VCgKzFfBR2aEFGnp_prFpS9O_Qcwhi-Z-0_mumBx_8znC9P3aY9xIIbVxpDbPPxotePu4N2yKZ1_MnMtjbheGAhRKIM4l0Cr7ZUAHUEQcim_d2kJZkq-jZEmNwg5Uw3aPqV7-ihYCsr4h7bk%3D)

[** JOIN CURTIS BASHAW > **](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=3a163b8bdc4b45a9aa36c31e9a0bdf6f&_e=ZtmQhtihMewaSiBaOcZsQxR5sGaT1cH68hs_8GClLWwGnBoMHGo8IxTIET3BOrZCJASK97Pwvwc8swjMf5Uh4ctBcuzMurKSJ1FDaDsLRkaGQW-gBRKt_Vh1YlB1Sv-73kwc34mSsNvR_2KEtNm7jdO93prGNrdUJXBkJ2l_fsw6O311pc9cd8213cFjB3aZGkmqDIvsowDc0-wQmv5X3HKlYs9uCjOp2a2G5FMphIAsZXCszCe75ALMRdV7HerD9V2W-sasACTxObduqpfe9LLFLS-Be8sopYcw0VL-zMbqzFVp5neNGL6iuGQFQqV9XteKnrx4CtWwg168ZIy5FVntpVON4w62Dnqg0tKug_WKyUYmKJwPrdV59e5X-jyUlLvDwYBl1ptTCvBgsqsG1wjOf-Yqps0p8dcuRCh1QP4%3D)

I have been a known conservative in Hollywood throughout my career. It wasn’t always easy, but the latest from the bankrupt elites in my town really got to me.

After President Trump was shot, the only echo reverberating through my so-called “community” was a regret that the assassin failed to kill him. Weeks later, on a zoom call: White Dudes for Kamala. In a masterpiece of intolerance, in a breathtakingly short period of time, we learned what they are all about: _Hatred and Racism._ **Pathetic**.

I refuse to rail about the Democrats and what they have inflicted upon this country. We all know about their shortcomings, and we all know the kind of future we can bank on should they remain in power.

[**I believe Curtis Bashaw is the right kind of man to send to Washington to promote well-being in New Jersey and the United States at large. We can look to him to protect the Jersey Shore.**](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=3a163b8bdc4b45a9aa36c31e9a0bdf6f&_e=ZtmQhtihMewaSiBaOcZsQxR5sGaT1cH68hs_8GClLWwGnBoMHGo8IxTIET3BOrZCJASK97Pwvwc8swjMf5Uh4ctBcuzMurKSJ1FDaDsLRkaGQW-gBRKt_Vh1YlB1Sv-73kwc34mSsNvR_2KEtNm7jdO93prGNrdUJXBkJ2l_fsw6O311pc9cd8213cFjB3aZGkmqDIvsowDc0-wQmv5X3HKlYs9uCjOp2a2G5FMphIAsZXCszCe75ALMRdV7HerD9V2W-sasACTxObduqpfe9CJ4-SYP1Bc3zrFZMpxZCsfwokTwjr-ANElfwpEFFJspnQEFffZVbes7IAmlkUJ4SZ_Nztfxf-U_xbmoFSDJ4OBRUu8hTZE-WKtc6_ZFSVKjjSaMqpg0-qbWQnlkUBHQ2LcQAa7DLMG1ZpqmPl2fT64%3D)

We can look to him to promote prosperity for all—a good paycheck and food we can afford. But more importantly, he is a good man. A man of good character. A man whose voice can be trusted as he raises his hand to preserve the Constitution of the United States. Our Constitution.

[**There comes a time when we have to speak out in support of our nation’s traditional values. For Patriotism. For the right to pursue happiness on our own terms.**](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=3a163b8bdc4b45a9aa36c31e9a0bdf6f&_e=ZtmQhtihMewaSiBaOcZsQxR5sGaT1cH68hs_8GClLWwGnBoMHGo8IxTIET3BOrZCJASK97Pwvwc8swjMf5Uh4ctBcuzMurKSJ1FDaDsLRkaGQW-gBRKt_Vh1YlB1Sv-73kwc34mSsNvR_2KEtNm7jdO93prGNrdUJXBkJ2l_fsw6O311pc9cd8213cFjB3aZGkmqDIvsowDc0-wQmv5X3HKlYs9uCjOp2a2G5FMphIAsZXCszCe75ALMRdV7HerD9V2W-sasACTxObduqpfe9FPxqLS4m8IWLOH-v5EUJM5VoFI63jBef2dpoLCg0RKNot8J9xNB_0SPpVZ-gTMnt_U5wfl7Y6-Qpt_haPcgd6JYy5w1LSR761YZUCQBwb7KhpMLI4lyEOIkWEEWd8xjINAbfwPD3za0kb-XQZAzIP8%3D)

[** DONATE TO CURTIS BASHAW > **](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=3a163b8bdc4b45a9aa36c31e9a0bdf6f&_e=ZtmQhtihMewaSiBaOcZsQxR5sGaT1cH68hs_8GClLWwGnBoMHGo8IxTIET3BOrZCJASK97Pwvwc8swjMf5Uh4ctBcuzMurKSJ1FDaDsLRkaGQW-gBRKt_Vh1YlB1Sv-73kwc34mSsNvR_2KEtNm7jdO93prGNrdUJXBkJ2l_fsw6O311pc9cd8213cFjB3aZGkmqDIvsowDc0-wQmv5X3HKlYs9uCjOp2a2G5FMphIAsZXCszCe75ALMRdV7HerD9V2W-sasACTxObduqpfe9HQagSmbQmw1OYylbUqFYnAMUt4J9RUBlWP_QHiqBF-rFT7VoITV0blMr6EEyDfWXVx2hlFLuvp417bhaM0V7ZatUMtqvy9ywFkGUtSSAwfZz0QrROnQmau3AIyefVIKNUqDnMnuIj3-6WaFFx0aVrs%3D)

We need a remedy for what Washington has been doing.

Curtis Bashaw in the United States Senate could be that remedy or at least a good part of it.

Please join me in supporting Curtis Bashaw.

Cheerfully and flag-wavingly yours!

Kelsey Grammer

| **_GET TO KNOW CURTIS_**

**Curtis Bashaw is a hotel entrepreneur, job creator, and preservationist. He's running for United States Senate to provide greater freedom and opportunities for all New Jerseyans.**

A lifelong New Jersey resident, Curtis grew up in Camden County and spent his summers at the Jersey Shore working as a bellhop and waiting tables at Congress Hall in Cape May. He has spent his life in the real estate and hospitality industries, and is the Founder and Managing Partner of Cape Resorts, a hotel company focusing on the restoration and operation of classic American resort properties in New Jersey and New York.

Throughout his career, Curtis has worked to build communities and bring people together. He is widely recognized for leading the landmark restorations of Congress Hall and the Virginia Hotel in Cape May, and for launching creative programming to dramatically extend Cape May's season, a catalyst for the economic rebirth of one of the Jersey Shore's most beautiful communities.

Curtis is a successful businessman and job creator, employing more than 1,000 people in New Jersey and New York. Curtis' company owns and operates eight hotels, ten cottages, six restaurants, four retail outlets and a working farm, all on the Jersey Shore and Long Island's East End. Curtis lives in Cape May with his husband, Will.
