I'm a proud daughter of West Central Wisconsin, and I come from a long line of dairy farmers in the Chippewa Valley, where I was raised.

Growing up on my family's farm, I learned the importance of hard work and resilience from an early age. Money was tight, but my parents worked hard to open doors of opportunity for me.
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/92492665/497295616/-532190170?refcode=WTEFHU20_20240909_CookeSplit_ND&sourceid=1054806&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNRUwvMS84NzA2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzOTIxNjRkNi1mNjZlLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=WiLarzY45sSR72uwsVzL6_KwlxYOfF4IlesWCCz8OsU=)
_I spent my summers showing our registered Holsteins around the state._

It's also why I launched a nonprofit called the Red Letter Grant to help women entrepreneurs start main-street businesses throughout western Wisconsin.

It wasn't long before folks started to take notice. **I became the youngest person appointed by Gov. Tony Evers to the Wisconsin Economic Development Corporation** , where I continued working on growing entrepreneurship and innovation across our state.

We need a homegrown, working class representative who understands these issues firsthand — not extreme politicians like my opponent, Derrick Van Orden. Growing up, my dad worked in construction, sometimes putting in 60 to 70 hours a week just to make ends meet. And thanks to my parents’ hard work, my sisters and I were the first in our family to go to college.
Ever since then, I’ve spent my life fighting for families just like mine. In the State Senate, I helped pass the largest tax cut for working families in Michigan’s history, introduced plans to address the growing child care and housing crises in our state, and enacted a commonsense gun violence prevention bill.
**But we need to do more to ensure Michigan families can send their kids to good schools, own a home, and afford to save for retirement. Congress isn’t doing enough – and I’m running to make things better.**
MAGA Republicans’ Project 2025 not only makes life more expensive for working families, but it takes away our fundamental rights. And make no mistake: they will do whatever it takes to win.

Weeks before Ayşenur’s murder, Israeli forces shot American teacher Amado Sison and threw stun grenades at Americans protesting illegal Israeli settlements in the West Bank.
The activist with Ayşenur said: _“If there had been a lot of retaliation after Amado was shot, she would still be alive. She died because the American government did not do anything to the Israeli army. They didn’t even tell the Israeli army to stop shooting American citizens._ ”
In 2022, Israeli soldiers killed 78-year-old Palestinian-American Omar Assad during a brutal arrest. Also in 2022, Israeli forces murdered beloved Palestinian-American journalist Shireen Abu Akleh in the West Bank while she was covering an Israeli military raid on a refugee camp. Shireen was clearly identified as a journalist by her blue vest that read “PRESS.” The U.S. government refused to open an independent investigation, though I pushed Congress and the White House alongside Shireen’s family. Her family, and Rachel Corrie’s family, are still waiting for accountability from the U.S. and Israeli governments. Human rights groups note that Israel clears its soldiers of wrongdoing in 99% of cases.
**The Israeli government is emboldened to continue acting with impunity, as the United States continues to arm its genocide against the Palestinian people.** Over the past 11 months, Israel’s government has killed more than 40,000 Palestinians in Gaza and at least 623 Palestinians in the West Bank. Israel also imprisoned more than 10,000 West Bank Palestinians, holding many without charges in inhumane conditions.

None of this has prompted the Biden administration to follow U.S. and international law by stopping the transfer of U.S. weapons to the Israeli military.

Hi Peter, A few weeks ago, I had the honor of witnessing the first Black woman become the official Democratic nominee at the top of the ticket. I was proud to be one of the many delegates standing behind Kamala Harris as she accepted her nomination. **To offer some historical context, segregation was not officially outlawed until 1964 — I was a young child, and our Presidential nominee Kamala Harris had just been _born_.** Back then, Black women could not hold a position of power — but that didn’t mean they weren’t powerful, Peter. Our grandmothers, mothers, aunts, and sisters all paved the way for us — stoking a fire that has brought Kamala and me to greater heights than our ancestors could have imagined. Tomorrow night, all eyes will be on the presidential debate. It’s a showdown between two drastically different visions for our climate, our democracy, and our future: | **❌ Donald Trump** Trump is doubling down on his reckless "Drill, baby, drill" approach and vows to defund the transition to clean energy, calling it a **"Green New scam."** His plan? **Project 2025** — a dangerous roadmap to **dismantle the EPA,** roll back restrictions on oil drilling, and hand over environmental regulations to **fossil-fuel-friendly Republican state officials.** During his presidency, Trump rolled back **over 100 environmental protections,** giving polluting industries the green light to poison our air and water. If re-elected, expect **skyrocketing emissions** and devastating climate impacts.
---
**✅ Vice President Kamala Harris** Kamala Harris has dedicated her career to **fighting for climate justice.** As California’s Attorney General, she **held Big Oil accountable,** including taking on ExxonMobil for deceiving the public about climate risks. As a U.S. Senator, she **championed the Green New Deal,** pushing for **carbon neutrality by 2030,** and introduced key legislation for **clean electric school buses** and **safe drinking water.** And as Vice President, she cast the **tie-breaking votes** to pass the largest climate legislation in U.S. history, securing billions for **clean energy** and **environmental justice.**
---
There’s no question about it: **the difference between a Kamala Harris presidency and a second Trump term is the difference between climate action and climate catastrophe.**

name: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez
subject: "Politician-speak"
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
#
Someone recently asked me, “Why do politicians always answer questions in ‘politician-speak’? **Why can’t they answer questions like a normal person?** ”
There are likely a few reasons — probably more than I can list — but two thoughts:
One is, if you talk like a normal person, you will get in trouble. **I choose to speak like a normal person, and I get in trouble a lot**. Most people do not want to do that.
And by trouble, I mean **as a politician, people are always taking little snippets of what you say out of context**. So if at any given time you string together six words that don’t have a disclaimer, someone’s going to make a thing about it.
Some politicians don’t want headlines of fake controversies, so they use a lot of practiced messaging and answers because they don’t want to deal with the New York Post or Fox News, because they decided to answer in an improvised way.
Because that’s a big part of what talking like a normal person is: you’re part of a conversation, you don’t pre-rehearse things, you’re talking, answering, and replying to someone in front of you based on what they said _in real time_. And for a lot of people that can create distraction.
The second thought is that **there are _specific_ ways that people poll for what phrases to use that are more persuasive to key audiences**, and so they choose to use that.
I’m not here to judge it or talk about whether it’s bad or good. I know it can be frustrating sometimes, because **people get too stuck in a rut and then it feels like you’re not getting a real answer**. It can feel not authentic.
It’s also this affect that then gets picked up in politics, a “politician-speak”, which is weird. So I get it.
I don’t do it, but I also pay a price for not doing it. You have to choose your battles.
But that's exactly why our movement came to Congress: to speak truth to power, to call out corruption, and to fight tooth and nail for working people across the country — **even if that means they call us 'extreme' for it**.

subject: Watch what happens when people learn the truth about Jim Jordan
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/100067/images/LOGO.jpg]
Friends,
I want to share a story about an experience I had with a voter that reminds me why this race is so important.
At a recent event, an older gentleman, a Republican, came to my event to meet me to ask me one question, “Will you please do something to lower prescription prices?” He dropped his head in shame and said, “I had to choose between buying food and my medication. It’s just so expensive. Will you please do something?”
I think about this man every day. I get tears in my eyes every time I think of him, too. I know I can and will beat Jim Jordan because people like that man, Republicans like that man, are tired of struggling. I am fully committed to helping them. I just need to get the word out.
Moments like these are why I’m running—because no one in Ohio or the country should ever have to make that terrible choice.
Many voters don’t realize that Jim Jordan has spent years voting against efforts to lower drug prices, cap insulin costs, and limit out-of-pocket expenses for seniors.
But here’s the thing: once people learn about his record, his support PLUMMETS.
Your contribution today will help us expose Jim Jordan's terrible record on healthcare and ensure every Ohio voter knows I will have their back. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240909_drug_prices_link1]
We have a real shot at winning this race, and we’ve already created ads that will make sure everyone in the district knows about Jordan’s shameful record.
But to keep these ads on the air through Election Day, we must double our fundraising in September.
Jordan’s cronies want to keep drug prices sky-high while working families struggle to make ends meet because it helps their bottom line and pays for expensive raises and vacation packages for CEOs.
But with your support, we can break their hold on our healthcare system and put people first.
We’ve raised more money and we’re polling higher than ANY opponent Jim Jordan has ever faced. But we need your help to push through to the finish line.
Contribute now to keep our ads running and ensure Ohio voters hear the truth about Jim Jordan. Let’s bring real change to our district and ensure that no one has to choose between food and medicine again. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240909_drug_prices_link2]

Tamie Wilson

---
Friends --
While I know our campaign has sent a lot of emails recently, I want to take a few minutes to tell you about my decision to run for Senate in the first place, and why your support is so important in our success.
The truth is, we all know America is _going through something_ right now. We seem to be living from crisis to crisis. But there are certain things that should be really simple:
Like living a middle-class life in the state that invented the middle class.
Like making things in America so that we’re in control of our own economic security.
Like protecting our children from the things that are _truly_ harming them.
And preserving our rights and our democracy so that our kids can live their version of the American dream.
**I’m running for Senate because I believe that we need a new generation of leaders that thinks differently, works harder, and never forgets the mission of public service.**
But my decision to run for Senate is also deeply personal to me, and it's related to what motivated me to first run for the House in 2018.
It's about my mom, Judy. She was diagnosed with stage IV ovarian cancer in 2009 — and didn't have health insurance at the time. She had let it lapse after the insurance companies had gouged her for years because she happened to have a pre-existing condition. She passed away in 2011, but that experience — of desperately trying to get her care at the same moment we were filling out bankruptcy paperwork — fueled me to run. I remember the exact moment that made me run: when the then-GOP controlled House of Representatives, the body I now serve in, voted to repeal those protections for people with pre-existing conditions.
Seven years later, the Republican leaders, fueled by the extreme wing of the party, are continuing the march to repeal things that the average Americans want. They want to privatize Social Security and Medicare, repeal drug price protections like allowing Medicare to negotiate, then there’s the rights they’re obsessed with repealing: a woman’s right to choose, voting rights, and any possible gun safety legislation.
By winning this Senate seat, we’ll help ensure that Democrats retain the (slight!) majority and can pass legislation that expands access to healthcare. Not the obsession with taking things away.
To be upfront: **Winning this race is going to take a lot of resources. A crazy amount. And we have to do it without raising a single dollar from corporate PACs.**

I have been a known conservative in Hollywood throughout my career. It wasn’t always easy, but the latest from the bankrupt elites in my town really got to me.

| Hi Friend -
---
Lots to catch up on! But first, let’s set the theme for this update ...
### **Gird Up and Go.**
As of today, there are 57 days between now and November 5th. Only 57 days.
The window of opportunity has closed for many things that could have, and should have, been done by now. Not the projects we are working on at True the Vote, mind you. Our focus is on a few very specific efforts, described below. We are trained, prepared, and ready to roll.
But we are being peppered with requests for resources and support for new ideas, untested theories, and fantastical expectations. Maybe you are seeing this, too.
There is no more time. We must gird up and go.
**In Voter Registration.** Voter registration is still happening. Some states stop registration 30 days before the election, in "same day registration states”, registration continues right up through Election Day. Having assisted over 30,000 people in registering or correcting their records, True the Vote’s [Scan.Check.Protect.](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001.bYZLwP2tKNW52PF5H5Fs6VDKmqL7dnq-Z_xN8QkhdZKgsxsq4umEAocVLBID6l-zNtT8Cdg3GPakOs5Hew5FuYwKbxgNdhoBvt_chMlwvSKCxEaOX0ckgpTb-r1rCfsZ5eOTo2j02Qxe371bqhzfqHvMggiAmD1ToTOB9HrRsTYlSy-1ASHB1V-SIanUd2RRevTejnA65iH7w45UKuFh0K1A0H3JPqIxwAIj2pbbbJY5EgnVDeI88tdK1_vZxkf6r-0ycgto6pn6reXJy5Hv6CfQ__zl6x6qbDvTS8OsGJs/49m/DJovmUAgT-qL-0gbg0Nt1w/h2/h001.YZPDiXFRJPVuTSoP-eOpWrvV8iY2FbBnyT-EshYvzSY) is a fast path for registration and review. In Voter Registration, we are girded up and ready.
**In Voter Roll Evaluation.** The federal standard, known as NVRA, closes down maintenance efforts, in almost all states, 90 days before an election. This deadline has passed. True the Vote’s [IV3 Project ](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001.ZOvxkEhKDw9DETb6Ummm9zQuo-zt7v1AcpXkOLMbvNt6YrZM562R3uGahNjwIn7jkGt_IWnw-uSgtquK_mdpjjdISa-tLImUGCjFLnGJ8wiCUDy2-cy8DRGoHI_bZNrinW5Ok7cMMzpq_clxZsV9p1UuJs3neMeIZNt620yYxNLdVsiml_Q_s1aoydIQGNj-Bf5xk-bcHcf37iVr9hrGhm46XGwoAHMCcnDbnEtr67diXRdkqn-1NdDICj3xC_qv2HXHo8CcjRHnCJPUYaQGlw/49m/DJovmUAgT-qL-0gbg0Nt1w/h3/h001._K-L7pKJuBQnP9GNT4pzCwrjKrHQzyg5HldAWvcgst8)assessed voter rolls in 47 states. We helped voters in over 1600 counties file over a 1,000,000 challenges of potentially ineligible voter registration records. We know that there are over 25 million such records, but now ... it all comes down to who votes. Our early work in this area set us up to now monitor incoming votes from potentially problematic records and forward findings to appropriate parties. In Voter Roll Evaluation, we are girded up and ready.
**In Training and Support.** From Election Worker trainings, to producing reference guides for in-field support, and launching the [VoteAlert ](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001.QaMHj7Qq1DDbDECCtYugmAHxKQRoU6lXtZdwF-D70_upyg-YyrOhoNbDuNYWjg-GsdjYNuPYfRtChfPsABiOhqkvIMAMKko4ujHsWpsgrLUsN4lnfdMvQl1fo9wqeMWH832Ze6Zv1lWGlFBpmJYm6DnoONn9zJwnJPA3unPT9kdbbAxPJNBtGf7v47a-TawdVeobLEbPTqxHOFwaTEQMtxqQzoYAHxbfbNETGPSnu29c5oKzQJL9u_Ch44L54uxdLGsfyQXsRRpE0v7tkX6qhA/49m/DJovmUAgT-qL-0gbg0Nt1w/h4/h001.Akuuza9AL5lF-XHjRZCcLsdAJ16bSlzvYiM6jnn29T0)hotline app for voters and election workers, we are helping recruit, train, and support volunteers nationwide. Mobilization is something that must be done by the parties or candidates. Exceedingly frustrating, but nonetheless true. But, for as much as can be done, we are girded up and ready.
**In Monitoring Ballot Dropboxes.** In 2020 and 2022, we learned more than we could have imagined about ballot dropbox monitoring. Our plan involves AI-driven cameras and real-time livestreaming, equipping Sheriffs where possible, other individuals where necessary. We have tested the tech for over a year. We have our own data center, so the livestream cannot be “disappeared”. We need funding to scale, but otherwise, we are girded up and ready.
**In Real-Time Reporting.** Using the Ground Fusion analytic platform and [VoteAlert](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001.QaMHj7Qq1DDbDECCtYugmAHxKQRoU6lXtZdwF-D70_upyg-YyrOhoNbDuNYWjg-GsdjYNuPYfRtChfPsABiOhqkvIMAMKko4ujHsWpsgrLUsN4lnfdMvQl1fo9wqeMWH832Ze6Zv1lWGlFBpmJYm6DnoONn9zJwnJPA3unPT9kdbbAxPJNBtGf7v47a-TawdVeobLEbPTqxHOFwaTEQMt3LqGL_GgqCJVOBAzYAUx1-y7daoXmUIh1Lk1ck6-nzCV1VRcHsS4bNDmwf8CG-V2A/49m/DJovmUAgT-qL-0gbg0Nt1w/h5/h001.srsIQB9PYB_eo81l72KLMPaHYkN4hxDYA7EoC5iOqBo) reporting, we will host daily broadcasts beginning in early October. Media quizzlings will do The Machine’s bidding. We will tell you what’s happening on the ground and give you options to GOTN (Get Out The News). For this too, we are girded up and ready.
**In Multilingual Outreach.** What started as Latino outreach through [Voto Honesto](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001.bYZLwP2tKNW52PF5H5Fs6UlhyHm_y7hn9DgzM_XLbg-uJuLQLkUwwj21fPKqB9uvp_QC_BQQq3O79Hyd6RQTCvWVNnVBLAGbDideQwIPcvh3wmAX0wY8eTf7fXkVlubZ0ufy3ix9aFCke50wWCNDd_7d1o6NtroNTfpdxXlcw54l6lszmC738AWCAhmjqwqj2tsxj5B419UD26doYHgkmBAMraB9GASS4fqmNG3l5fb_rldUPul32-TWgxlhOMWFSKeT0ohCpS4ZhqhYCmSfnw/49m/DJovmUAgT-qL-0gbg0Nt1w/h6/h001.Trxe9J-Hm7nGrMNsy_b-SG-hL0H6_WFnDWkyTI2iMeI) has expanded from Spanish to now include Vietnamese, Mandarin, and Korean. In this time of polarization and confusion, we are meeting voters where they’re at and sharing election facts in whatever language we need to. The common denominator is our shared love for America. Together, we are girded up and ready.
**In Prayer.** We are so blessed by our ongoing collaboration with Intercessors for America. The ‘Pray the Vote’ initiative gives you very specific ways to pray for voters. [Check it out here!](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001.sV4MFbzBllccGzy2svLCohU6PBwOxMMrGDSWW6e_iyXQCDKD7FkNECFRiJ1oKMdmcWNtcaDaH34VL-kUC77rpFUAf7oQja0CYX8NWCLIR8BL-PEEnXs4IESNd2F4qCjLKgM4vUqngQM8DxjHmq9JpUy3nowWUKHdLwUQy3KchCIEIvGwtRvCQY9LMp_3DpLgSglAi_I3FNbFQ0TTEpdzAYs8aV7M6enlZgnBAycvrBrlnUX_OqtUpASPqEtj3iL7ufI7zhurZ_id-YkNGeR0-w/49m/DJovmUAgT-qL-0gbg0Nt1w/h7/h001.znJuC86GF7It4uEWfhrIRoEOPXegzJcn57YnTdQuwkk) Praying it though with IFA, we are girded up and ready.
We have volunteers hosting voter registration and support events at long term care facilities (The Older But Wiser Project), voters righteously railing against the noncitizen voting fiasco (The 611 Project), we are still fighting in court on several lawsuits, still hosting weekly Q&A; workshops, and we are assisting many other groups and efforts, in ways seen and unseen. All of that is still going on, but ... it’s time to focus on what we, the American People, can bring to this game.
It’s time to lock in on what you can do. Roll up your sleeves. Think outside the box. The goal is simple, get everyone you can to vote to save the Republic. Serve in your local election. Report problems. And pray. There is no single effort that will right all the past wrongs. This is a 1,000 front war. Let’s gird up and go.
[If you can support our work .... please do.](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001.bYZLwP2tKNW52PF5H5Fs6UAj3E_p8cNGXIOwo9MdaP4uURHu2CF_xBMsTaXvArHujZCYcWDflXvAHZOdWogeY67YYVzOuRaIaHqb0EQF0i6ti96rrq3S5noXyuTduKaOjqhz7sZ10xBY8Av5zOspG02_w9NITGpCb_4Kg7GhYtKE39F0lr5yFcbyRrdK7MuJZwPlFCLa5tl5hRQW6gOpVDjsRNq7vK4CKfGaXzyRLnNXla_l-ak9hj1dcExcPQsbisSAccLmhl-JNd5AurchfTnQkdBsA33TJKxciQOIbYw/49m/DJovmUAgT-qL-0gbg0Nt1w/h8/h001.k-tgQfsOsfmxdGNEIFkKXdCI5HopngwLI-wGIf2hX6M) The needs are so great but resources are limited. We wish this wasn’t the case, but it is. To support the hotline, to install and stream cameras, to keep all the plates spinning, it is our goal to raise $750,000 over the next 30 days. If we can raise it, we can deploy it. But in any case, we will stay focused.

clean_body: Commit today to work in your local elections in 2024. | | | September 09, 2024 | | | Hi Friend - Lots to catch up on! But first, let’s set the theme for this update ... Gird Up and Go. As of today, there are 57 days between now and November 5th. Only 57 days. The window of opportunity has closed for many things that could have, and should have, been done by now. Not the projects we are working on at True the Vote, mind you. Our focus is on a few very specific efforts, described below. We are trained, prepared, and ready to roll. But we are being peppered with requests for resources and support for new ideas, untested theories, and fantastical expectations. Maybe you are seeing this, too. There is no more time. We must gird up and go. In Voter Registration. Voter registration is still happening. Some states stop registration 30 days before the election, in "same day registration states”, registration continues right up through Election Day. Having assisted over 30,000 people in registering or correcting their records, True the Vote’s is a fast path for registration and review. In Voter Registration, we are girded up and ready. In Voter Roll Evaluation. The federal standard, known as NVRA, closes down maintenance efforts, in almost all states, 90 days before an election. This deadline has passed. True the Vote’s voter rolls in 47 states. We helped voters in over 1600 counties file over a 1,000,000 challenges of potentially ineligible voter registration records. We know that there are over 25 million such records, but now ... it all comes down to who votes. Our early work in this area set us up to now monitor incoming votes from potentially problematic records and forward findings to appropriate parties. In Voter Roll Evaluation, we are girded up and ready. In Training and Support. From Election Worker trainings, to producing reference guides for in-field support, and launching the app for voters and election workers, we are helping recruit, train, and support volunteers nationwide. Mobilization is something that must be done by the parties or candidates. Exceedingly frustrating, but nonetheless true. But, for as much as can be done, we are girded up and ready. In Monitoring Ballot Dropboxes. In 2020 and 2022, we learned more than we could have imagined about ballot dropbox monitoring. Our plan involves AI-driven cameras and real-time livestreaming, equipping Sheriffs where possible, other individuals where necessary. We have tested the tech for over a year. We have our own data center, so the livestream cannot be “disappeared”. We need funding to scale, but otherwise, we are girded up and ready. In Real-Time Reporting. Using the Ground Fusion analytic platform and reporting, we will host daily broadcasts beginning in early October. Media quizzlings will do The Machine’s bidding. We will tell you what’s happening on the ground and give you options to GOTN (Get Out The News). For this too, we are girded up and ready. In Multilingual Outreach. What started as Latino outreach through has expanded from Spanish to now include Vietnamese, Mandarin, and Korean. In this time of polarization and confusion, we are meeting voters where they’re at and sharing election facts in whatever language we need to. The common denominator is our shared love for America. Together, we are girded up and ready. In Prayer. We are so blessed by our ongoing collaboration with Intercessors for America. The ‘Pray the Vote’ initiative gives you very specific ways to pray for voters. Praying it though with IFA, we are girded up and ready. We have volunteers hosting voter registration and support events at long term care facilities (The Older But Wiser Project), voters righteously railing against the noncitizen voting fiasco (The 611 Project), we are still fighting in court on several lawsuits, still hosting weekly Q&A; workshops, and we are assisting many other groups and efforts, in ways seen and unseen. All of that is still going on, but ... it’s time to focus on what we, the American People, can bring to this game. It’s time to lock in on what you can do. Roll up your sleeves. Think outside the box. The goal is simple, get everyone you can to vote to save the Republic. Serve in your local election. Report problems. And pray. There is no single effort that will right all the past wrongs. This is a 1,000 front war. Let’s gird up and go. The needs are so great but resources are limited. We wish this wasn’t the case, but it is. To support the hotline, to install and stream cameras, to keep all the plates spinning, it is our goal to raise $750,000 over the next 30 days. If we can raise it, we can deploy it. But in any case, we will stay focused. | ) I’ll wrap up with this - a reminder of what we do what we do. True the Vote recently had the great privilege of assisting a candidate running for office in Georgia. Ambrose King Jr., nephew of Martin Luther King, Jr., lost a school board race due to fraudulent votes and inaccurate district maps. Ambrose called us when no one else would listen. We listened, we researched, we helped with legal counsel ... and we are thrilled to report that the court overturned the errant election and Ambrose is now slated for another election in November.
